words.native_definition: a person sent to a foreign place to spread a religion
words.core_concept: one sent out to carry a message – 被派出去传递某种信念的人
words.core_image: 带着书和药箱上船，去的是从没到过的地方
examples: Missionaries founded the first school here.
He worked as a medical missionary.
semantic_expansions: 传教士与布道者：都是'被派出去传递信念的人'，一个偏派出一个偏所做

words.root_logic: inter-（之间）+ mit（送）+ -ent → 中间隔着断口地送出 → 间断的
words.origin: 拉丁语 intermittens：inter-（之间）+ mittere（送）——'中间停下'
words.native_definition: stopping and starting at intervals, not continuous
words.core_concept: sent out with gaps in between – 送出时中间夹着停顿
words.core_image: 水龙头没关严，水一滴一滴地落，不成一条线
examples: Intermittent rain is forecast.
He has an intermittent cough.
semantic_expansions: 间断的与断断续续的：都是'中间夹着停顿地送出'，中文两种说法同一个节奏

words.root_logic: pro-（向前）+ mis（送）+ -ing → 预先把话送出去，让人期待 → 有前途的
words.recall_hint: pro-（向前）+ mis（送）+ -ing → 预先把话送出去让人期待，因而看着有指望
words.origin: 拉丁语 promittere：pro-（向前）+ mittere（送）——'预先许诺'
words.native_definition: showing signs of future success
words.core_concept: sending ahead signs worth expecting – 预先透出值得期待的迹象
words.core_image: 苗才出土，看叶色就知道这块地会有收成
examples: She is a promising young engineer.
Early results look promising.
semantic_expansions: 有前途的与有希望的：都是'预先透出值得期待的迹象'，一个说人一个可说事

words.root_logic: de-（往下、拿走）+ duct（引导）→ 从总数里引走一部分 → 扣除
words.origin: 拉丁语 deducere：de-（拿走）+ ducere（引导）
words.native_definition: to take an amount away from a total
words.core_concept: leading an amount away from the total – 从总数里引走一部分
words.core_image: 工资单上先列总额，再一行行往下减
examples: Tax is deducted at source.
Points are deducted for errors.
semantic_expansions: 扣除与减去：都是'从总数里引走一部分'，一个偏账目一个偏运算

words.root_logic: pro-（向前）+ duct（引出）→ 被引出来的那个成品 → 产品
words.origin: 拉丁语 productum：pro-（向前）+ ducere（引导）
words.native_definition: something made to be sold, or a result of a process
words.core_concept: what has been led forth – 被引出来的那个东西
words.core_image: 流水线尽头一件件推出来的成品
examples: The product sells well abroad.
The product of three and four is twelve.
semantic_expansions: 产品：被造出来推向市场的东西
产物：某个过程引出的结果
乘积：两数相乘引出的那个数。三义共享'被引出来的结果'

words.root_logic: product（引出的成果）+ -ive（能…的）→ 能引出成果的 → 多产的
words.origin: 拉丁语 productivus：producere（引出）
words.native_definition: producing a lot, or achieving good results
words.core_concept: able to lead forth much – 能引出许多成果
words.core_image: 同一块地，这片的穗子明显更密
examples: It was a productive meeting.
The land is highly productive.
semantic_expansions: 多产的/生产的：能引出许多成果
有成效的（会议）：确实引出了结果。同一个'引得出成果'，一个说数量一个说实效

words.root_logic: reduce（往回引、减少）+ -ion（名词）→ 被减下来的那一部分或这件事 → 减少
words.origin: 拉丁语 reductio：re-（往回）+ ducere（引导）
words.native_definition: the act of making something smaller, or the amount taken off
words.core_concept: the leading back to something smaller – 往回引、变小这件事
words.core_image: 价签上原价被划掉，旁边写着新的更小的数
examples: There has been a sharp reduction in costs.
Members get a ten percent reduction.
semantic_expansions: 减少/降低：往回引、使变小这件事
折扣：被减下来的那一部分。同一个'往回引'，一个说过程一个说所减之量

words.root_logic: introduce（引进来）+ -ion（名词）→ 引进来这件事，或书前引人入门的那一段 → 介绍
words.recall_hint: introduce（引进来）+ -ion → 把人或物引进来这件事；也指书前引人入门的那一段
words.origin: 拉丁语 introductio：intro-（向内）+ ducere（引导）
words.native_definition: the act of bringing something in or presenting someone, or an opening section
words.core_concept: the leading in of something – 把某物或某人引进来这件事
words.core_image: 主人领着新来的人走进屋，一一说明是谁
examples: The introduction of the tax was delayed.
Read the introduction before chapter one.
semantic_expansions: 介绍（人）/引进（制度）：把人或物引进来
引言：把读者引进正文的那一段。三义共享'引进来'

words.root_logic: dif-（分开）+ fer（带）→ 各自带向不同方向 → 不同
words.origin: 拉丁语 differre：dis-（分开）+ ferre（带）
words.native_definition: to be unlike something else, or to disagree
words.core_concept: being carried apart from each other – 各自被带往不同方向
words.core_image: 两条路从同一个岔口分开，越走越远
examples: The two versions differ slightly.
Experts differ on this point.
semantic_expansions: 不同/相异：各自朝不同方向去
有分歧（人）：意见各自朝不同方向去。同一个'分向而行'，一个说事物一个说看法

words.root_logic: differ（分向而行）+ -ence（名词）→ 分开之后隔出的那一段 → 差别
words.origin: 拉丁语 differentia：dis-（分开）+ ferre（带）
words.native_definition: the way in which two things are not the same, or the amount by which they vary
words.core_concept: the gap left by being carried apart – 分向而行之后隔出的那一段
words.core_image: 两条线从同一点岔开，末端之间那段空白
examples: There is a big difference in price.
Can you tell the difference?
semantic_expansions: 差别/差异：分开之后隔出的那一段
差额：两数之间隔出的那个量。同一个'隔出的距离'，量的是性质还是数目

words.root_logic: differ（分向而行）+ -ent（…的）→ 走的不是同一条路的 → 不同的
words.origin: 拉丁语 differens：dis-（分开）+ ferre（带）
words.native_definition: not the same as another
words.core_concept: not carried along the same line – 与另一个不在同一条路上
words.core_image: 两只鞋摆在一起，一眼看出不是一双
examples: We have very different tastes.
She tried three different methods.
semantic_expansions: 不同的：不在同一条路上
各种各样的（three different）：彼此都不相同的那几个。同一个'不相同'，一个作对比一个作列举

words.root_logic: in-（否定）+ different（有分别的）→ 觉得没什么分别的 → 漠不关心的
words.recall_hint: in-（否定）+ different（有分别）→ 在他看来两边没什么分别，因而无所谓、不上心
words.origin: 拉丁语 indifferens：in-（不）+ differre（有分别）
words.native_definition: having no interest or concern, or of mediocre quality
words.core_concept: seeing no difference worth caring about – 看不出有什么分别值得在意
words.core_image: 问他选哪个，他连头都没抬：都行
examples: He was indifferent to the outcome.
The food was indifferent at best.
semantic_expansions: 漠不关心的/无所谓的：看不出分别，因而不上心
平庸的：不比别的好也不比别的差。同一个'没有分别'，一个说态度一个说水平

words.root_logic: trans-（穿过）+ fer（带）→ 把东西带到另一边 → 转移
words.origin: 拉丁语 transferre：trans-（穿过）+ ferre（带）
words.native_definition: to move something or someone from one place or owner to another
words.core_concept: carrying something across to another place – 把东西带过去到另一处
words.core_image: 钱从一个账户划到另一个，中间那一下什么都不在
examples: She transferred the funds yesterday.
Transfer to line 2 at the next stop.
semantic_expansions: 转移/转让：把东西带到另一处或另一人手里
转乘：把自己带到另一条线上。同一个'带过去'，带的是物还是人

words.root_logic: pre-（在前）+ fer（带）→ 把它拿到前面来 → 更喜欢
words.origin: 拉丁语 praeferre：prae-（在前）+ ferre（带）——'置于前'
words.native_definition: to like one thing better than another
words.core_concept: carrying one out in front of the rest – 把其中一个拿到前面来
words.core_image: 几件里挑出一件先摆到前面，其余推到后面
examples: I prefer tea to coffee.
She prefers to walk.
semantic_expansions: 更喜欢与宁愿：都是'把它拿到前面来'，一个说偏好一个说取舍

words.root_logic: prefer（拿到前面）+ -ence（名词）→ 被拿到前面的那个取向 → 偏好
words.origin: 拉丁语 praeferre（置于前）+ -ence
words.native_definition: a greater liking for one thing over another, or the thing preferred
words.core_concept: which one is carried out in front – 被拿到前面的那一个
words.core_image: 名单按意愿排序，第一行就是最想要的那个
examples: State your preference on the form.
Members are given preference.
semantic_expansions: 偏好/偏爱之物：被拿到前面的那个取向或对象
优先（给予优先）：让某人排在前面。同一个'置于前'，一个是心里的顺序一个是待遇上的顺序

words.root_logic: suf-（sub- 的变体，在下）+ fer（承受）→ 在底下扛着 → 遭受
words.origin: 拉丁语 sufferre：sub-（在下）+ ferre（承受）
words.native_definition: to experience something bad, or to feel pain
words.core_concept: bearing a weight from underneath – 在底下扛着那份重量
words.core_image: 担子压在肩上，路还得走完
examples: She suffers from migraines.
The economy suffered badly.
semantic_expansions: 遭受/受苦：在底下扛着那份重量
变差（业绩）：因承压而走低。同一个'在下承受'，一个说人一个说事态

words.root_logic: platea（宽街、场地）本身即词根，无词缀 → 东西落定的那块地方；作动词是把它搁到那儿
words.recall_hint: platea（场地）本身即词根 → 东西落定的那块地方；作动词则是把它搁到某处
words.origin: 拉丁语 platea（宽街）← 希腊语 plateia（宽阔的路）
words.native_definition: a particular position or area, or to put something in a position
words.core_concept: the spot where something sits – 东西落定的那一块
words.core_image: 书架上每本书都有自己那一格，抽走就留个空
examples: This is a good place to stop.
Place the vase on the shelf.
semantic_expansions: 地方/位置：东西落定的那一块
放置（动词）：把它搁到那一块上。同一个'落定之处'，一个是名词一个是动作

words.root_logic: re-（重新）+ place（放置）→ 在同一位置上换另一个放进去 → 取代
words.recall_hint: re-（重新）+ place（放置）→ 在同一位置上换另一个放进去；也指把东西放回原处
words.origin: 拉丁语 re-（重新）+ platea（场地）经法语 replacer
words.native_definition: to take the place of something, or to put something back
words.core_concept: putting another into the same spot – 在同一位置上换另一个放进去
words.core_image: 旧灯泡拧下来，新的拧进同一个灯口
examples: Machines replaced much manual work.
Please replace the book on the shelf.
semantic_expansions: 取代/更换：在原位上换另一个
放回：把它重新搁回原位。同一个'重新放置'，换掉还是复位

words.root_logic: replace（换上去）+ -ment（结果）→ 换这件事，或换上去的那一个 → 替换、替代者
words.recall_hint: replace（在原位换一个）+ -ment → 换这件事本身；也指被换上去的那个人或物
words.origin: 拉丁语 re-（重新）+ platea（场地）+ -ment
words.native_definition: the act of replacing, or the person or thing that replaces another
words.core_concept: the swapping, or what is swapped in – 换这件事，或换上去的那一个
words.core_image: 名单上原来那个名字被划掉，下面写着新来的
examples: Replacement of the roof took a week.
They found a replacement for her.
semantic_expansions: 替换/更换：换这件事本身
替代者：被换上去的那个人或物。同一个'换上'，一个是行为一个指对象

words.root_logic: dis-（离开）+ place（位置）→ 把它从原位挪走 → 移置
words.origin: 拉丁语 dis-（离开）+ platea（场地）
words.native_definition: to force something or someone out of its usual place
words.core_concept: forcing something out of its spot – 把它从原本的位置挤走
words.core_image: 石头放进满杯的水里，水从杯口溢出去
examples: The flood displaced thousands.
Cars displaced horses in the city.
semantic_expansions: 移置：把它从原位挤走
使离开家园：把人从原住地挤走
取代：占了原来那个的位置。三义共享'从原位被挤开'

words.root_logic: inter-（之间）+ leg（挑选）+ -ent → 能在混杂之间挑出分别的 → 聪明的
words.origin: 拉丁语 intelligens：inter-（之间）+ legere（挑选）
words.native_definition: able to learn and understand things quickly
words.core_concept: able to pick out distinctions others miss – 能在混杂中挑出别人看不出的分别
words.core_image: 一堆相似的种子里，他一眼指出哪几粒不一样
examples: She asked an intelligent question.
The car has an intelligent braking system.
semantic_expansions: 聪明的：能挑出别人看不出的分别
智能的（设备）：能自行分辨情形并作出反应。同一个'分辨得出'，一个说人一个说机器

words.root_logic: intelligent（分辨得出的）+ -ence（名词）→ 分辨的能力；引申为分辨出来的军政消息 → 情报
words.recall_hint: intelligent（分辨得出）+ -ence → 分辨的那份能力；引申为经分辨筛出的军政消息
words.origin: 拉丁语 intelligentia：inter-（之间）+ legere（挑选）
words.native_definition: the ability to learn and understand, or secret information about an enemy
words.core_concept: the power of picking out distinctions – 分辨出门道的那份能力
words.core_image: 同一堆材料，有人只看见纸，有人看出里面的门道
examples: The test measures verbal intelligence.
Military intelligence warned of the attack.
semantic_expansions: 智力/智慧：分辨出门道的能力
情报：经分辨筛出的关键消息。同一个'从混杂中辨出'，一个是能力一个是所得

words.root_logic: intellect（分辨力）+ -ual（…的）→ 与分辨思考相关的 → 智力的、知识分子
words.recall_hint: intellect（分辨力）+ -ual → 与动脑分辨相关的；作名词则指以此为业的那类人
words.origin: 拉丁语 intellectualis：intelligere（分辨、领会）
words.native_definition: relating to thinking and reasoning, or a person who works with ideas
words.core_concept: having to do with the work of discerning – 与动脑分辨这件事相关
words.core_image: 桌上摊着书和笔记，工作靠的是想不是手
examples: The book poses an intellectual challenge.
She moved in intellectual circles.
semantic_expansions: 智力的/脑力的：与动脑分辨相关
知识分子（名词）：以动脑分辨为业的人。同一个'分辨之事'，一个说属性一个指人

words.root_logic: intellig（分辨、领会）+ -ible（可…的）→ 分辨得出意思的 → 可理解的
words.origin: 拉丁语 intelligibilis：intelligere（领会）
words.native_definition: able to be understood
words.core_concept: such that the sense can be picked out – 意思分辨得出来
words.core_image: 对方口音很重，但每个字还是听得出来
examples: His explanation was barely intelligible.
Make the diagram intelligible to beginners.
semantic_expansions: 可理解的与清楚易懂的：都是'意思分辨得出来'，一个说可能一个说程度

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ vent（来、碰上）→ 碰上一个从来没有的东西并把它做出来 → 发明
words.recall_hint: in-（进入）+ vent（来、碰上）→ 碰上从来没有的那个东西并把它做出来；也指编造出并不存在的说法
words.origin: 拉丁语 invenire：in-（进入）+ venire（来）——'碰上、找到'
words.native_definition: to create something that did not exist before, or to make up a false story
words.core_concept: coming upon something new and bringing it into being – 碰上从未有的东西并把它带出来
words.core_image: 试了几十次之后，那个从没存在过的装置转起来了
examples: He invented a new kind of valve.
She invented an excuse on the spot.
semantic_expansions: 发明/创造：碰上并做出从未有过的东西
编造：造出并不存在的说法。同一个'使原本没有的出现'，一个是实物一个是虚言

words.root_logic: invent（做出新东西）+ -ion（名词）→ 发明这件事，或做出来的那件东西 → 发明物
words.origin: 拉丁语 inventio：invenire（找到、发明）
words.native_definition: something newly created, or the act of creating it
words.core_concept: what has been brought newly into being – 被带到世上来的那个新东西
words.core_image: 专利证书旁摆着那台机器，世上原本没有它
examples: The invention changed farming.
The whole story was pure invention.
semantic_expansions: 发明/发明物：被带到世上的那个新东西
虚构：被造出来的那个不存在之事。同一个'使之出现'，真物还是空言
words.recall_hint: invent（碰上并做出从未有的东西）+ -ion → 这件事本身，或做出来的那个物；也指凭空造出的说法

words.root_logic: invent（碰上、找到）+ -ory（表所列之物）→ 把找得到的东西逐项列出来 → 清单
words.recall_hint: invent（碰上、找到）+ -ory → 把能找到的东西逐项列出来的那份单子；也指所列的那批存货
words.origin: 拉丁语 inventarium：invenire（找到）——'所寻见之物的清单'
words.native_definition: a complete list of goods, or the stock a business holds
words.core_concept: a list of everything found on hand – 把手上找得到的逐项列出
words.core_image: 仓库里逐架清点，每一项数目都记在纸上
examples: They took an inventory of the warehouse.
Inventory levels fell in June.
semantic_expansions: 清单/盘存：把找得到的逐项列出
存货：所列的那批东西本身。同一个'清点所有'，一个是单子一个是货

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ vit（此处取 invitare'请来'义）→ 请人进来 → 邀请
words.recall_hint: in-（进入）+ vit（请来）→ 请对方进来；引申为某种做法把麻烦也一并请了进来
words.origin: 拉丁语 invitare：in-（进入）+ -vitare（请）
words.native_definition: to ask someone to come or to take part, or to bring something on oneself
words.core_concept: asking someone in – 请对方进到这边来
words.core_image: 门推开一半，主人抬手让客人先进
examples: They invited us to dinner.
Such carelessness invites trouble.
semantic_expansions: 邀请：请人进来
招致（麻烦）：等于把麻烦也请了进来。同一个'请进'，请的是客还是祸

words.root_logic: ad-（朝向）+ vers（转）→ 转过来正对着你的 → 不利的
words.origin: 拉丁语 adversus：ad-（朝向）+ vertere（转）——'迎面而来的'
words.native_definition: unfavourable or harmful
words.core_concept: turned to face against you – 转过来正对着你、挡着你
words.core_image: 顶风骑车，风正对着脸吹
examples: Adverse weather delayed the flight.
The drug has few adverse effects.
semantic_expansions: 不利的/逆向的：转过来正对着你挡路
有害的（副作用）：作用转向了不该去的方向。同一个'迎面相对'，一个是阻力一个是伤害

words.root_logic: di-（分开）+ vers（转）→ 各自转向不同方向的 → 多样的
words.origin: 拉丁语 diversus：dis-（分开）+ vertere（转）
words.native_definition: of many different kinds
words.core_concept: turned in many different directions – 各自朝不同方向转开
words.core_image: 一把伞骨从中心散开，没有两根指同一处
examples: The city has a diverse population.
Her interests are remarkably diverse.
semantic_expansions: 多样的与各不相同的：都是'各自朝不同方向转开'，中文一个说整体一个说彼此

words.root_logic: in-（反）+ vers（转）→ 关系正好倒过来的 → 相反的
words.origin: 拉丁语 inversus：in-（反）+ vertere（转）
words.native_definition: opposite in position, order, or relationship
words.core_concept: turned into the opposite arrangement – 次序或关系整个倒过来
words.core_image: 一边升高另一边必降低，跷跷板两头永远相反
examples: Pressure and volume have an inverse relation.
The inverse is also true.
semantic_expansions: 相反的/逆的：关系整个倒过来
反比的（数学）：一个增另一个必减。同一个'倒转的关系'，一个泛指一个专指比例

words.root_logic: re-（往回）+ vers（转）→ 转到相反方向 → 倒转
words.origin: 拉丁语 reversus：re-（往回）+ vertere（转）
words.native_definition: to change to the opposite direction or decision, or the opposite side
words.core_concept: turning something back the other way – 把它转到相反方向
words.core_image: 挂上倒挡，车开始往后走
examples: The court reversed the decision.
Print on the reverse side.
semantic_expansions: 倒转：转到相反方向
撤销（判决）：把已定的翻过来
背面：转过去那一面。三义共享'转到反向'

words.root_logic: de-（缺）+ fic（做）+ -iency（名词）→ 该做够而没做够的那一块 → 不足
words.origin: 拉丁语 deficientia：de-（缺）+ facere（做）
words.native_definition: a lack or shortage of something needed
words.core_concept: the shortfall where something was not made up – 该补足而没补足的那一块
words.core_image: 化验单上那一行低于下限，旁边画了个箭头
examples: Iron deficiency causes fatigue.
The report notes several deficiencies.
semantic_expansions: 不足/缺乏：该够而没够的那一块
缺陷：该做到而没做到之处。同一个'没做足'，一个说量一个说质

words.root_logic: efficient（做出结果又不浪费的）+ -cy（名词）→ 不浪费地做出结果的那个程度 → 效率
words.origin: 拉丁语 efficientia：ex-（向外）+ facere（做）
words.native_definition: the ability to do something well without wasting resources
words.core_concept: how much is produced per unit spent – 每份投入换来多少产出
words.core_image: 同样一桶油，这台机器跑得更远
examples: The upgrade improved fuel efficiency.
We must raise efficiency, not hours.
semantic_expansions: 效率与效能：都是'每份投入换来多少产出'，一个偏比值一个偏能力

words.root_logic: pro-（向前）+ fic（做）+ -iency → 做到能往前走一大截的水平 → 熟练
words.recall_hint: pro-（向前）+ fic（做）+ -iency → 做得已经能往前推进一大截的那个水平
words.origin: 拉丁语 proficientia：pro-（向前）+ facere（做）——'有进展的'
words.native_definition: a good standard of ability or skill in something
words.core_concept: having advanced far in the doing – 在做这件事上已经推进得很远
words.core_image: 同一段谱子，他不看谱也弹得下来
examples: Proficiency in Japanese is required.
She reached proficiency in six months.
semantic_expansions: 熟练/精通：在做这件事上推进得很远
水平（考试等级）：所达到的那个程度。同一个'做到多远'，一个说能力一个说等级

words.root_logic: infect（进到体内动手脚）+ -ious（…的）→ 会传给别人的 → 传染的
words.origin: 拉丁语 infectiosus：in-（进入）+ facere（做）
words.native_definition: able to be passed from one person to another, or spreading readily
words.core_concept: able to get inside another and act there – 能进到别人体内起作用
words.core_image: 一人咳嗽，同屋的人接着一个个咳起来
examples: Measles is highly infectious.
Her laughter was infectious.
semantic_expansions: 传染性的（疾病）：能进到别人体内起作用
有感染力的（情绪）：能传进别人心里。同一个'进到他人内里起作用'，传的是病还是情绪

words.root_logic: proceed（往前走）+ -ing（名词）→ 一步步往前推的那件事，尤指法律程序 → 诉讼程序
words.recall_hint: proceed（往前走）+ -ing → 一步步往前推的那个过程，尤指按法定步骤走的那一套
words.origin: 拉丁语 procedere：pro-（向前）+ cedere（行走）
words.native_definition: an action taken in a legal case, or the record of a meeting
words.core_concept: the going forward step by step – 一步步往前推的那个过程
words.core_image: 法庭日程表上一项接一项，按顺序往下走
examples: Legal proceedings began in March.
The proceedings were published later.
semantic_expansions: 诉讼程序/进程：一步步往前推的那个过程
议程记录：把这个过程记下来的那份东西。同一个'往前推的步骤'，一个是过程一个是记录

words.root_logic: pro-（向前）+ cess（行走）+ -ion → 一队人依次向前走 → 队列
words.origin: 拉丁语 processio：pro-（向前）+ cedere（行走）
words.native_definition: a line of people or vehicles moving forward in an orderly way
words.core_concept: a body moving forward in order – 一队依次向前走的人
words.core_image: 长街上人一列列走过，前后不乱
examples: A funeral procession blocked the road.
The procession moved toward the square.
semantic_expansions: 队列/行列：依次向前走的一队
游行：这样走过街市的场面。同一个'依次前行'，一个说形态一个说场合

words.root_logic: suc-（紧接）+ cess（行走）+ -ion → 一个紧接一个走上来 → 连续、继承
words.recall_hint: suc-（紧接）+ cess（行走）+ -ion → 一个紧接一个走上来：既指接连不断，也指位子一代代传下去
words.origin: 拉丁语 successio：sub-（紧接）+ cedere（行走）
words.native_definition: a number of things following one after another, or the passing on of a title
words.core_concept: one following right after another – 一个紧接一个走上来
words.core_image: 台阶上的人一个下来一个接着上去，位置从没空过
examples: She won three titles in succession.
The rules of succession were disputed.
semantic_expansions: 连续：一个紧接一个
接替/继承：位子一个接一个传下去。同一个'紧接而上'，一个说次序一个说承袭

words.root_logic: succeed（紧接着走）+ -ive（…的）→ 一个接一个不断的 → 连续的
words.origin: 拉丁语 successivus：sub-（紧接）+ cedere（行走）
words.native_definition: following one after another without interruption
words.core_concept: coming one right after another – 一个紧接一个地来
words.core_image: 日历上连着五格都画了圈，中间没有空格
examples: It rained for four successive days.
Successive governments avoided the issue.
semantic_expansions: 连续的与接连的：都是'一个紧接一个地来'，与 consecutive 近义，均出 cedere

words.root_logic: success（一步步走到目标）+ -ful（充满…的）→ 走到了目标的 → 成功的
words.origin: 拉丁语 successus：sub-（紧接）+ cedere（行走）+ 英语 -ful
words.native_definition: achieving what was aimed at
words.core_concept: having arrived at the goal – 一步步走到了目标
words.core_image: 登顶那一刻回头，走过的路全在脚下
examples: The launch was successful.
She is a successful architect.
semantic_expansions: 成功的与有成就的：都是'一步步走到了目标'，一个说结果一个说其人

words.root_logic: de-（完全）+ taillier（切）→ 从整体中细细切出的部分
words.origin: 古法语 detail：de- + taillier（切开）
words.native_definition: a small individual part of a larger whole
words.core_concept: a small piece cut out for close attention – 从整体中切出来单独细看的小部分
words.core_image: 一幅大图被放大，其中一小角显出细密纹路
examples: The report includes every important detail.
She described the scene in detail.
semantic_expansions: 细节/详情：从整体中切出并单独查看的小部分
详述（动词）：把整体切成小部分逐项说清

words.root_logic: en-（使进入）+ taillier（切、刻）→ 把条件刻进安排里，使其必然随附
words.origin: 古法语 entaillier（刻入）；法律义先指以限定方式安排地产，后泛化为必然包含
words.native_definition: to make something necessary or to involve it as a consequence
words.core_concept: having a condition cut into an arrangement so it must come with it – 条件被刻进安排，无法单独拿掉
words.core_image: 合同边缘刻着一道条件，签下主体也同时带上它
examples: The job entails frequent travel.
Repairing the roof will entail considerable expense.
semantic_expansions: 使必要/必然包含：条件已经刻进安排，接受主体就必须连带接受它
牵涉：某事随主要行动一并被带进来

words.root_logic: re-（再次、分回）+ taillier（切）→ 从大宗货物中再切成小份出售
words.origin: 古法语 retaillier（切下一块）；retail 原指零切出售
words.native_definition: the sale of goods to the public in small quantities
words.core_concept: cutting bulk goods into portions for individual buyers – 把大宗货切成个人能买的小份
words.core_image: 一整卷布在柜台上按顾客需要一段段剪下
examples: The company sells its products at retail.
Online retail has grown rapidly.
semantic_expansions: 零售：把大宗货物分切成面向个人的小份
零售业/零售的：围绕这种分份出售形成的行业或属性

words.root_logic: taillier（切、裁）+ 人称后缀 → 按尺寸裁布的人
words.origin: 古法语 tailleur（裁切者），来自 taillier（切）
words.native_definition: a person who makes fitted clothes, or to adapt something for a purpose
words.core_concept: cutting material to fit one particular body or need – 按特定对象的尺寸裁出合身形状
words.core_image: 一双手沿着粉笔线下剪，让布片恰好贴合一个人的尺寸
examples: The tailor adjusted the jacket sleeves.
The course is tailored to beginners.
semantic_expansions: 裁缝：按人的尺寸裁布者
使适合：像裁衣一样按具体需要改造内容

words.root_logic: pre-（在前）+ sid（坐）+ -ent（人）→ 坐在众人前面主持的人
words.origin: 拉丁语 praesidens，praesidere（坐在前面、主持）的现在分词
words.native_definition: the elected head of a republic or the person in charge of an organization
words.core_concept: the person seated before a group to preside over it – 坐在众人前面主持事务的人
words.core_image: 会议桌前端有一个主位，坐在那里的人主持全场
examples: The president addressed the nation.
She was elected president of the association.
semantic_expansions: 总统/主席/会长：都指坐在集体前面主持事务的人，中文按组织层级区分

words.root_logic: re-（留在、回到）+ sid（坐）+ -ence → 稳定坐落并居住的地方
words.origin: 拉丁语 residentia，来自 residere（留下、居住）
words.native_definition: the place where someone lives, especially officially
words.core_concept: a place where someone settles and remains – 一个人坐定并长期留下的地方
words.core_image: 夜里一栋房子的窗户亮起，住户每天都回到这里
examples: The form asks for your place of residence.
The ambassador returned to the official residence.
semantic_expansions: 住所/官邸：人稳定居住的地点，官邸强调职务身份
居住：在某处坐定并持续留下的状态

words.root_logic: re-（留在）+ sid（坐）+ -ent（人）→ 在一个地方坐定并长期留下的人
words.origin: 拉丁语 residens，residere（留下、居住）的现在分词
words.native_definition: a person who lives in a particular place, or staying in a place
words.core_concept: someone settled in a particular place – 在某地坐定并长期留下的人
words.core_image: 公寓门口的一排信箱写着长期住在这里的人的名字
examples: Local residents opposed the plan.
She is resident in London.
semantic_expansions: 居民/住户：在某地稳定留下的人
居住的：说明某人或事物固定留在该处

words.root_logic: sub-（在后、在下）+ sid（坐）→ 坐在后方待命的后备力量 → 支援款项
words.origin: 拉丁语 subsidium（后备部队、援助），来自 subsidere（坐在后方待命）
words.native_definition: money given by a government or organization to support an activity
words.core_concept: support kept sitting in reserve behind an activity – 留在后方、需要时托住事情的支援
words.core_image: 主力资金快见底时，后方一只储备钱袋被推到桌前
examples: Farmers receive a government subsidy.
The museum depends on public subsidies.
semantic_expansions: 补贴/津贴/补助金：都是后方拨出的支援资金，中文按对象和制度区分

words.root_logic: cor-（共同）+ relate（带入联系）→ 把两项共同带到一条线上比较
words.origin: 现代拉丁语 correlatio：com-（共同）+ relatio（关联）
words.native_definition: to show or have a mutual relationship
words.core_concept: bringing two changing things onto the same line – 把两个变化项带到一起看它们是否同步
words.core_image: 两条数据曲线叠在同一张图上，一起升降
examples: Income tends to correlate with education.
Researchers correlated the two sets of data.
semantic_expansions: 相关/使相互关联：把两项带到同一条线上寻找共同变化
关联物：在这条联系中与另一项对应的事物

words.root_logic: re-（带回）+ lat（ferre 的过去分词词干，带）→ 把一件事带回另一件事旁边 → 关联或讲述
words.origin: 拉丁语 relatus，referre（带回、报告）的过去分词
words.native_definition: to connect things, tell an account, or understand someone's experience
words.core_concept: carrying one thing back beside another – 把一件事带到另一件事旁边形成联系
words.core_image: 说话者把过去发生的事一件件带回听众面前
examples: The study relates diet to health.
She related the whole incident to the police.
Many readers can relate to the character.
semantic_expansions: 联系：把两件事带到一起
讲述：把过去的事情带回听者面前
理解并认同：把别人的经历带回自己的经验旁边比较

words.root_logic: relate（带到一起）+ -ion → 两件事被带到一起后形成的联系
words.origin: 拉丁语 relatio（带回、报告、联系），来自 referre
words.native_definition: a connection between people, groups, or things
words.core_concept: the connection formed by bringing things together – 事物被带到一起后形成的那条联系
words.core_image: 两座分开的岛之间架起一座桥，双方因此相连
examples: The relation between the two variables is unclear.
Diplomatic relations have improved.
semantic_expansions: 关系/联系：事物被带到一起后形成的连接
亲属：由共同血缘把人带到一起的一类关系

words.root_logic: relation（联系）+ -ship（状态）→ 联系持续存在的状态与方式
words.origin: 英语 relation + -ship，relation 最终来自拉丁语 referre（带回）
words.native_definition: the way in which people or things are connected
words.core_concept: an ongoing state of connection – 一条联系持续存在并形成固定相处方式
words.core_image: 两个人之间的一根线经过长期往来变成稳定的纽带
examples: They have a close working relationship.
The chart shows the relationship between cost and quality.
semantic_expansions: 关系/关联：两方持续相连的方式
人际关系：这种持续连接发生在人与人之间

words.root_logic: pract（做）+ -ical（…的）→ 能拿来实际做、能解决现实问题的
words.origin: 希腊语 praktikos（适合行动的），来自 prassein（做）
words.native_definition: concerned with real situations and likely to work effectively
words.core_concept: suited to being done in the real world – 放到现实中能真正做成的
words.core_image: 方案从纸面搬到工作台，工具材料都刚好用得上
examples: We need a practical solution.
The course provides practical experience.
semantic_expansions: 实际的/实践的：着眼于真实行动而非纯理论
实用的：放进现实行动后确实能解决问题

words.root_logic: practical（实际可做的）+ -ly → 从实际操作看；进一步表示几乎已经如此
words.origin: 英语 practical + -ly；practical 最终来自希腊语 prassein（做）
words.native_definition: in a realistic way, or almost completely
words.core_concept: judged by what happens in actual action – 按真正做起来的结果判断
words.core_image: 进度条只剩细细一格，实际看已经等于完成
examples: Practically speaking, the plan is impossible.
The hall was practically empty.
semantic_expansions: 实际上/实用地：按现实行动而不是抽象说法判断
几乎：实际效果已经接近完整状态，只差极小一步

words.root_logic: pract（做）+ -ise（使、反复进行）→ 反复实际去做以形成能力
words.origin: 中古英语 practisen，来自古法语 practiser，最终源自希腊语 prassein（做）
words.native_definition: to do an activity repeatedly to improve, or to work in a profession
words.core_concept: doing an action repeatedly until it becomes reliable – 一遍遍实际去做直到熟练
words.core_image: 同一段旋律被每天重复弹奏，手指越来越顺
examples: She practises the piano every morning.
He practises law in Manchester.
semantic_expansions: 练习：反复实际去做以提高能力
实行：把原则落实为行动
从事职业：长期实际执行某种专业工作

words.root_logic: practise（实际从事）+ -er（人）→ 长期实际从事某项专业工作的人
words.origin: 英语 practitioner，来自 practise；最终源自希腊语 prassein（做）
words.native_definition: a person actively engaged in a profession or skilled practice
words.core_concept: a person who regularly carries out a skilled practice – 经常亲手执行专业工作的人
words.core_image: 诊室里的人不是只读理论，而是每天亲自处理真实病例
examples: The clinic needs an experienced medical practitioner.
She is a leading practitioner of the method.
semantic_expansions: 从业者/执业者：实际执行某种专业工作的人
实践者：把一种方法持续落实为行动的人

words.root_logic: phys（自然、身体）+ -ical（…的）→ 属于可观察自然或身体实体的
words.origin: 拉丁语 physicalis，来自希腊语 physikos（自然的），源于 physis（自然）
words.native_definition: relating to the body, material things, or the laws of nature
words.core_concept: belonging to material nature and the body – 属于可触摸的自然实体与身体
words.core_image: 手掌碰到石块，能感到它真实的重量和硬度
examples: Regular physical activity improves health.
The device suffered physical damage.
semantic_expansions: 身体的：指自然生长的身体实体
物质的：指可触摸和测量的自然实体
物理的：指这些实体遵循的自然规律

words.root_logic: physic（自然知识、医术）+ -ian（从业者）→ 研究并照料身体自然状态的人
words.origin: 中古英语 fisicien，来自古法语，最终源自希腊语 physis（自然）；中世纪 physic 兼指自然学与医术
words.native_definition: a medical doctor, especially one treating illness without surgery
words.core_concept: a specialist in the body's natural condition – 诊察身体状态并帮助其恢复的人
words.core_image: 医生观察脉搏、呼吸和体温，从身体迹象判断病情
examples: The physician examined the patient carefully.
Consult your physician before changing the dose.
semantic_expansions: 医师：研究并处理身体自然状态的专业人员
内科医生：现代语境中常特指主要用非外科方法治疗的人

words.root_logic: physics（自然规律之学）+ -ist（研究者）→ 研究物质与能量规律的人
words.origin: 英语 physicist，来自 physics；physics 最终源自希腊语 physis（自然）
words.native_definition: a scientist who studies matter, energy, and natural forces
words.core_concept: a researcher of the rules governing material nature – 寻找物质世界运行规律的人
words.core_image: 实验室里一束光穿过仪器，研究者记录它如何偏转
examples: The physicist developed a new model of matter.
Several physicists repeated the experiment.

words.root_logic: phys（自然）+ -ics（学科）→ 研究自然物质、能量与运动规律的学科
words.origin: 希腊语 ta physika（关于自然之事），来自 physis（自然）
words.native_definition: the science of matter, energy, motion, and forces
words.core_concept: the systematic study of material nature – 系统寻找物质自然如何运行
words.core_image: 小球沿斜面滚下，刻度和计时器把运动规律记录下来
examples: She studies physics at university.
The physics of flight is complex.
semantic_expansions: 物理学：系统研究物质与能量的自然规律
物理现象：某件事背后实际运行的那些规律

words.root_logic: com-（共同、环绕）+ pass（步）→ 绕着边界一步步走量 → 圈定范围与定向工具
words.origin: 中古英语 compas，来自古法语 compasser（丈量、绕行），与 passus（步）相关
words.native_definition: an instrument showing direction, or the range and limits of something
words.core_concept: pacing around a boundary to establish direction and range – 绕着范围走量以确定方向和界限
words.core_image: 人在空地绕一圈丈量边界，再用指针确认北方
examples: Use a compass to find north.
The issue lies beyond the compass of this study.
semantic_expansions: 指南针：帮助行路者确定该往哪一步走
圆规：绕中心划定圆形边界
范围：被绕行丈量后圈定的界限

words.root_logic: passare（迈步经过）→ 从一边走过界线到另一边
words.origin: 古法语 passer，来自晚期拉丁语 passare（迈步、经过）
words.native_definition: to move beyond a point, give something onward, or succeed in a test
words.core_concept: moving across a point and onward – 跨过一个位置继续向前
words.core_image: 接力棒越过两人之间的界线，被递到下一只手里
examples: We passed the station at noon.
She passed the exam.
Please pass the salt.
semantic_expansions: 经过：身体跨过一个地点
通过：跨过考试设下的标准线
传递：让物品越过人与人之间的界线

words.root_logic: pass（经过）+ -age（过程或结果）→ 经过某处的通道、过程或一段文字
words.recall_hint: 先抓住 pass 的‘跨过’：它既可以是供移动穿过的一段路径，也可以是时间推进的过程，还可以是阅读时从头走到尾的一段文字。
words.origin: 古法语 passage，来自 passer（经过）
words.native_definition: the act or route of passing, or a section of text
words.core_concept: a route or segment through which movement proceeds – 让移动穿过的一段路径
words.core_image: 墙中留出一条窄道，人可以从一个房间走到另一个房间
examples: A narrow passage led to the garden.
The passage of time changed the town.
Read the final passage carefully.
semantic_expansions: 通道：供人经过的路径
经过：跨越过程本身
段落：阅读时从头走到尾的一段文字

words.root_logic: sur-（越过、在上）+ pass（经过）→ 走过对方所在的位置 → 超过
words.origin: 古法语 surpasser：sur-（在上、越过）+ passer（经过）
words.native_definition: to do or be better or greater than someone or something
words.core_concept: passing beyond another person's level – 跨过对方所处的标线继续向前
words.core_image: 两名跑者并排时，其中一人再迈一步越到前面
examples: Sales surpassed all expectations.
Her latest work surpasses the earlier novel.
semantic_expansions: 超过/超越：跨过原有数量或水平线
胜过：跨过竞争者所在的位置

words.root_logic: histor(y)（调查记录）+ -ian（从事者）→ 研究并书写过去记录的人
words.origin: 英语 historian，来自 history；最终源自希腊语 historia（调查、叙述）
words.native_definition: a person who studies and writes about the past
words.core_concept: a person who investigates evidence and builds an account of the past – 查证材料并重建过去叙述的人
words.core_image: 书桌上摊着档案、旧信和地图，研究者逐项核对年代
examples: The historian examined newly opened archives.
Historians disagree about the cause of the war.
semantic_expansions: 历史学家/史学工作者：都指调查证据并组织过去叙述的人，中文按语境正式程度区分

words.root_logic: histor(y)（历史记录）+ -ic → 值得写进历史记录的 → 有历史重大意义的
words.origin: 英语 historic，来自 history；最终源自希腊语 historia
words.native_definition: important enough to be remembered in history
words.core_concept: important enough to enter the lasting account – 重要到会被写进长期记录
words.core_image: 签字笔落下的一刻，大批记者把这一事件记录下来
examples: The leaders signed a historic agreement.
It was a historic victory for the team.
semantic_expansions: 有历史意义的/历史性的：重要到会被后人持续记述；不是泛指任何过去的事物

words.root_logic: history（历史记录）+ -ical → 与过去记录或历史研究有关的
words.origin: 英语 historical，来自 history；最终源自希腊语 historia
words.native_definition: connected with the study or events of the past
words.core_concept: belonging to the evidence and account of the past – 属于过去材料与叙述范围的
words.core_image: 博物馆展柜里陈列旧地图，标签注明它来自哪个年代
examples: The novel is based on historical events.
We need to examine the historical evidence.
semantic_expansions: 历史的/有关历史的：泛指与过去事件或研究有关
史实的：强调叙述能够由历史材料支持；与 historic 的重大意义不同

words.root_logic: historia（调查、叙述）→ 对过去进行调查后形成的记录
words.origin: 希腊语 historia（调查所得的知识、叙述），经拉丁语和古法语进入英语
words.native_definition: the study and record of past events, or a person's previous experience
words.core_concept: an investigated account of what happened before – 对已经发生之事的查证与记述
words.core_image: 一卷时间轴把散落的旧事件按先后顺序连接起来
examples: She teaches modern European history.
The patient has a history of heart disease.
semantic_expansions: 历史/历史学：对过去事件的记录与系统研究
经历：某个人或事物过去发生过的事情记录

words.root_logic: electr（琥珀摩擦产生的电现象）+ -ic → 由电荷驱动或带电的
words.origin: 新拉丁语 electricus（像琥珀一样能吸引），来自希腊语 elektron（琥珀）
words.native_definition: using, producing, or charged with electricity
words.core_concept: driven by or carrying electric charge – 由电荷推动或自身带有电荷
words.core_image: 插头接通后，电流沿导线进入机器让它运转
examples: They bought an electric car.
The wire carries an electric current.
semantic_expansions: 电的/带电的：直接涉及电荷和电流
电动的：以电流作为运转动力

words.root_logic: electric（电的）+ -al（有关…的）→ 与电力系统、设备或电学有关的
words.origin: 英语 electric + -al；electric 最终来自希腊语 elektron（琥珀）
words.native_definition: relating to electricity, especially systems and equipment
words.core_concept: connected with systems that carry and use charge – 与传送和使用电流的系统有关
words.core_image: 墙内成束导线连接配电箱与各个插座
examples: The building needs extensive electrical repairs.
She studies electrical engineering.
semantic_expansions: 电气的/电力的：多指完整的供电系统和设备
有关电的：泛指与电现象或电学相关；electric 常直接修饰由电驱动的东西

words.root_logic: electric（电）+ -ian（专业人员）→ 安装和维修电力线路设备的人
words.origin: 英语 electrician，来自 electric；electric 最终来自希腊语 elektron（琥珀）
words.native_definition: a person trained to install and repair electrical systems
words.core_concept: a specialist who works directly with systems carrying current – 亲手处理电流线路与设备的人
words.core_image: 技术人员打开配电箱，用仪表逐根检查线路
examples: Call an electrician to inspect the wiring.
The electrician replaced the damaged cable.
semantic_expansions: 电工/电气技师：都指安装维修电力系统的人，后者更强调专业技术身份

words.root_logic: electric（电荷作用的）+ -ity（状态）→ 电荷存在、移动所形成的能量和现象
words.origin: 英语 electricity，来自 electric；electricus 原指琥珀摩擦后的吸引性质
words.native_definition: a form of energy resulting from charged particles, especially when flowing as current
words.core_concept: energy produced by the presence and movement of charge – 电荷存在和移动形成的能量
words.core_image: 开关闭合后，电荷沿导线流动，灯丝随即发亮
examples: The storm cut off the electricity.
Electricity flows through the cable.
semantic_expansions: 电/电力：可输送并驱动设备的电能
电学现象：电荷静止或移动时表现出的各种作用

words.root_logic: econom（管理资源）+ -ic → 与生产、分配和整体资源体系有关的
words.origin: 法语 économique，来自希腊语 oikonomikos；根源为 oikonomia（家政管理）
words.native_definition: relating to the production, distribution, and use of wealth and resources
words.core_concept: belonging to the system that organizes resources – 属于整个资源生产和分配体系的
words.core_image: 城市地图上，工厂、市场、家庭与资金流被线条连成一个系统
examples: The country faces serious economic problems.
Economic growth slowed this year.
semantic_expansions: 经济的/经济上的：涉及社会整体资源如何生产和分配
经济学的：涉及研究这套资源体系的学科

words.root_logic: econom（管理资源）+ -ical → 会精打细算、不浪费资源的
words.origin: 英语 economical，来自 economic；最终源自希腊语 oikonomia（家政管理）
words.native_definition: using money, time, or resources carefully without waste
words.core_concept: managing a limited supply with little waste – 把有限资源安排得够用而不浪费
words.core_image: 同样一箱燃料，这台机器安排得当，运行时间更长
examples: This small car is economical to run.
We need a more economical use of water.
semantic_expansions: 节约的/省耗的：管理资源时尽量减少浪费
经济实惠的：花费与所得安排得划算；不同于 economic 的宏观经济含义

words.root_logic: econom（管理资源）+ -ics（学科）→ 研究稀缺资源如何生产、分配和使用的学科
words.origin: 英语 economics，来自 economy；最终源自希腊语 oikonomia（家政管理）
words.native_definition: the study of how resources, goods, and services are produced and distributed
words.core_concept: the systematic study of allocating limited resources – 系统研究有限资源如何安排
words.core_image: 黑板上一边写有限预算，一边画出家庭、企业和政府之间的流动箭头
examples: She studied economics at university.
The economics of the project remain uncertain.
semantic_expansions: 经济学：研究资源生产与分配的学科
经济状况（the economics of）：某个项目的成本收益结构

words.root_logic: oiko-（家）+ nom-（管理规则）→ 原指管理一个家，后扩大为管理社会资源的整体体系
words.origin: 希腊语 oikonomia（家政管理），由 oikos（家）+ nomos（规则、管理）构成
words.native_definition: the system by which a society organizes production and resources, or careful use without waste
words.core_concept: an organized household enlarged to society – 把整个社会的资源像一个家一样安排
words.core_image: 一个巨大的家庭账本里同时记录生产、交易、收入和支出
examples: Tourism is vital to the local economy.
We must achieve greater economy in fuel use.
semantic_expansions: 经济/经济体：社会范围内组织生产和分配资源的整体
节约：回到家政管理本义，谨慎安排有限资源避免浪费

words.root_logic: ad-（到…旁边）+ voc（呼叫）+ -ate → 被叫到身旁替人发声的人
words.origin: 拉丁语 advocatus，来自 advocare（召来作援助）
words.native_definition: a person who publicly supports a cause, or to support it publicly
words.core_concept: someone called beside another person to speak in support – 被召到身边替某人发声
words.core_image: 一人面对人群陈述理由，身旁的人因此不再独自应对
examples: She is a strong advocate for equal access.
The report advocates stricter safety rules.
semantic_expansions: 倡导者/拥护者：站到某人或某事旁边替其发声的人
提倡：公开发声支持一种主张

words.root_logic: voc（声音）+ -al（有关…的）→ 与声音有关，或把意见明确说出来的
words.origin: 拉丁语 vocalis（有声音的），来自 vox（声音）
words.native_definition: relating to the voice, or expressing opinions openly
words.core_concept: using the voice so a position can be heard – 让声音清楚传到别人耳中
words.core_image: 原本安静的人走到麦克风前，把立场清楚说出
examples: The song demands strong vocal control.
Residents were vocal in their opposition.
semantic_expansions: 声音的/声乐的：直接涉及人声及其运用
直言不讳的：把意见发声说出而不保持沉默

words.root_logic: voc（召唤）+ -ation → 内心或职责发出的召唤，进而成为长期投入的职业
words.origin: 拉丁语 vocatio（召唤），来自 vocare（呼叫）
words.native_definition: a strong sense of fitness for a particular career, or that career itself
words.core_concept: a line of work that seems to call a person toward it – 某项工作像声音一样不断召人前往
words.core_image: 一条工作道路从远处亮起，像持续的呼声引人走过去
examples: Teaching became her vocation.
He felt a vocation to serve the community.
semantic_expansions: 使命感/天职：内心听见某项长期职责的召唤
职业：由这种召唤发展成持续从事的工作

words.root_logic: dis-（分开、打乱）+ turb（混乱）→ 把原有秩序搅散
words.origin: 拉丁语 disturbare：dis- + turbare（使混乱），经古法语进入英语
words.native_definition: to interrupt calm, order, or concentration
words.core_concept: stirring a settled state into disorder – 把平静稳定的状态搅乱
words.core_image: 平整水面被突然拨动，波纹向四周扩散
examples: Please do not disturb the patients.
The news disturbed her deeply.
semantic_expansions: 打扰/扰乱：打断原有的安静或秩序
使不安：把内心的稳定状态搅动起来

words.root_logic: disturb（搅乱）+ -ance（状态或事件）→ 打破平静后出现的混乱或异常
words.origin: 英语 disturbance，来自 disturb
words.native_definition: an interruption of peace or normal conditions
words.core_concept: the disorder left after calm has been stirred – 平静被搅动后留下的异常状态
words.core_image: 原本整齐的队列出现一处推挤，波动传遍全队
examples: The noise caused a serious disturbance.
Scientists detected a disturbance in the field.
semantic_expansions: 干扰：正常过程被外力搅动
骚乱：人群秩序被搅散
异常：稳定系统中出现的扰动

words.root_logic: turb（旋动）+ -ine（装置）→ 被流体推动而持续旋转的机器
words.origin: 法语 turbine，来自拉丁语 turbo（旋风、旋转物）
words.native_definition: a machine whose blades rotate when driven by a moving fluid
words.core_concept: a wheel turned by a controlled stream like a contained whirl – 流体推动叶片形成受控旋转
words.core_image: 水流冲向一圈叶片，中心轴随之快速转动
examples: Steam drives the turbine.
The wind turbine generates electricity.
semantic_expansions: 涡轮机/叶轮机：利用水、气或蒸汽的流动推动叶片旋转的装置

words.root_logic: at-（向）+ tribut（分派）→ 把原因、性质或作品归到某一方名下
words.origin: 拉丁语 attributus，来自 attribuere（分配给、归于）
words.native_definition: to regard something as caused or created by a particular source
words.core_concept: assigning a result to one named source – 把结果那一份归到特定来源名下
words.core_image: 几条原因卡片最终被放到同一个名字下面
examples: She attributes her success to persistence.
The work is attributed to a local artist.
semantic_expansions: 归因于/归属：把结果或作品分派到某个来源名下
属性：被归给某一对象的特征

words.root_logic: con-（共同）+ tribut（分派给予）→ 每个人把自己的一份交进共同之中
words.origin: 拉丁语 contribuere：con- + tribuere（共同给予）
words.native_definition: to give money, effort, ideas, or help toward a shared result
words.core_concept: giving one's assigned share into a common pool – 把自己的一份投入共同目标
words.core_image: 多人各放一块材料，中央逐渐拼成完整结构
examples: Many volunteers contributed their time.
Several factors contributed to the decline.
semantic_expansions: 贡献/捐助：把自己的资源份额交给共同目标
促成：某个因素把自己的一份作用加入最终结果

words.root_logic: dis-（分开、向各处）+ tribut（分派）→ 把整体拆成份额送到各方
words.origin: 拉丁语 distribuere：dis- + tribuere（分开分配）
words.native_definition: to give or spread portions among people or places
words.core_concept: dividing a whole into shares and sending each outward – 把整体分成多份向外送出
words.core_image: 一摞资料被逐份递到房间里每个人手中
examples: Workers distributed food to the crowd.
The species is widely distributed.
semantic_expansions: 分发/分配：把整体按份额交给不同对象
分布：许多份散到不同地点后形成的状态

words.root_logic: dis-（分离、偏离）+ tort（扭）→ 把原形或原意扭离正确位置
words.origin: 拉丁语 distortus，来自 distorquere（扭向一边）
words.native_definition: to twist the shape, sound, facts, or meaning away from accuracy
words.core_concept: twisting something away from its true line – 把形状或信息拧离真实轨道
words.core_image: 一条笔直网格被拉扯后弯曲，图像随之走样
examples: The lens distorted the image.
Do not distort what she said.
semantic_expansions: 扭曲/使变形：物体被拧离原形
歪曲：事实或原意被拧离真实含义

words.root_logic: re-（向回）+ tort（扭）→ 把对方的话拧转回去，形成尖锐回应
words.origin: 拉丁语 retortus，来自 retorquere（扭回、投回）
words.native_definition: to reply quickly and sharply, or a vessel with a curved neck
words.core_concept: turning an attack back toward its source – 把来势迅速扭回发出者方向
words.core_image: 一支射来的箭被弯曲挡板弹转回去
examples: She retorted that the claim was unfair.
The liquid was heated in a glass retort.
semantic_expansions: 反驳/回嘴：把对方的话锋扭转回去
曲颈甑：蒸馏容器的颈部弯转，使蒸气改向

words.root_logic: tort（扭）+ -ure → 原指扭曲身体施加痛苦，后泛指极端折磨
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 tortura（扭曲、折磨），来自 torquere（扭）
words.native_definition: the deliberate infliction of severe pain, or extreme suffering
words.core_concept: pain produced as if the body or mind were being twisted – 身体或内心像被持续拧紧
words.core_image: 绳索被一点点收紧，承受者无法摆脱压力
examples: The treaty prohibits torture.
The long uncertainty was torture for the family.
semantic_expansions: 酷刑：通过强力扭压身体制造剧痛
折磨/使受煎熬：痛苦像持续拧紧一样无法停止

words.root_logic: toler（承受）+ -ance（能力或状态）→ 面对差异、压力或剂量仍能承受的范围
words.origin: 拉丁语 tolerantia（忍耐），来自 tolerare
words.native_definition: the ability or willingness to accept difference, pain, or adverse conditions
words.core_concept: the range of burden that can be borne without failure – 在不崩溃前可以承住的范围
words.core_image: 秤盘不断加码，支架仍保持稳定
examples: A healthy society requires tolerance.
The material has a high heat tolerance.
semantic_expansions: 容忍：承受与自己不同的人或观点
耐受性：身体或材料承住刺激的能力
公差：尺寸允许承受的偏差范围

words.root_logic: toler（承受）+ -ant（具有…性质的）→ 能承受差异或不利条件的
words.origin: 拉丁语 tolerans，tolerare（承受）的现在分词
words.native_definition: willing to accept differences, or able to withstand conditions
words.core_concept: able to carry difference or stress without reacting destructively – 承住差异或压力而不失稳
words.core_image: 不同颜色的积木放在同一平台上，平台仍稳稳托住全部
examples: They are tolerant of opposing views.
This plant is tolerant of drought.
semantic_expansions: 宽容的：能承受观点和生活方式的差异
耐受的：能承受干旱、温度等不利条件

words.root_logic: toler（承受）+ -ate → 把不舒服或不同之处扛住而不阻止
words.origin: 拉丁语 tolerare（承受、忍耐）
words.native_definition: to allow something disliked or withstand an adverse condition
words.core_concept: continuing to bear something unpleasant without collapse or removal – 面对不适仍把它承住
words.core_image: 机器在持续震动中运转，结构没有断裂
examples: The school will not tolerate bullying.
Some crops tolerate salty soil.
semantic_expansions: 容忍/忍受：面对不喜欢的行为或感受仍承受下来
耐受：生物或材料在不利条件下仍维持功能

words.root_logic: hypo-（在下方）+ thesis（放置）→ 先放在论证底下作为待验证的基础
words.origin: 希腊语 hypothesis（基础、假定）：hypo- + thesis
words.native_definition: an explanation proposed for testing
words.core_concept: an idea placed underneath an investigation as its starting support – 先垫在调查下面等待验证的解释
words.core_image: 实验开始前，一张暂定说明被放在证据板最底层
examples: The experiment tests the hypothesis.
They proposed a new hypothesis about climate change.
semantic_expansions: 假设/假说：暂时放在研究底部、等待证据检验的解释

words.root_logic: syn-（共同）+ thesis（放置）→ 把多个部分放到一起形成整体
words.origin: 希腊语 synthesis：syn- + thesis（共同放置）
words.native_definition: the combination of parts or ideas into a connected whole
words.core_concept: placing separate pieces together until one whole emerges – 把分散部分共同放成整体
words.core_image: 几张不同颜色的碎片被拼到一起，中央出现完整图案
examples: The essay offers a synthesis of several theories.
The drug is produced by chemical synthesis.
semantic_expansions: 综合：把不同观点共同放进一个整体
合成：把不同物质组合成新整体
结合体：共同放置后形成的结果

words.root_logic: thesis（放置、命题）→ 正式放出来供论证的主张或研究成果
words.origin: 希腊语 thesis（放置、命题），经拉丁语进入英语
words.native_definition: a central proposition or a long research paper supporting one
words.core_concept: a claim set down to be defended with evidence – 放到台面上并用证据支撑的主张
words.core_image: 一张核心主张放在中央，周围证据用线与它相连
examples: Her thesis challenges the standard account.
He completed his doctoral thesis.
semantic_expansions: 论点/命题：正式放出并准备论证的主张
论文：围绕一个核心主张组织证据的长篇研究

words.root_logic: integr（完整）+ -al → 属于整体且不可缺少的
words.origin: 拉丁语 integralis（构成整体的），来自 integer（完整）
words.native_definition: necessary to make a whole complete, or forming a whole
words.core_concept: a part whose removal would break the whole – 一旦拿走整体就出现缺口的部分
words.core_image: 齿轮组中一枚关键齿轮与其余部分严密咬合
examples: Trust is integral to the partnership.
The machine has an integral control unit.
semantic_expansions: 不可或缺的：少了它整体便不完整
完整的：作为一个整体内置形成
积分的：数学中把微小部分重新合成整体量

words.root_logic: integr（完整）+ -ate → 使分开的部分进入一个完整整体
words.origin: 拉丁语 integrare（使完整、恢复），来自 integer
words.native_definition: to combine parts into a whole or bring people fully into a group
words.core_concept: making separated parts function as one intact whole – 让分散部分合成无缺口的整体
words.core_image: 几个独立模块接上接口后开始像一台机器共同运转
examples: The platform integrates several services.
New students quickly integrated into the group.
semantic_expansions: 整合/使一体化：把分散部分接成完整系统
融入：让个体进入群体并成为其中完整一部分

words.root_logic: integr（完整）+ -ity（状态）→ 结构没有破损，或人格没有被利益切走一块
words.origin: 拉丁语 integritas（完整、纯正），来自 integer
words.native_definition: structural wholeness or firm adherence to moral principles
words.core_concept: remaining whole under pressure, physically or morally – 面对压力仍不破裂、不缺失
words.core_image: 密封结构经受冲击后仍无裂缝，内部也没有泄漏
examples: Engineers checked the bridge's structural integrity.
She acted with integrity.
semantic_expansions: 完整性：结构在压力下仍保持无缺口
正直/诚实：原则没有被诱因削掉一部分

words.root_logic: com-（共同）+ memor（记住）+ -ate → 大家一起把某事留在记忆中
words.origin: 拉丁语 commemorare（提醒、纪念）：com- + memorare
words.native_definition: to honor and remember an important person or event
words.core_concept: keeping an event present in shared memory – 让一件事持续留在众人的共同记忆里
words.core_image: 人群围在一块刻有日期的石碑旁，安静回望过去
examples: The ceremony commemorates those who died.
A plaque commemorates the discovery.
semantic_expansions: 纪念：通过仪式或标志让重要的人与事留在共同记忆中
庆祝：以公开活动记住值得欢庆的事件

words.root_logic: memor（记住）+ -ial（有关…的）→ 专门帮助人把过去留在心中的标志
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 memoriale（纪念物），来自 memoria
words.native_definition: something created to preserve the memory of a person or event
words.core_concept: a visible object that keeps an absent past present – 用可见标志把已经离开的过去留下
words.core_image: 广场中央立着刻名石碑，经过的人停步阅读
examples: They built a memorial beside the river.
A memorial service was held on Sunday.
semantic_expansions: 纪念碑/纪念物：帮助后人持续想起过去的实体标志
追悼的：用于共同记住逝者的

words.root_logic: memor（记住）+ -y → 心中保存并可再次调出的过去内容或能力
words.origin: 拉丁语 memoria（记忆），来自 memor（记得的）
words.native_definition: the ability to retain information or something remembered
words.core_concept: a past scene kept available inside the mind – 被心智保存、之后还能调出的场景
words.core_image: 关闭的相册重新翻开，旧画面再次清晰出现
examples: The experience remains vivid in my memory.
The computer needs more memory.
semantic_expansions: 记忆力：把信息留在心中的能力
回忆：被保存并再次调出的内容
存储器：机器中承担类似留存功能的部件

words.root_logic: mechan（机器装置）+ -ic（从事者）→ 处理机器结构与运转的人
words.origin: 希腊语 mēkhanikos（与机器有关的），经拉丁语和法语进入英语
words.native_definition: a person who repairs and maintains machines
words.core_concept: someone who understands how a device's parts produce motion – 看懂各部件如何传力并修复它的人
words.core_image: 工作台上摊开齿轮和螺栓，一双手逐件检查磨损
examples: The mechanic inspected the engine.
A bicycle mechanic replaced the chain.
semantic_expansions: 机械师/修理工：理解机器部件并维护其运转的人

words.root_logic: mechan（机器）+ -ical（有关…的）→ 属于机器运转，或像机器一样不经思考重复
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 mechanicus，来自希腊语 mēkhanikos
words.native_definition: relating to machines, or performed automatically without thought
words.core_concept: working through fixed moving parts or fixed repetition – 按预定结构和动作运转
words.core_image: 齿轮每转一圈，连杆都按同一路径重复升降
examples: The device suffered a mechanical failure.
His response sounded mechanical.
semantic_expansions: 机械的：由机器部件和传力结构完成的
机械性的/呆板的：像固定装置一样重复而缺少灵活判断

words.root_logic: mechan（装置）+ -ism（体系）→ 各部件配合产生结果的内部系统
words.origin: 新拉丁语 mechanismus，来自希腊语 mēkhanē
words.native_definition: a system of parts or processes that produces a result
words.core_concept: the hidden arrangement through which inputs become an outcome – 输入沿内部结构传递并产生结果
words.core_image: 透明外壳内，多枚齿轮依次咬合带动末端指针
examples: The locking mechanism is simple.
Researchers studied the mechanism of infection.
semantic_expansions: 机械装置：实体部件配合运转的系统
机制/机理：任何过程内部使结果发生的连锁结构

words.root_logic: graph（写、画）→ 用线和位置把数量关系画出来的记录
words.origin: 希腊语 graphē（书写、图画），来自 graphein
words.native_definition: a diagram showing relationships between quantities
words.core_concept: quantities written as positions and lines on a surface – 数量被写成平面上的点和线
words.core_image: 坐标纸上的数据点被一条上升曲线连接
examples: The graph shows a steady increase.
Plot the results on a graph.
semantic_expansions: 图表/曲线图：把数量关系刻写成位置和线条
绘图：把数据记录到图形表面上的动作

words.root_logic: graph（画、写）+ -ic → 通过清楚图形呈现，或描写得像画在眼前
words.origin: 希腊语 graphikos（适于书写或绘画的），来自 graphein
words.native_definition: relating to visual images, or described in vivid detail
words.core_concept: presented in marks vivid enough to be seen mentally – 用线条或细节呈现得清晰可见
words.core_image: 文字旁边出现一幅轮廓鲜明的示意图，信息一眼可辨
examples: The report includes graphic illustrations.
The witness gave a graphic account.
semantic_expansions: 图形的：以可见线条和图像呈现
生动的/详细露骨的：描述清晰得像直接画在眼前

words.root_logic: para-（旁边）+ graph（写）→ 原指写在旁边的段落标记，后指由该标记分出的文字块
words.origin: 希腊语 paragraphos（写在旁边的标记），经拉丁语进入英语
words.native_definition: a distinct section of written text dealing with one point
words.core_concept: a block of writing marked off as one unit – 被边界标出、集中表达一点的文字块
words.core_image: 长篇文字中一次换行缩进，圈出一个独立内容单元
examples: Each paragraph develops one idea.
Please divide the text into paragraphs.
semantic_expansions: 段落：被标记边界分开的一个书写单元
分段符号：早期写在行旁、提示新单元开始的记号

words.root_logic: im-（压入）+ press（压）+ -ion → 外物压入心中留下的痕迹
words.origin: 拉丁语 impressio（压入、印痕），来自 imprimere
words.native_definition: an idea or effect formed in the mind, or a mark pressed into a surface
words.core_concept: a mark left after something presses inward – 接触之后被压留下来的痕迹
words.core_image: 软蜡被印章压下，抬起后仍保留清晰纹路
examples: She made a strong first impression.
The seal left an impression in the wax.
semantic_expansions: 印象：经历压入心中留下的整体痕迹
印记：物体受压后留下的形状
印数：印刷版被反复压印出的数量

words.root_logic: impress（压入、留下印象）+ -ive → 强到能深深压进人心的
words.origin: 英语 impressive，来自 impress
words.native_definition: causing admiration through size, quality, or skill
words.core_concept: powerful enough to leave a deep mental mark – 力量或品质深深压入心中
words.core_image: 宏大的建筑立在眼前，轮廓久久留在观看者脑中
examples: The team achieved an impressive result.
The building is visually impressive.
semantic_expansions: 令人印象深刻的/令人钦佩的：效果强到在人心中留下深刻压痕

words.root_logic: con-（共同、在内）+ tain（握住）+ -er → 把内容物收在内部握住的东西
words.origin: 英语 contain + -er；contain 来自拉丁语 continere
words.native_definition: an object used to hold or transport things
words.core_concept: an enclosure that holds contents together inside – 把内容集中握在内部的外壳
words.core_image: 透明盒子的四壁把散落零件稳稳收在里面
examples: Store the liquid in a sealed container.
The goods arrived in a shipping container.
semantic_expansions: 容器：把物品收在内部的器具
集装箱：用于运输、把大量货物集中握住的标准箱体

words.root_logic: ten（握住、占有）+ -ant（人）→ 依法握有房屋使用权的人
words.origin: 古法语 tenant（持有者），来自拉丁语 tenere（握住）
words.native_definition: a person who rents and occupies property
words.core_concept: someone who holds the right to occupy a place for a period – 在约定时期握有空间使用权的人
words.core_image: 钥匙被交到入住者手中，在租期内由其保管房屋
examples: The tenant pays rent monthly.
Landlords must protect tenant rights.
semantic_expansions: 租户/承租人：通过租约暂时握有房屋使用权的人

words.root_logic: con-（加强、完全）+ quest（寻求）→ 追索到底并取得控制
words.origin: 古法语 conqueste，来自拉丁语 conquirere（搜求、取得）
words.native_definition: the act of taking control by force, or something won
words.core_concept: a search pursued until the object is taken into one's control – 追求直到目标被取得并控制
words.core_image: 旗帜越过城墙，寻找的领地被纳入控制范围
examples: The conquest changed the region's borders.
The island became a colonial conquest.
semantic_expansions: 征服/攻取：追索目标直到取得控制
战利品：完成这种取得后落入手中的东西

words.root_logic: en-（进入）+ quir（寻求）→ 通过提问深入寻找信息
words.origin: 古法语 enquérir，来自拉丁语 inquirere（寻求、调查）
words.native_definition: to ask for information
words.core_concept: seeking one's way into missing information through questions – 用问题进入未知处寻找答案
words.core_image: 一个问号沿着线索深入档案，逐格照亮空白
examples: I called to enquire about the schedule.
Police enquired into the complaint.
semantic_expansions: 询问/打听：通过提问寻找缺少的信息
调查：沿线索深入寻找事实

words.root_logic: ex-（彻底、向外）+ quisit（寻求）→ 被精挑细选出来的 → 极精美的
words.origin: 拉丁语 exquisitus，来自 exquirere（仔细搜寻、挑选）
words.native_definition: extremely beautiful, delicate, or finely made
words.core_concept: selected through an exceptionally careful search – 经过细密寻找才挑出的上乘之物
words.core_image: 许多近似样品中，一件细节最完美的被单独取出
examples: The box contains exquisite carvings.
She felt exquisite pain in her hand.
semantic_expansions: 精美的/精致的：像经过彻底搜选才留下的上品
剧烈的：感觉细密而强烈到每一点都清晰可辨

words.root_logic: not（做记号）+ -able → 值得被单独做记号记下的
words.origin: 拉丁语 notabilis（值得注意的），来自 notare（做记号）
words.native_definition: worthy of attention or being remembered
words.core_concept: marked out enough to be worth special notice – 被特别标注出来、值得关注的
words.core_image: 人群中一个身影被光标单独圈出，让人记住
examples: The meeting produced a notable breakthrough.
She is a notable figure in the field.
semantic_expansions: 值得注意的/显著的：重要到值得单独做记号
著名的：因突出而被众人记住

words.root_logic: not（记号）+ -ify（使）→ 把一个记号/消息送到某人面前让他知道
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 notificare（使知道），来自 notare＋facere
words.native_definition: to formally tell someone about something
words.core_concept: bringing a marked message to someone so it becomes known – 把做了记号的信息送到某人眼前
words.core_image: 一封盖着红印章、写着明确消息的信被递到收件人手上
examples: Please notify us of any change of address.
The system notifies users of updates.
semantic_expansions: 通知/告知：把信息正式送到某人面前使其知晓

words.root_logic: not（记号）+ -ion → 心中形成的记号，即一个想法或概念
words.origin: 拉丁语 notio（认识、概念），来自 notus（知道的）
words.native_definition: an idea, belief, or vague understanding
words.core_concept: a mark formed in the mind that stands for an idea – 在脑中成形的、代表某个想法的记号
words.core_image: 一个念头像发光的标签在脑海里亮起
examples: She rejected the notion of fate.
I have no notion of what he means.
semantic_expansions: 概念/观念：心中代表某种理解而成立的记号
想法：脑中浮现的、尚未成形的认识

words.root_logic: not（记号）+ -orious → 被广泛做了记号、名声传开的（多带贬义）
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 notorius（尽人皆知的），来自 notus（被知道的）
words.native_definition: famous for something bad
words.core_concept: marked so widely that everyone knows the name – 被处处标注、名声尽人皆知
words.core_image: 一栋建筑的名字反复出现在负面报道的标题上
examples: The city is notorious for traffic jams.
He is a notorious liar.
semantic_expansions: 臭名昭著的：因负面事情名声广为人知

words.root_logic: oper（工作）+ -ate → 让机器或组织进入工作状态
words.origin: 拉丁语 operatus，来自 operari（劳作、工作）
words.native_definition: to control a machine, run a system, or be in working condition
words.core_concept: bringing parts together so a whole begins producing work – 让各部分配合开始产出结果
words.core_image: 驾驶舱里的手推动手柄，整台装置随之启动
examples: She operates the crane safely.
The hospital operates a 24-hour clinic.
semantic_expansions: 操作：控制机器使其按规程工作
运转/经营：系统或组织持续发挥功能

words.root_logic: oper（工作）+ -ation → 使系统工作的过程、活动或手术
words.origin: 拉丁语 operatio（劳作、活动），来自 operari
words.native_definition: the process of working, an organized action, or a medical procedure
words.core_concept: getting parts to cooperate and produce, including the body during surgery – 让部件配合产出结果的一次过程
words.core_image: 一套流程启动，从投入逐步走到产出
examples: The new line is now in operation.
The patient was prepared for operation.
semantic_expansions: 操作/运作：系统投入工作的过程
手术：医生在病人身体上进行的专门操作

words.root_logic: operation（运作）+ -al → 能够执行作业的，或与实际运作有关的
words.origin: 英语 operational，来自 operation
words.native_definition: working and ready to be used, or relating to practical functioning
words.core_concept: able to be put to work now – 此刻就能投入工作的
words.core_image: 指示灯亮起，表示整套系统已就绪可运转
examples: The plant is fully operational again.
We need an operational plan for the launch.
semantic_expansions: 可操作的/运行中的：系统当前能正常执行任务
实际运作的：与执行层面的具体工作有关

words.root_logic: dign（值得）+ -ity（状态）→ 值得尊重并把持住的自身价值
words.origin: 拉丁语 dignitas（尊严、地位），来自 dignus（值得的）
words.native_definition: the state of being worthy of respect, or calm self-respect
words.core_concept: the worth that proves one deserves respect – 经得起检验、配得上尊重的那份价值
words.core_image: 一个人挺直站立，肩头托着的重量与所得尊重相称
examples: She faced the crowd with dignity.
Every person deserves to be treated with dignity.
semantic_expansions: 尊严：证明自己值得被尊重的那份价值
庄重：以稳定姿态撑住这份价值

words.root_logic: in-（不、反对）+ dign（配得上）+ -ant → 因觉得受了不相配的对待而愤怒
words.origin: 拉丁语 indignans（愤愤不平的），来自 indignari（认为不配）
words.native_definition: angry because of unjust or unworthy treatment
words.core_concept: feeling that something is beneath one and thus wrong – 感到被按不配的身价对待而激起愤怒
words.core_image: 一个人自认高出所受待遇，胸口腾起不平之气
examples: She was indignant at the false accusation.
Citizens grew indignant over the unfair tax.
semantic_expansions: 愤慨的/义愤的：因遭遇不相配、不公正的对待而愤怒

words.root_logic: indignant（愤慨）+ -ation → 因不公或轻视而产生的愤怒情绪
words.origin: 拉丁语 indignatio（愤懑），来自 indignari
words.native_definition: anger caused by unworthy or unjust treatment
words.core_concept: the flame kindled when one is treated as beneath one's worth – 被按低劣身价对待时腾起的怒火
words.core_image: 被轻视者胸口涌起的怒火几乎可见
examples: The unfair dismissal caused general indignation.
He reported the news with indignation.
semantic_expansions: 愤慨/义愤：因受到不相配的轻视或不公而生的强烈不满

words.root_logic: ordin（次序）+ -ary（属于…的）→ 依通常次序而来、不越出常规的
words.origin: 拉丁语 ordinarius（按次序的），来自 ordo（次序）
words.native_definition: normal and not special in any way
words.core_concept: following the usual rank and line, nothing extra – 顺着常规次序、没有超出
words.core_image: 一摞日用品按平常位置摆放，没有任何特别标记
examples: In an ordinary year we plant in spring.
The film turned an ordinary story into something moving.
semantic_expansions: 普通的/平常的：顺着通常次序、不特别
平庸的：缺少超出常规的突出点

words.root_logic: co-（共同）+ ordin（次序）+ -ate → 让多方按共同次序配合行动
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 coordinare（共同排列），来自 ordinare
words.native_definition: to organize different parts so they work together
words.core_concept: putting separate pieces into one shared order so they move as one – 把分散部分排进同一次序协同运作
words.core_image: 几个团队接到同一张时间表，动作因此合到同一节奏
examples: She coordinates the volunteers across three sites.
The rescue teams coordinated their efforts.
semantic_expansions: 协调/配合：把不同部分排进共同次序
使一致：让各方步调对齐

words.root_logic: sub-（在下）+ ordin（次序）→ 排在主序之下、位居从属
words.origin: 拉丁语 subordinatus，来自 subordinare（置于下位）
words.native_definition: lower in rank or position, or a person in such a rank
words.core_concept: placed under the main order – 被排在主序列之下
words.core_image: 一人站在阶梯较下一级，听命于更高位置者的安排
examples: The chief delegate delegated tasks to her subordinates.
Safety is subordinate to the deadline in his logic.
semantic_expansions: 从属的/次要的：排在主序之下
下级：职位处于从属序列的人员

words.root_logic: solid（坚实）→ 质地密实、无空隙，或可靠
words.origin: 拉丁语 solidus（坚实的）
words.native_definition: firm, dense, reliable, and without gaps
words.core_concept: a body with no hollow inside that will not yield to pressure – 内部无空隙、受压力不塌陷
words.core_image: 一块整木被重物压住仍棱角分明，没有变形
examples: The table is made of solid oak.
The proposal rests on solid evidence.
semantic_expansions: 固体的/坚实的：质地密实无空隙
可靠的：像实心结构一样经得起压力

words.root_logic: con-（共同）+ solid（坚实）→ 使分散部分凝成一块坚实整体
words.origin: 拉丁语 consolidare（使牢固）：con- + solidare
words.native_definition: to combine into a stronger whole or make more secure
words.core_concept: pressing separate pieces until they become one solid mass – 让分散部分挤成无空隙的整体
words.core_image: 几处松散的土堆被压成一片结实的路基
examples: The firm consolidated several departments.
Sleep helps consolidate memory.
semantic_expansions: 合并：把分散部分合成一个坚实整体
巩固：让结构或成果变得更牢固

words.root_logic: solid（坚实）+ -arity（状态）→ 众人像一块整体那样彼此支撑
words.origin: 法语 solidarité，来自 solidaire（连带的）
words.native_definition: unity of feeling and support within a group
words.core_concept: a group standing as one dense body where each supports the rest – 大家合成一块整体彼此担当
words.core_image: 许多人并肩站成一面墙，一人受力众人都顶住
examples: Workers showed solidarity during the strike.
We stand in solidarity with the community.
semantic_expansions: 团结/相互支持：众人如一体般彼此坚实支撑

words.root_logic: terr（惊惧）+ -ible（可…的）→ 让人感到惊惧的，或程度极严重
words.origin: 拉丁语 terribilis（可怕的），来自 terrere
words.native_definition: extremely bad, harmful, or causing great fear
words.core_concept: so bad that it overwhelms and frightens – 坏到把人镇住
words.core_image: 一场灾难的场面铺满视野，任何抵抗都显得无力
examples: The storm caused terrible damage.
I had a terrible night's sleep.
semantic_expansions: 可怕的：引发强烈恐惧
严重/糟糕的：坏到接近令人害怕的程度

words.root_logic: terr（惊惧）+ -ify（使）→ 使人充满恐惧
words.origin: 法语 terrifier，来自拉丁语 terrificare
words.native_definition: to make someone feel intense fear
words.core_concept: pouring fear into someone until they freeze – 让恐惧充满一个人直到僵住
words.core_image: 黑影从角落逼近，被看者瞬间屏住呼吸
examples: The loud bang terrified the child.
She was terrified of heights.
semantic_expansions: 使恐惧/使惊吓：用巨大威胁让人充满恐惧

words.root_logic: terr（惊惧）+ -or（名词）→ 极端剧烈的恐惧
words.origin: 拉丁语 terror（惊恐），来自 terrere
words.native_definition: extreme fear, or violence meant to spread such fear
words.core_concept: the frozen state produced by a force too big to face – 面对无法抵挡之物时被镇住的状态
words.core_image: 城市突然笼罩在一种让人无法入睡的惊恐中
examples: The crowd fled in terror.
The group used terror to control the town.
semantic_expansions: 恐怖/惊骇：极端剧烈的恐惧
恐怖行为：以制造恐惧为手段的暴力

words.root_logic: dis-（分开、打散）+ rupt（断裂）→ 打断正常运行
words.origin: 拉丁语 disruptus，来自 disrumpere（裂开、打断）
words.native_definition: to interrupt or throw something out of its normal course
words.core_concept: breaking the continuity of a running system – 把正运行的过程从中间打断
words.core_image: 正在亮起的长串灯忽然断掉几盏，节奏被打乱
examples: Flights were disrupted by the storm.
The protest disrupted traffic.
semantic_expansions: 扰乱/打断：使正常运行从中间断开
中断：使连续性暂时或永久停止

words.root_logic: ab-（离开）+ rupt（断裂）→ 像被硬生生掐断、缺乏过渡
words.origin: 拉丁语 abruptus（断裂的），来自 abrumpere（切断）
words.native_definition: sudden, unexpected, and lacking smooth transition
words.core_concept: cut off sharply without the usual lead-in – 没有过渡就硬生生断掉
words.core_image: 一条平整的山路走到底突然断成悬崖边缘
examples: The meeting came to an abrupt end.
His tone was abrupt and cold.
semantic_expansions: 突然的/生硬的：像被硬生生断开、缺少过渡
陡峭的：地形如断裂般骤然下降

words.root_logic: cor-（完全）+ rupt（断裂）→ 使原本正直的东西整体腐坏变形
words.origin: 拉丁语 corruptus，来自 corrumpere（败坏）
words.native_definition: dishonest or morally decayed, or data that has been damaged
words.core_concept: breaking down a sound whole, morally or materially – 把一个完好整体从内部败坏
words.core_image: 原本明亮的证书被墨渍和篡改弄得形状歪曲
examples: Corrupt officials were removed from office.
The file was corrupt and could not be opened.
semantic_expansions: 腐败的/腐化的：整体从内部败坏
损坏的：数据或物品被破坏到无法正常用

words.root_logic: sum（总数）→ 若干部分加在一起得到的总量
words.origin: 拉丁语 summa（总数、顶端）
words.native_definition: the total amount from adding parts, or an amount of money
words.core_concept: the top result reached when all parts are piled together – 各部分相加后处于顶端的那个总值
words.core_image: 一叠小账单被整齐相加，顶端得出一个数字
examples: The sum of the parts equals the whole.
He paid a large sum for the house.
semantic_expansions: 总和：各部分组成的总量
金额：一笔具体数额的钱

words.root_logic: summary（概要）+ -ize（使）→ 把大量内容收拢成一段简短总说
words.origin: 英语 summarize，来自 summary
words.native_definition: to state the main points briefly
words.core_concept: gathering a long account into a single top-line statement – 把长内容收拢成顶端的简要概括
words.core_image: 成堆文字被压成一行要点，整齐排在顶部
examples: Summarize the key findings in two sentences.
The report summarizes five years of data.
semantic_expansions: 总结/概括：把大量内容收拢成简短的要点

words.root_logic: sum（总数）+ -mary → 把内容汇总成简短整体
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 summarius（概要的），来自 summa（总数）
words.native_definition: a brief statement of the main points
words.core_concept: the compact total of a longer account – 长内容汇总出的简短总体
words.core_image: 一本书的末页浓缩了全部章节的要点
examples: Each chapter ends with a summary.
She gave a brief summary of the case.
semantic_expansions: 摘要/概要：把完整内容浓缩成的简要总体

words.root_logic: fin（终结、结清）+ -ance → 与清偿/资金结算有关的事务
words.origin: 中古法语 finance（结算），来自 finer（终结、清账）
words.native_definition: the management of money, or money provided for a purpose
words.core_concept: the money side of seeing a matter through to its end – 把事项推进到收尾时的资金支撑
words.core_image: 一张建造计划下方垫着一层钱物，支撑它进行到完工
examples: She studied finance at university.
The project needs public finance.
semantic_expansions: 金融/财政：围绕资金收付与管理的事务
资金：支撑事项完成所需的款项

words.root_logic: com-（共同）+ part（部分）+ -ment → 大空间被划分出的一个部分
words.origin: 法语 compartiment，来自 compartir（分割）
words.native_definition: a separate section, often given a specific use
words.core_concept: one divided-out pocket inside a larger whole – 大整体中切分出的一块空位
words.core_image: 列车长椅上方被隔板分成一个个独立空间
examples: The fridge has a separate compartment for vegetables.
Her bag has a hidden compartment.
semantic_expansions: 隔间/车厢：大空间中被划分出的独立部分

words.root_logic: counter-（对应、对照）+ part（部分）→ 与某部分相对称的对应部分
words.origin: 英语 counterpart，来自 counter ＋ part
words.native_definition: a person or thing that corresponds to another in position or function
words.core_concept: the matching part standing opposite across a shared scheme – 在共同结构中与一方成对的另一半
words.core_image: 谈判桌两边各坐一人，职位一一对应
examples: The US secretary met his British counterpart.
This gear is the counterpart of that one.
semantic_expansions: 对应的人/物：在共同结构中与另一方地位、功能相对的部分

words.root_logic: per-（贯穿）+ pet（追求）+ -ual → 一直向前追着不停，没有终止
words.origin: 拉丁语 perpetuus（连续的），可能与 per＋petere 相关
words.native_definition: continuing forever, or seeming to never end
words.core_concept: stretching forward without a breaking point – 一路向前不断开
words.core_image: 一条线向前延展到望不见尽头的位置
examples: The clock is driven by a near-perpetual motion.
He complained about the perpetual noise.
semantic_expansions: 永恒的/永久的：向前不断开、没有终止
不断的：持续发生而看上去无尽头

words.root_logic: ad-（靠向）+ ject（投掷）→ 原意“加靠到名词旁的词”
words.origin: 拉丁语 adjectivum（附加的词），来自 adjicere（添加）
words.native_definition: a word that modifies a noun by adding a quality
words.core_concept: a word thrown alongside a noun to add description – 投过去依附在名词旁起修饰作用的词
words.core_image: “blue”被放到“sky”旁边，天空的颜色就此明确
examples: In English, adjectives usually precede the noun.
The adjective modifies the noun.
semantic_expansions: 形容词：投放到名词旁、为其添加描述的词

words.root_logic: direct（指引）+ -ory（场所）→ 用来指引人找到对象的名册或路径组织
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 directorium（指引的书册），来自 dirigere（指引）
words.native_definition: a listing of names or files used to find things
words.core_concept: an organized place that points one toward the sought item – 帮你指向目标所在的编排
words.core_image: 大厅里的名册按姓氏排列，一翻就能指向对应房间
examples: Please check the directory for the extension.
Save the file into a new directory.
semantic_expansions: 名录/目录：按规则编排、指引人找到对象的集合
文件夹：计算机中指向并组织文件的位置

words.root_logic: firm（坚固）→ 牢固不移、确定的
words.origin: 拉丁语 firmus（坚固的、结实的）
words.native_definition: steady, resolute, and not easily moved or changed
words.core_concept: set so solidly it will not strain or shift – 安放得结实坚固、不松动不移位
words.core_image: 一根桩子被深深钉进地面，推上去只是更稳
examples: She kept a firm hold on the rope.
The manager gave a firm answer.
semantic_expansions: 坚固的：质地坚实不松动
坚决的：立场笃定不打折扣
公司：英文重新借回 firm 作营业实体

words.root_logic: af-（ad- 靠向）+ firm（坚固）→ 把话坚定地确认下来
words.origin: 拉丁语 affirmare（使确定），来自 ad＋firmare
words.native_definition: to state positively that something is true
words.core_concept: pressing a claim until it stands solid – 把一句话说到坚硬稳固、坐实为真
words.core_image: 某人的表态被重重按下，像盖章一样坐实
examples: The witness affirmed the account.
She affirmed her support for the plan.
semantic_expansions: 断言/确认：把说法坚定地说到坐实为真

words.root_logic: con-（完全）+ firm（坚固）→ 使原先的话头被完全坐实
words.origin: 拉丁语 confirmare（加强确认），来自 con＋firmare
words.native_definition: to show that something is true, certain, or definite
words.core_concept: settling a suspicion into a fixed fact – 把尚不确定的事坐实为定局
words.core_image: 机票座位号得到第二处核对，原先的犹豫落了地
examples: The test confirmed the diagnosis.
Please confirm your attendance by Friday.
semantic_expansions: 证实/确认：使不确定之事坐实为确定事实

words.root_logic: an-（ad- 靠向）+ nounce（通告）→ 把消息正式说到众人面前
words.origin: 拉丁语 annuntiare（宣告），来自 ad＋nuntiare
words.native_definition: to make something known publicly and formally
words.core_concept: bringing a piece of news to the crowd's attention – 把一则消息正式送达众人面前
words.core_image: 主持人上台，向全场公开念出那条新消息
examples: The company announced a new product.
They announced the winner last night.
semantic_expansions: 宣布/公布：把消息正式公开告知众人

words.root_logic: de-（向下、出）+ nounce（通告）→ 当众公开谴责、斥责
words.origin: 拉丁语 denuntiare（正式告知、谴责）
words.native_definition: to publicly condemn or strongly criticize
words.core_concept: speaking a public farewell of blame against someone – 当众发布对某人的公开谴责
words.core_image: 发言人站在人前，把某种丑行当众指认出来
examples: The mayor denounced the violence.
Critics denounced the new policy.
semantic_expansions: 谴责/公开指责：当众批判某种言行

words.root_logic: pro-（向前）+ nounce（通告）→ 把音从往前送出来正式说清
words.origin: 拉丁语 pronuntiare（宣读出、说出）
words.native_definition: to speak a word with its proper sound, or declare officially
words.core_concept: pushing a sound out to the front so it is clearly heard – 把音节向前送出、让人听清
words.core_image: 舌尖把每个音节推到前面，清清楚楚念出来
examples: How do you pronounce this word?
The judge pronounced the sentence.
semantic_expansions: 发音：把语音正确地念出来
宣判/宣布：正式说出具有效力的结论

words.root_logic: cour（心）+ -age → 把心放进胸膛去面对凶险的一种力量
words.origin: 法语 courage，来自 cœur（心）
words.native_definition: the ability to face danger or difficulty without giving in
words.core_concept: the strength one draws from the heart when pressure mounts – 压力压顶时从心里提出的那股劲
words.core_image: 一个人在威胁面前按住心跳，仍朝前迈出一步
examples: It took great courage to speak up.
Soldiers fought with courage.
semantic_expansions: 勇气/胆量：面对凶险时内心撑起的力量

words.root_logic: en-（使进入）+ courage（勇气）→ 使勇气注入人心中
words.origin: 法语 encourager，来自 en＋courage
words.native_definition: to give someone confidence or support to do something
words.core_concept: pouring courage into another's heart so they dare – 把勇气注进对方心里让他敢去行动
words.core_image: 一只手搭上肩，对方心里便多了迈步的底气
examples: The coach encouraged the players.
She encouraged me to apply.
semantic_expansions: 鼓励/激励：把信心和勇气送入他人心中

words.root_logic: dis-（除去）+ courage（勇气）→ 把勇气从人心里抽走
words.origin: 法语 décourager，来自 dis＋courage
words.native_definition: to make someone lose confidence or willingness
words.core_concept: pulling the heart's courage away so one no longer dares – 把心中勇气抽走、让人不敢再试
words.core_image: 一连串打击让原本高涨的心气一点点泄掉
examples: Don't let failure discourage you.
The price discouraged most buyers.
semantic_expansions: 使气馁/使灰心：抽走人行动的勇气

words.root_logic: cord（心）+ -ial → 从心里发出、热诚真挚的
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 cordialis（与心有关的），来自 cor
words.native_definition: warm and friendly in manner
words.core_concept: coming straight from the heart, unguarded and warm – 由心直接流出、真挚热诚
words.core_image: 主人握住的双手带有发自内心的热乎劲
examples: The two leaders had a cordial meeting.
He gave us a cordial welcome.
semantic_expansions: 热诚的/由衷的：从心里直接流出、真挚亲切

words.root_logic: pati（承受）→ 愿意稳稳承受病情或等待而不急躁
words.origin: 拉丁语 patiens（忍耐的、承受的），来自 pati
words.native_definition: a person receiving medical care, or someone able to wait calmly
words.core_concept: one who bears an affliction steadily without complaint – 愿意稳稳承受病痛或等待而不急躁
words.core_image: 病床上的人静静躺着，接受照护、不怨不躁
examples: The nurse checked on each patient.
Be patient with the slow process.
semantic_expansions: 病人：正在承受、接受治疗的人
有耐心的：能稳住等待不焦躁

words.root_logic: pati（承受）+ -ence → 稳稳承受等待与麻烦的能力
words.origin: 拉丁语 patientia（忍耐），来自 pati
words.native_definition: the capacity to accept delay or trouble without annoyance
words.core_concept: the steady bearing of waiting and hardship without snapping – 面对等待与麻烦仍稳稳不放、不崩裂
words.core_image: 一个人排队等了很久，仍平静如初不抱怨
examples: The task requires great patience.
She waited with patience for the news.
semantic_expansions: 耐心/忍耐：承受等待与麻烦而不急躁崩裂的能力

words.root_logic: im-（不）+ patient（忍耐）→ 不能安心等待、急不可耐
words.origin: 拉丁语 impatientia（不耐烦），来自 in＋pati
words.native_definition: unable to wait calmly, or eager to have something happen soon
words.core_concept: unwilling to bear delay, wanting it now – 不愿承受片刻等待、立时要到
words.core_image: 排队者来回数着步子，恨不能立刻轮到自己
examples: He grew impatient with the delays.
Children are impatient for the holiday.
semantic_expansions: 不耐烦的/急切的：不能安心等待、急于成事

words.root_logic: pass（承受）+ -ion → 强烈到使人几乎被卷挟过去的情感
words.origin: 拉丁语 passio（受苦、激烈情感），来自 pati
words.native_definition: a very strong feeling, especially love or enthusiasm
words.core_concept: an emotion so strong one feels swept or carried by it – 强烈到像被裹挟着走的情感
words.core_image: 一个人谈起所爱之事时，眼里近乎着了火
examples: She has a passion for music.
The argument was fought with passion.
semantic_expansions: 激情/热情：强烈到几乎把人卷走的情感
酷爱：对某事近乎难以自抑的热衷

words.root_logic: pass（承受）+ -ive → 处于承受、被作用一方的
words.origin: 拉丁语 passivus（被动的），来自 pati
words.native_definition: showing no active resistance; receiving action
words.core_concept: on the receiving end of action without doing – 处于被作用而自身不主动的一方
words.core_image: 一个人只是静静承受外力，不去推、不去挡
examples: He took a passive role in the debate.
The patient remained passive during treatment.
semantic_expansions: 被动的/消极的：处于被作用而不主动推动

words.root_logic: com-（共同）+ passion（承受）→ 与他人共同承受其苦
words.origin: 法语 compassion，来自拉丁语 com＋pati
words.native_definition: sympathetic concern for the suffering of others
words.core_concept: bearing another's pain alongside them as if shared – 与他人一同承受对方的苦楚
words.core_image: 老人跌倒时，旁人心里也像跟着疼了一下
examples: She showed great compassion for the refugees.
Compassion moved the doctor to volunteer.
semantic_expansions: 同情/怜悯：与他人的苦难一同承受而产生的关怀

words.root_logic: con-（完全）+ ced（让出）→ 完全让出、承认对方有理
words.origin: 拉丁语 concedere（让与），来自 con＋cedere
words.native_definition: to admit something is true, or give up a claim
words.core_concept: stepping fully aside to let the other side pass – 完全退让、把位置让给对方
words.core_image: 争执中一方慢慢退后，把原来的立场交出去
examples: She conceded that she was wrong.
The team conceded two goals.
semantic_expansions: 承认/让步：让出立场、承认对方有理
words.recall_hint: ced（让出）走到完全退让那一步，不再争持

words.root_logic: pre-（在前）+ ced（行走）→ 走在他人之前
words.origin: 拉丁语 praecedere（走在前面），来自 prae＋cedere
words.native_definition: to come before someone or something in time or order
words.core_concept: walking out ahead so others follow in sequence – 走在队伍最前面、他人随后
words.core_image: 开幕的号角声在前，正戏紧随其后上演
examples: A brief speech preceded the ceremony.
The storm was preceded by dark clouds.
semantic_expansions: 在…之前：时间或次序上先行一步

words.root_logic: re-（向后）+ ced（行走）→ 向后退去、退远
words.origin: 拉丁语 recedere（后退），来自 re＋cedere
words.native_definition: to move back or appear to move away
words.core_concept: walking backward, drawing away from the front – 朝后退行、远离当前
words.core_image: 退潮时水面一点点斜着往回缩
examples: The floods slowly receded.
The coastline receded into mist.
semantic_expansions: 退去/减退：向后退行、声势逐渐减弱

words.root_logic: pre-（在前）+ ced（行走）+ -ent → 走在前、可作先例再对照
words.origin: 拉丁语 praecedens（在先的），来自 praecedere
words.native_definition: an earlier event or ruling used as an example for later ones
words.core_concept: the earlier case that walks ahead and guides later ones – 走在前头、供后来者参照的先例
words.core_image: 存档的旧卷宗摆在前，后来的案子便照着走
examples: The ruling set a legal precedent.
There is no precedent for this decision.
semantic_expansions: 先例/判例：走在前、供后来者参照的既有之例

words.root_logic: con-（完全）+ stant（站立）→ 始终站定、不变化的
words.origin: 拉丁语 constans（不变的），来自 con＋stare
words.native_definition: not changing; happening all the time
words.core_concept: standing always in one fixed position unchanged – 一直站在原处、始终不变
words.core_image: 桌上的钟摆按同一节奏不停摆动，从不停歇
examples: The clock keeps a constant speed.
She lives under constant pressure.
semantic_expansions: 恒定的/持续的：一直站定不变、不间断

words.root_logic: in-（在上）+ stant（站立）→ 紧贴着眼前的当下、正立在当处
words.origin: 拉丁语 instans（正在进行的），来自 instare（立于其上）
words.native_definition: a very short moment of time; happening immediately
words.core_concept: the point that stands right up against the now – 紧贴在当下这一点上
words.core_image: 电光火石间那一瞬，几乎来不及眨眼
examples: He paused for an instant.
The message reached me in an instant.
semantic_expansions: 片刻/瞬间：紧贴现在的极短一瞬
立刻：就在当下发生

words.root_logic: instant（瞬间）+ -aneous → 发生在转眼之间、同时即至
words.origin: 英语 instantaneous，来自 instant
words.native_definition: happening immediately, without delay
words.core_concept: taking but the blink of an instant – 眨眼之间即发生、毫不拖延
words.core_image: 按下的按钮与亮起的光几乎同时完成
examples: The site gave instantaneous feedback.
Death was instantaneous.
semantic_expansions: 瞬间的/即时的：在眨眼之间即发生

words.root_logic: st（站立）+ -able → 能稳稳站住、不会倒下
words.origin: 拉丁语 stabilis（稳固的），来自 stare（站立）
words.native_definition: steady and not likely to change or collapse
words.core_concept: able to stand steadily without falling – 能安稳站立、不易倾倒
words.core_image: 一栋楼的地基打得深，风吹只晃不动
examples: The patient's condition is stable.
They built on stable ground.
semantic_expansions: 稳定的/牢固的：能稳立不倒、不易改变

words.root_logic: est-（站）+ -abl- + -ish → 使某物立起来并稳稳站住
words.origin: 拉丁语 stabilire（使稳固），来自 stare
words.native_definition: to set up something durable, or prove something as fact
words.core_concept: raising something onto solid footing where it stands firm – 把事物立起来使其稳固站定
words.core_image: 一块碑被深深埋住竖好，从此站在那里不再倒
examples: They established a new school.
The theory was established by evidence.
semantic_expansions: 建立/确立：把事物立稳、使其长久站定

words.root_logic: manu-（手）+ fact（做）+ -ure → 原指用手做出，后指量产制造
words.origin: 拉丁语 manufactura（手工制造），来自 manus＋facere
words.native_definition: to produce goods in large quantities
words.core_concept: making things by hand or machine at scale – 通过手或机器大批产出成品
words.core_image: 流水线上工位相接，一件件成品被造出来
examples: The plant manufactures car parts.
They manufacture goods for export.
semantic_expansions: 制造/生产：用手或机器成批做出物品

words.root_logic: bene-（好）+ fic（做出）+ -ial → 造出好处的、有利的
words.origin: 拉丁语 beneficialis（有益的），来自 beneficium（恩惠）
words.native_definition: producing good or helpful results
words.core_concept: making good come forth for someone – 为某人造出好处
words.core_image: 一场及时雨洒下，田地因此长势更好
examples: Regular exercise is beneficial to health.
The new law is beneficial to farmers.
semantic_expansions: 有益的/有利的：能为人带来好处与助益

words.root_logic: con-（共同）+ fin（界限）→ 把范围限制在共同划定的边界内
words.origin: 拉丁语 confinare（限定边界），来自 con＋finis
words.native_definition: to keep within set limits, or restrict a person
words.core_concept: holding something inside a fixed boundary line – 把事物限制在划定的界线之内
words.core_image: 乱跑的小动物被围栏圈回，出不了那道边
examples: The fire was confined to one room.
Please confine your remarks to the topic.
semantic_expansions: 限制/局限于：把范围关在既定边界之内

words.root_logic: de-（下、定）+ fin（界限）→ 为事物的边界下定义
words.origin: 拉丁语 definire（定界限），来自 de＋finire
words.native_definition: to state the exact meaning or limits of something
words.core_concept: setting down the boundary so a thing is clearly delimited – 划下界线把含义确定下来
words.core_image: 词典编者用一句话圈出那个词的确切边界
examples: Please define the key terms.
The rules define what is allowed.
semantic_expansions: 定义/界定：划定精确边界以确定含义

words.root_logic: re-（再次）+ fin（末端、纯净）→ 反复提纯、去除杂质
words.origin: 拉丁语 raffinare（提纯），来自 re＋fin
words.native_definition: to purify, or improve by removing unwanted parts
words.core_concept: re-passing something to its clean end state, stripping impurity – 反复过一遍把杂质滤净
words.core_image: 粗矿在炉中一再炼制，杂质一层层被剔除
examples: The company refines crude oil.
They refined the design over months.
semantic_expansions: 精炼/提纯：反复处理以滤除杂质
改进：去掉粗糙处使其更完善

words.root_logic: of-（ob- 迎面）+ fer（带来）→ 把东西带到面前供人取舍
words.origin: 拉丁语 offerre（呈上），来自 ob＋ferre
words.native_definition: to present something for acceptance or rejection, or a deal
words.core_concept: bringing a thing up to someone's face to take or refuse – 把物件呈到人前供其接或拒
words.core_image: 托盘被端到宾客面前，任他取用或推回
examples: She offered him a cup of tea.
He offered to help with the move.
semantic_expansions: 提供/提出：把事物呈到面前供人选择

words.root_logic: re-（回）+ fer（携带）→ 把目光或话题带回某处
words.origin: 拉丁语 referre（带回、提及），来自 re＋ferre
words.native_definition: to direct attention to, or mention as a source
words.core_concept: carrying attention back to a source or named thing – 把注意力带回所指之处
words.core_image: 读者顺着页码把问题带回那一段原文
