words.core_concept: the wheeled box one gets into and is taken along in – 坐进去、被它带着走的那个带轮子的箱
words.core_image: 四个轮子撑着一个铁壳，人坐进去合上门
examples: She parked the car outside.
The train has eight cars.
semantic_expansions: 汽车：带轮载人的那种车
车厢：列车上同样带轮的一节
words.recall_hint: carrus（四轮货车）→ 带轮子载人载物的车

words.root_logic: carrus（货车）→ carriare（用车运）→ 把东西带着走
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 carier（用车运）← 通俗拉丁语 carricare ← carrus（货车）
words.native_definition: to hold something and take it with you
words.core_concept: taking a load along instead of leaving it where it lay – 把货带着走，而不是留在原地
words.core_image: 他把箱子抱起来，一路没放下过
examples: She carried the box upstairs.
This bus carries fifty people.
semantic_expansions: 搬运/携带：把东西带着走
载运：车船同样把货带着走
words.recall_hint: carrus（货车）→ carriare（用车运）→ 带着走

words.root_logic: carry（用车运）+ -age → 供载运的那辆车，及载运这件事
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 cariage ← carier ← 通俗拉丁语 carricare ← carrus
words.native_definition: a vehicle pulled by horses; a railway coach; the act of carrying
words.core_concept: the box on wheels made to be pulled – 造出来专供人拉着走的那个带轮的厢
words.core_image: 两匹马在前头，后面那个厢一晃一晃跟着
examples: A horse-drawn carriage waited outside.
Goods carriage costs extra.
semantic_expansions: 马车/车厢：供载运的那个带轮的厢
运输：把货带着走这件事本身
words.recall_hint: carry（用车运）+ -age → 供载运的车及其事

words.root_logic: carry（带着走）+ -er → 负责把东西带着走的人或物
words.origin: 英语 carrier，来自 carry ← 通俗拉丁语 carricare ← carrus
words.native_definition: a person or thing that transports something; one who spreads a disease
words.core_concept: whatever the load is handed to for the journey – 把货交给它、由它带走的那个
words.core_image: 包裹交到那人手上，第二天出现在另一座城
examples: The carrier delivered it by noon.
Mosquitoes are carriers of malaria.
semantic_expansions: 运送者/承运人：受托把货带走的那方
带菌者：同样是被病带着走的那个载体
words.recall_hint: carry（带着走）+ -er → 负责带走的那个

words.root_logic: carrus（货车）→ 西班牙语 cargar（装车）→ 装在车船上的那批货
words.origin: 西班牙语 cargo（装载物）← cargar（装车）← 通俗拉丁语 carricare ← carrus
words.native_definition: the goods carried by a ship, plane, or truck
words.core_concept: what fills the hold once the loading is done – 装完之后填满舱里的那批东西
words.core_image: 舱盖掀开，底下一层层码到顶都是箱子
examples: The ship carried a cargo of grain.
Cargo planes fly overnight.
semantic_expansions: 货物/载货：装在车船上被带走的那批东西
words.recall_hint: carrus（货车）→ cargar（装车）→ 装上去的货

words.root_logic: carrus（车）→ carraria（车道）→ 跑道 → 一个人走过的那条职业道
words.origin: 法语 carrière（跑马道）← 意大利语 carriera ← 通俗拉丁语 carraria（车道）← carrus
words.native_definition: the series of jobs a person has over their working life
words.core_concept: the track laid for wheels, and by extension the course one runs – 给车轮铺出的那条道，引申为人一路跑下来的路线
words.core_image: 车辙压出两道印子，后来的车都顺着这两道走
examples: She had a long career in law.
He changed careers at forty.
semantic_expansions: 职业/事业：一个人顺着走下来的那条道
生涯：这条道从头到尾的整段
words.recall_hint: carrus（车）→ carraria（车道）→ 人走的职业道

words.root_logic: carrus（货车）→ carricare（装车）→ 把担子压上去 → 收费、指控、充电
words.origin: 古法语 chargier（装载）← 通俗拉丁语 carricare（装车）← carrus（货车）
words.native_definition: to ask a price; to accuse formally; to put electricity into
words.core_concept: loading a weight onto someone or something – 把一份分量压到人或物身上
words.core_image: 货往车上一压，车轴吃住了那个重量
examples: They charge ten pounds for entry.
He was charged with theft.
semantic_expansions: 收费：把价钱这份分量压给顾客
指控：把罪名压到人身上
充电：把电这份量压进电池
冲锋：把整个人的势压向前
words.recall_hint: carrus（货车）→ carricare（装车）→ 把分量压上去

words.root_logic: trad（交付）+ -ition → 一代代交下来的那套 → 传统
words.origin: 拉丁语 traditio（交付、口传）← tradere（交付）← trans＋dare
words.native_definition: a custom or belief passed down over generations
words.core_concept: what each generation puts into the next pair of hands – 每一代交到下一双手里的那份
words.core_image: 老人把那套做法一样样交给儿子，儿子照着又教给孙子
examples: It is a family tradition.
The town keeps its old traditions.
semantic_expansions: 传统/惯例：一代代交下来、照着做的那套
传承：交这个动作本身
words.recall_hint: trad（交付）+ -ition → 一代代交下来的那套

words.root_logic: trait（交付）+ -or（人）→ 把自己一方交出去的那个人
words.origin: 古法语 traitre ← 拉丁语 traditor（交付者、叛卖者）← tradere
words.native_definition: a person who betrays their country or friends
words.core_concept: the one who hands his own side over to the other – 把自己这边交到对面手里的那个
words.core_image: 他把名册递了出去，第二天册上的人一个个被带走
examples: He was executed as a traitor.
They called her a traitor.
semantic_expansions: 叛徒/卖国者：把自己一方交到对面手里的那个人
words.recall_hint: trait（交付）+ -or（人）→ 把自己一方交出去的人

words.root_logic: treas（交付）+ -on → 把国家交出去这桩罪
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 treisoun ← 拉丁语 traditio（交付、叛卖）← tradere
words.native_definition: the crime of betraying one's own country
words.core_concept: the act of handing one's own country across – 把自己的国交出去这个行为
words.core_image: 图纸从抽屉里取出，越过边境线递到了对面
examples: He was tried for treason.
Such an act amounts to treason.
semantic_expansions: 叛国罪：把自己的国交出去这桩罪
背叛：同一个交出去的动作，泛用
words.recall_hint: treas（交付）+ -on → 把国交出去这桩罪

words.root_logic: be-（加强）+ tray（交付）→ 把托付之物交给外人 → 背叛；引申为无意露出
words.origin: 中古英语 betrayen，由 be-＋古法语 trair ← 拉丁语 tradere（交付）
words.native_definition: to be disloyal to someone; to reveal something unintentionally
words.core_concept: handing over what was entrusted to you – 把托付给自己的东西交了出去
words.core_image: 钥匙本是托他保管，他却把它递到了外人手上
examples: He betrayed his closest friend.
Her face betrayed her fear.
semantic_expansions: 背叛：把托付之物交给外人
泄露：把不该交的消息交了出去
流露：神情不自觉把心里的事交了出来
words.recall_hint: be-（加强）+ tray（交付）→ 把托付之物交出去

words.root_logic: basis（踏脚处）→ 底下承重的那一处 → 底座、基地
words.origin: 古法语 bas ← 拉丁语 basis ← 希腊语 basis（踏脚处）← bainein（踏）
words.native_definition: the lowest part that supports something; a centre of operations
words.core_concept: the part everything above puts its weight on – 上面所有重量都压在它身上的那一层
words.core_image: 柱子底下那块方石承着整根柱，抽掉它上面就塌
examples: The base of the lamp is heavy.
They returned to base at dusk.
semantic_expansions: 底部/基础：上面重量全压在它身上的那一层
基地：一切行动的落脚与出发之处
words.recall_hint: basis（踏脚处）→ 底下承重的那一层

words.root_logic: basis（踏脚处）→ 论证或安排所立足的那一点
words.origin: 拉丁语 basis ← 希腊语 basis（踏脚处）← bainein（踏）
words.native_definition: the facts or ideas from which something is developed
words.core_concept: the footing an argument stands on – 一番道理踩着立住的那一点
words.core_image: 他先把那个前提摆稳，后面的话才踩得住
examples: What is the basis of your claim?
We meet on a weekly basis.
semantic_expansions: 基础：整套说法立足的那一点
根据/依据：拿它当立足点来论证
words.recall_hint: basis（踏脚处）→ 论证立足的那一点

words.root_logic: base（底层）+ -ic → 属于最底那一层的 → 基本的
words.origin: 英语 basic，来自 base ← 希腊语 basis（踏脚处）
words.native_definition: forming the simplest and most necessary part of something
words.core_concept: the layer nothing else can be put under – 底下再没有别的一层了
words.core_image: 把上面几层都揭掉，剩下这层再往下就没有了
examples: Learn the basic rules first.
The room has only basic furniture.
semantic_expansions: 基本的/必需的：底下再没有一层可揭的
初级的：从最底那层学起的
words.recall_hint: base（底层）+ -ic → 属于最底那一层

words.root_logic: base（底部）+ -ment → 房子最底下那一层
words.origin: 英语 basement，来自 base ← 希腊语 basis（踏脚处）
words.native_definition: the floor of a building that is below ground level
words.core_concept: the storey the whole house stands on, dug into the ground – 整栋房子踩着的那一层，埋在地里
words.core_image: 顺楼梯往下走到底，头顶就是一楼的地板
examples: They store boxes in the basement.
The basement floods every spring.
semantic_expansions: 地下室/底层：整栋房子踩着的、埋在地里那一层
words.recall_hint: base（底部）+ -ment → 房子最底那一层

words.root_logic: base（垒、踏脚处）+ ball（球）→ 绕垒跑的那种球赛
words.origin: 英语复合词 base＋ball；base ← 希腊语 basis（踏脚处）
words.native_definition: a game in which players hit a ball and run round four bases
words.core_concept: the game named after the spots the runner must step on – 以跑者必须踩到的那几处得名的球赛
words.core_image: 打完那一棒他就跑，脚一个个点过场上那四块垫子
examples: They played baseball all afternoon.
He collects baseball cards.
semantic_expansions: 棒球：以跑者要踩的那几处（垒）得名的球赛
words.recall_hint: base（垒）+ ball（球）→ 绕垒跑的球赛

words.root_logic: charta（纸）→ 裁成小张的硬纸片
words.origin: 法语 carte ← 意大利语 carta ← 拉丁语 charta（纸）← 希腊语 khartēs
words.native_definition: a small piece of stiff paper used for messages, games, or identity
words.core_concept: the palm-sized stiff sheet you hand over or hold – 递出去或攥在手里那张巴掌大的硬纸
words.core_image: 他从钱包里抽出一张硬硬的小方片，递到柜台上
examples: She sent me a birthday card.
He shuffled the cards twice.
semantic_expansions: 卡片：裁成小张的硬纸
纸牌：印了花色供玩的那种小张
证件：印了身份信息的那一张
words.recall_hint: charta（纸）→ 裁成小张的硬纸片

words.root_logic: charta（纸）→ 画上线条数据的那张纸 → 图表、海图
words.origin: 法语 charte ← 拉丁语 charta（纸）
words.native_definition: a sheet showing information as lines, figures, or a map
words.core_concept: the sheet whose marks let you read a whole situation at a glance – 靠纸上的线条一眼看出全局的那张
words.core_image: 墙上贴的那张纸画着起落的折线，谁走过都抬头看一眼
examples: The chart shows monthly sales.
The captain checked the chart.
semantic_expansions: 图表：把数据画成线条的那张纸
海图：画着航路水深的那张
排行榜：把名次排成表的那张
words.recall_hint: charta（纸）→ 画上线条数据的那张纸

words.root_logic: chart（纸）+ -er → 写明权利的那份正式文书；动词指按约包租
words.origin: 古法语 chartre ← 拉丁语 chartula（小纸片、文书）← charta（纸）
words.native_definition: a formal document stating rights; to hire a vehicle for exclusive use
words.core_concept: the sheet whose words bind, once sealed – 一旦盖了印，纸上的字就约束住人
words.core_image: 羊皮纸上盖了红印，从此城里的人按那上头写的办
examples: The city received its charter in 1215.
They chartered a plane.
semantic_expansions: 宪章/特许证：写明权利、盖印生效的那份文书
包租：照文书约定独家使用车船
words.recall_hint: chart（纸）+ -er → 写明权利、盖印生效的文书

words.root_logic: carta（纸）+ -one（大）→ 大张硬纸上的草图 → 漫画、动画
words.origin: 意大利语 cartone（厚纸板、草图）← carta ← 拉丁语 charta（纸）
words.native_definition: a humorous drawing; a film made from drawings
words.core_concept: the big sheet a drawing is worked out on before anything else – 别的都还没动，先在大张纸上画出来的那个
words.core_image: 一大张厚纸摊在桌上，草稿一格一格画满了
examples: The cartoon made everyone laugh.
Children watched a cartoon.
semantic_expansions: 漫画：画在纸上、供人一看就笑的那种图
动画片：由这类画一格格连成的影片
words.recall_hint: carta（纸）+ -one（大）→ 大张纸上的草图

words.root_logic: campus（原野）→ 在野地上扎下的临时住处
words.origin: 法语 camp ← 意大利语 campo ← 拉丁语 campus（原野）
words.native_definition: a place with tents or huts where people stay temporarily
words.core_concept: cloth and poles set up on open ground, meant to come down again – 在空地上搭起来、还要拆走的那些棚帐
words.core_image: 空地上支起十几顶帐篷，绳子一头钉进土里
examples: They set up camp by the river.
We camped for three nights.
semantic_expansions: 营地/露营：在野地搭起、还要拆走的临时住处
阵营：同一块地上聚起来的那一伙人
words.recall_hint: campus（原野）→ 野地上扎的临时住处

words.root_logic: campus（原野）→ 学校所占的那整片地
words.origin: 拉丁语 campus（原野），18 世纪美国普林斯顿用它指校地，遂成此义
words.native_definition: the grounds and buildings of a university or college
words.core_concept: the whole stretch of ground a school spreads over – 一所学校摊开来占住的那整片地
words.core_image: 从图书馆走到食堂要穿过两片草坪，全在同一圈围墙里
examples: The campus has three libraries.
She lives on campus.
semantic_expansions: 校园/校区：一所学校摊开占住的那整片地
words.recall_hint: campus（原野）→ 学校占住的那整片地

words.root_logic: campagna（旷野）→ 军队开到野地上打的那一仗 → 战役；引申为有组织的行动
words.origin: 法语 campagne ← 意大利语 campagna（旷野）← 拉丁语 campus（原野）
words.native_definition: a planned series of actions to achieve a goal, military or public
words.core_concept: a run of moves carried out on open ground toward one end – 在开阔地上一步步铺排、朝一个目标去的那串动作
words.core_image: 队伍开到野地上驻下，一步步照计划往前推
examples: The campaign lasted six months.
She ran a campaign for clean water.
semantic_expansions: 战役：军队在野地上铺排的那一仗
运动/竞选活动：同样有组织、朝一个目标推的那串行动
words.recall_hint: campagna（旷野）→ 野地上铺排的那一仗

words.root_logic: campio（在场上格斗的人）← campus（场地）→ 场上胜出的那个 → 冠军
words.origin: 古法语 champion ← 晚期拉丁语 campio（角斗者）← 拉丁语 campus（场地）
words.native_definition: a person who wins a competition; one who fights for a cause
words.core_concept: the one left standing on the field when the others are done – 场上比到最后还立着的那个
words.core_image: 场地中间只剩一个人站着，四周的人开始鼓掌
examples: She is the world champion.
He championed the new law.
semantic_expansions: 冠军：场上比到最后立着的那个
拥护者：同样在场上替某一方出战的人
words.recall_hint: campio（场上格斗者）← campus（场地）→ 胜出者

words.root_logic: circulus（小环）→ 一圈闭合的线，及圈起来的那片
words.origin: 古法语 cercle ← 拉丁语 circulus（小环）← circus（圆圈）
words.native_definition: a round shape whose edge is everywhere the same distance from the centre
words.core_concept: the closed line that ends exactly where it started – 终点正落在起点上的那条闭线
words.core_image: 笔尖绕一圈回到原处，纸上留下一条合起来的线
examples: Draw a circle on the board.
She has a small circle of friends.
semantic_expansions: 圆：终点落回起点的那条闭线
圈子：像那条线一样围起来的一小群人
环绕：沿着那条线走一遍
words.recall_hint: circulus（小环）→ 终点落回起点的闭线

words.root_logic: circul（小环）+ -ar（…的）→ 圆形的；也指绕回原处的（论证）
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 circularis（属于环的）← circulus
words.native_definition: shaped like a circle; moving round; returning to the start
words.core_concept: of the form that leads back to where it set out – 属于那种走回原处的形状
words.core_image: 跑道绕了一整圈，起跑线和终点线是同一条
examples: The table has a circular top.
That is a circular argument.
semantic_expansions: 圆形的：形如那条闭线
循环的：绕一圈回到原处
通知：绕着一圈人依次传阅的那张
words.recall_hint: circul（小环）+ -ar → 形如闭线、绕回原处

words.root_logic: circus（圆圈）→ 圆形场地 → 在圆场里演的那种班子
words.origin: 拉丁语 circus（圆圈、圆形竞技场）← 希腊语 kirkos（环）
words.native_definition: a travelling show with acrobats and animals, performed in a ring
words.core_concept: the round pit the audience sits all the way around – 观众围满一整圈的那个圆场
words.core_image: 帐篷中间空出一个圆场，看台把它整整围了一圈
examples: The circus came to town.
They met at Piccadilly Circus.
semantic_expansions: 马戏团：在圆场里演出的那个班子
圆形广场：几条路绕成一圈的那处场地
words.recall_hint: circus（圆圈）→ 圆形场地 → 圆场里的班子

words.root_logic: circum（绕，circus 的宾格作副词）+ it（ire 行）→ 绕行一周 → 回路、巡回
words.origin: 古法语 circuit ← 拉丁语 circuitus（绕行）← circum（绕）＋ire（行）；主根是 ire（行），但 circum 出自 circus，故归此族并在此注明
words.native_definition: a closed path, especially one electricity flows round; a regular tour
words.core_concept: the way that must close on itself for anything to move along it – 必须首尾接上、才走得通的那条路
words.core_image: 线从这头接到那头再绕回来，灯才亮起来
examples: The circuit was broken.
The judge rides the circuit.
semantic_expansions: 电路：首尾接上才通电的那条闭路
环线/巡回：同样绕一圈回到原处的路线
words.recall_hint: circum（绕）+ it（行）→ 绕行一周、首尾接上

words.root_logic: battuere（击打）→ battualia（操练、交手）→ 两军对打的那一场
words.origin: 古法语 bataille ← 晚期拉丁语 battualia（击剑操练）← battuere（击打）
words.native_definition: a fight between armed forces; a struggle to achieve something
words.core_concept: two sides trading blows until one gives way – 两边对着打，直到一方撑不住
words.core_image: 两队人在坡上互相冲了几个来回，谁也没退
examples: The battle lasted two days.
She fought a long battle with illness.
semantic_expansions: 战斗/战役：两军对着打的那一场
斗争：把这场对打用在非武力的事上
words.recall_hint: battuere（击打）→ 两边对打的那一场

words.root_logic: com-（相对）+ bat（打）→ 面对面对打
words.origin: 法语 combat ← combattre ← 晚期拉丁语 combattere ← com＋battuere（击打）
words.native_definition: fighting between armed forces; to try to stop something bad
words.core_concept: the two standing face to face, each blow met by another – 两人面对面站定，一下换一下
words.core_image: 两人正面站着，拳头一来一回，没人侧身躲开
examples: He was killed in combat.
New laws combat pollution.
semantic_expansions: 战斗/搏斗：面对面对打
对抗：把这股对打之力用在抑制某事上
words.recall_hint: com-（相对）+ bat（打）→ 面对面对打

words.root_logic: de-（往下）+ bate（打）→ 用话往下打 → 辩论
words.origin: 古法语 debatre（争辩）← de＋batre ← 晚期拉丁语 battuere（击打）
words.native_definition: a formal discussion where opposing views are argued
words.core_concept: blows traded in words instead of fists – 打的是话，不是拳头
words.core_image: 两人隔着讲台一句接一句往回顶，谁也不肯松口
examples: The debate ran for three hours.
They debated the new policy.
semantic_expansions: 辩论/争论：用话一句接一句地对打
讨论：同一动作缓和下来，只交换看法
words.recall_hint: de-（往下）+ bate（打）→ 用话往下打

words.root_logic: canalis（水槽）→ 人工挖出让水通行的那条道
words.origin: 拉丁语 canalis（水槽、管道）← canna（芦管）
words.native_definition: a long channel dug for boats or for carrying water
words.core_concept: the trench cut so water has one path and no other – 挖出来只许水走这一条的沟
words.core_image: 两岸砌得笔直，水面一路平着延到看不见的地方
examples: The canal links two rivers.
Boats pass through the canal daily.
semantic_expansions: 运河/沟渠：挖出让水通行的那条道
管道：体内同样中空可通的那种道
words.recall_hint: canalis（水槽）→ 挖出让水通行的那条道

words.root_logic: canalis（管道）经古法语 chanel → 水流经过的那条道；引申为传递的路子
words.origin: 古法语 chanel ← 拉丁语 canalis（水槽、管道）
words.native_definition: a passage water flows along; a band for broadcasting; a way of doing something
words.core_concept: the groove that decides where the flow may go – 决定水往哪儿走的那道槽
words.core_image: 石板上凿出一道浅槽，水只能顺着这道往下淌
examples: The Channel separates England and France.
Change to another channel.
semantic_expansions: 海峡：两地之间供水通行的那条道
频道：信号顺着走的那条道
途径：办事所走的那条道
words.recall_hint: canalis（管道）→ 决定流向的那道槽

words.root_logic: canna（管）+ -one（大）→ 一根大管子 → 火炮
words.origin: 法语 canon ← 意大利语 cannone（大管）← canna（芦管）← 拉丁语
words.native_definition: a large heavy gun that fires solid balls
words.core_concept: the oversized tube that sends its load out one end – 一根粗大的管，装的东西从一头轰出去
words.core_image: 铜管架在木架上，粗到能塞进拳头，一头对着城墙
examples: The cannon fired at dawn.
Old cannons line the fort wall.
semantic_expansions: 大炮/火炮：一根粗大的管，装的东西从一头轰出去
words.recall_hint: canna（管）+ -one（大）→ 一根大管子

words.root_logic: caput（头）经古法语 chief → 一群人里居首的那个
words.origin: 古法语 chief（头、首领）← 拉丁语 caput（头）
words.native_definition: the leader of a group; most important
words.core_concept: the one the others look to before acting – 别人动手前先看的那一个
words.core_image: 帐篷里众人说着话，一齐朝上座那人望过去
examples: The chief gave the order.
That is our chief concern.
semantic_expansions: 首领：一群人里居首的那个
主要的/首席的：诸事里排在头位的
words.recall_hint: caput（头）→ 一群人里居首的那个

words.root_logic: chief（首领）的法语后期形 → 厨房里居首的那个 → 主厨
words.origin: 法语 chef（de cuisine，厨房之长）← 古法语 chief ← 拉丁语 caput（头）
words.native_definition: a professional cook, especially the one in charge of a kitchen
words.core_concept: the one whose word settles what leaves the kitchen – 菜出不出得了门，由他一句话定
words.core_image: 灶台后那人一抬手，几个帮手同时停下等着听
examples: The chef prepared a special menu.
She trained as a chef in Paris.
semantic_expansions: 主厨/厨师长：厨房里居首、说话作数的那个
words.recall_hint: chief（首领）法语后期形 → 厨房之长

words.root_logic: capitale（首要财产）→ 旧时最值钱的家产就是牛 → 牛群
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 catel（财产）← 晚期拉丁语 capitale（首要财产）← caput（头）；英语 capital（资本）同出此支，牛作旧时首要家产故得此名
words.native_definition: cows and bulls kept on a farm
words.core_concept: what used to count as a household's chief wealth, counted by the head – 旧时算作一家首要财产、按头来数的那些
words.core_image: 栏里十几头挤在一处，主人清早数一遍才放心
examples: The cattle grazed by the river.
He keeps forty head of cattle.
semantic_expansions: 牛/牲畜：旧时算作首要家产、按头计数的那些
words.recall_hint: capitale（首要财产）→ 旧时最值钱的家产即牛

words.root_logic: citare（唤来）→ 把别人的话唤到眼前作凭据 → 引用
words.origin: 拉丁语 citare（唤来、传唤）← ciere（使动起来）
words.native_definition: to quote a source as evidence; to summon to court
words.core_concept: calling another's words up to stand as witness – 把别人说过的话叫到跟前当证人
words.core_image: 他翻开书按住那一行，念出来给在座的人听
examples: She cited three studies.
He was cited to appear in court.
semantic_expansions: 引用/引证：把别人的话唤到眼前作凭据
传唤：把人唤到庭前
words.recall_hint: citare（唤来）→ 把话唤到眼前作凭据

words.root_logic: ex-（出来）+ cite（唤动）→ 把里头的劲唤出来 → 使激动
words.origin: 拉丁语 excitare（唤起、激发）← ex＋citare（唤动）
words.native_definition: to make someone feel eager or stirred up
words.core_concept: calling out the energy that was sitting still inside – 把本来静着的那股劲唤出来
words.core_image: 话音刚落，屋里人一下都坐直了，声音也高了
examples: The news excited everyone.
Loud noise excites the dog.
semantic_expansions: 使激动/激起：把静着的劲唤出来
刺激：同一动作用在感官或神经上
words.recall_hint: ex-（出来）+ cite（唤动）→ 把里头的劲唤出来

words.root_logic: re-（再）+ cite（唤来）→ 把记住的话再唤出来 → 背诵
words.origin: 拉丁语 recitare（朗读、背诵）← re＋citare（唤来）
words.native_definition: to say aloud something learned by heart
words.core_concept: calling the words up again from memory, out loud – 把记下的话再唤出来，说给人听
words.core_image: 他闭着眼把整段说完，一个字没停顿
examples: She recited the poem from memory.
He recited the whole list.
semantic_expansions: 背诵/朗诵：把记下的话再唤出来说给人听
列举：把各项一件件唤出来点过
words.recall_hint: re-（再）+ cite（唤来）→ 把记住的话再唤出来

words.root_logic: klima（地带）← klinein（倾斜）→ 日照斜角不同分出的地带 → 一地长年的天候
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 clima（地带）← 希腊语 klima（倾斜、地带）← klinein（倾斜）；古人按日照入射的斜角划分地带，故此词本指「斜度」
words.native_definition: the usual weather conditions of an area over many years
words.core_concept: what the sun's slant onto one stretch of ground settles into over years – 日头斜照一地，年复一年定下来的那副样子
words.core_image: 同一片地上，年年都是那几个月潮、那几个月干
examples: The climate here is mild.
There is a climate of distrust.
semantic_expansions: 气候：日照斜度定下的、一地长年的天候
风气：一处长期形成的那种氛围
words.recall_hint: klima（斜度、地带）← klinein（倾斜）→ 长年天候

words.root_logic: klimax（梯子）← klinein（斜靠）→ 一级级斜上去的顶端 → 高潮
words.origin: 希腊语 klimax（梯子）← klinein（斜靠、倾斜）
words.native_definition: the most intense or important point of something
words.core_concept: the last rung of a ladder that leans up and stops – 斜靠上去的梯子，最后那一级
words.core_image: 一级一级往上，到最上面那级再没有了，人就停在那儿
examples: The film builds to a climax.
Her career reached its climax.
semantic_expansions: 高潮/顶点：斜梯一级级上去、最后那一级
words.recall_hint: klimax（梯子）← klinein（斜靠）→ 最后那一级

words.root_logic: klinē（卧床）← klinein（斜靠）→ 在床边诊治 → 诊所
words.origin: 法语 clinique ← 希腊语 klinikē（床边医术）← klinē（卧床）← klinein（斜靠）
words.native_definition: a place where people go for medical treatment or advice
words.core_concept: the room built around the bed a patient leans back on – 围着病人斜靠的那张床设起来的屋
words.core_image: 一排床挨墙摆着，穿白衣的人挨床看过去
examples: The clinic opens at eight.
She works at a dental clinic.
semantic_expansions: 诊所/门诊：围着病人斜靠的床设起来的诊治之处
words.recall_hint: klinē（卧床）← klinein（斜靠）→ 床边诊治之处

words.root_logic: bulla（铅封文书）→ bullettino（小文书）→ 简短公告
words.origin: 法语 bulletin ← 意大利语 bullettino（小文告）← bulla（盖铅封的文书）← 拉丁语
words.native_definition: a short official statement of news
words.core_concept: the sealed slip put up so all may read the same words – 盖了印贴出来、让众人读到同一句话的那张
words.core_image: 墙上钉着一张短短的纸，底下按了印，路过的人都停下看
examples: A bulletin was issued at noon.
She reads the news bulletin.
semantic_expansions: 公告/简报：盖印贴出、让众人读到的那张短文
新闻快报：同样简短、随时发出的那种
words.recall_hint: bulla（铅封文书）→ 简短公告

words.root_logic: boule（球）+ -ette（小）→ 小圆球 → 枪弹
words.origin: 法语 boulette（小球）← boule（球）← 拉丁语 bulla（圆泡）
words.native_definition: a small piece of metal fired from a gun
words.core_concept: the little round slug that leaves the barrel – 从枪管里出去的那颗小圆粒
words.core_image: 掌心里几颗黄铜色的小圆粒，一头是尖的
examples: The bullet missed by inches.
He loaded six bullets.
semantic_expansions: 子弹/弹丸：从枪管出去的那颗小圆粒
words.recall_hint: boule（球）+ -ette（小）→ 小圆球 → 枪弹

words.root_logic: boule（球）→ bowl（滚球）+ -ing → 滚球撞瓶的那种玩法
words.origin: 英语 bowling，来自 bowl（滚球）← 法语 boule（球）← 拉丁语 bulla（圆泡）
words.native_definition: a game in which a heavy ball is rolled to knock down pins
words.core_concept: the heavy round thing sent rolling down a lane – 顺着一条道滚出去的那个沉圆物
words.core_image: 一个沉沉的圆球贴地滚出去，尽头一排木柱哗啦倒了
examples: They went bowling on Friday.
He booked a bowling lane.
semantic_expansions: 保龄球/滚球游戏：把沉圆物滚出去撞倒木柱的那种玩法
words.recall_hint: boule（球）→ bowl（滚球）→ 滚球撞瓶的玩法

words.core_concept: days laid out in ruled squares – 日子排进格子，好查哪天办什么

examples: Each region has its own culture.

semantic_expansions: 文化：世代照管养出来的那套风习
培养/栽培：照管使之长起来这个动作本身
words.recall_hint: cult（照管）+ -ure → 长年照管长出来的那一片

words.root_logic: creare（使生出）→ 把原先没有的做出来
words.origin: 拉丁语 creare（造出、使生出）的过去分词 creatus
words.native_definition: to make something exist that did not exist before
words.core_concept: the moment a thing first stands where nothing stood – 原先空着的那处，头一回有了东西
words.core_image: 纸上本来什么都没有，笔一落，一个形状就在那儿了
examples: She created a new design.
The storm created chaos.
semantic_expansions: 创造/创作：把原先没有的做出来
造成：某事使一个局面生出来
words.recall_hint: creare（使生出）→ 把原先没有的做出来

words.root_logic: create（使生出）+ -ive → 能把没有的弄出来的
words.origin: 英语 creative，来自 create ← 拉丁语 creare
words.native_definition: able to produce new and original things
words.core_concept: of the kind that turns an empty surface into something – 属于「能把空处变出东西」那一类
words.core_image: 同样一堆边角料，有人摆着摆着就成了个能用的东西
examples: She has a creative mind.
It was a creative solution.
semantic_expansions: 有创造力的/创造性的：能把原先没有的弄出来的那种
words.recall_hint: create（使生出）+ -ive → 能把没有的弄出来

words.root_logic: create（使生出）+ -ure → 被造出来的那个 → 生物
words.origin: 古法语 creature ← 晚期拉丁语 creatura（被造之物）← creare（造出）
words.native_definition: any living thing that can move, especially an animal
words.core_concept: whatever was brought into being and now moves on its own – 被弄出来、如今自己会动的那个
words.core_image: 石头下面那个小东西被光一照，八条腿一齐动起来
examples: Strange creatures live in the deep sea.
The poor creature was shivering.
semantic_expansions: 生物/动物：被造出来、自己会动的那个
家伙：带感情色彩地指某个人
words.recall_hint: create（使生出）+ -ure → 被造出来的那个

words.root_logic: crux（十字）→ 从一边横过到另一边，路线与原线相交
words.origin: 古英语 cros ← 古爱尔兰语 cros ← 拉丁语 crux（十字架）
words.native_definition: to go from one side to the other; a mark or shape of two lines
words.core_concept: the path that cuts through another instead of running alongside – 不顺着走，而是横切过去的那条线
words.core_image: 他从这边人行道横切过去，走线正好压过车道
examples: Look both ways before you cross.
Mark your answer with a cross.
semantic_expansions: 穿过：横切过另一条线
十字/交叉：两条线相交留下的那个形
words.recall_hint: crux（十字）→ 横切过去、与原线相交

words.root_logic: cruc（十字路口）+ -ial → 处在岔路交点上的 → 决定性的
words.origin: 拉丁语 crucialis（十字形的）← crux（十字架）；十字路口须择一路走，故引申为「决定成败的那一处」
words.native_definition: extremely important because it decides what follows
words.core_concept: the fork where the road splits and one must be chosen – 路在此分岔，非选一条不可的那一点
words.core_image: 路到这儿分成两条，选哪条后头就全不一样了
examples: This is a crucial decision.
Timing was crucial to the plan.
semantic_expansions: 决定性的/关键的：处在岔路交点、选择定成败的那一处
words.recall_hint: cruc（十字路口）+ -ial → 岔路交点、择一定成败

words.root_logic: crux（十字）→ 荷兰语 kruisen（打十字、来回横渡）→ 巡航
words.origin: 荷兰语 kruisen（十字形来回航行）← kruis（十字）← 拉丁语 crux
words.native_definition: to sail or drive at a steady pace without hurrying
words.core_concept: going back and forth across a stretch rather than straight to one end – 在一片水面上来回横着走，不直奔一头
words.core_image: 船不赶路，在同一片海面上来回划着走，速度一直没变
examples: The ship cruised along the coast.
We cruised at sixty miles an hour.
semantic_expansions: 巡航/巡游：来回横着走而不直奔一头
缓行：保持一个不赶的速度走
words.recall_hint: crux（十字）→ kruisen（来回横渡）→ 巡航

words.root_logic: datum（所给之物）的复数 → 摆出来供人处理的那些事实
words.origin: 拉丁语 data（datum 的复数，「所给之物」）← dare（给）
words.native_definition: facts and figures collected for reference or analysis
words.core_concept: the figures handed over for someone else to work on – 交到手上、让人拿去处理的那些数字
words.core_image: 一叠表格递过来，上面全是记好的数字，等着人去算
examples: The data shows a clear trend.
We collected data for six months.
semantic_expansions: 数据/资料：交到手上供人处理的那些事实与数字
words.recall_hint: datum（所给之物）的复数 → 供人处理的事实

words.root_logic: data（所给之物）+ base（底座）→ 把数据搁在一处的那个底盘
words.origin: 英语复合词 data＋base；data ← 拉丁语 dare（给）
words.native_definition: an organized store of information held in a computer
words.core_concept: the one place all the handed-over figures are kept – 把交上来的数字全搁在一处的那个地方
words.core_image: 所有表格最后都归到同一个柜里，查哪一份都能翻出来
examples: The database holds ten million records.
She queried the customer database.
semantic_expansions: 数据库：把交上来的数据统一搁在一处的那个地方
words.recall_hint: data（所给之物）+ base（底座）→ 存放数据的底盘

words.root_logic: datum（所给之物）→ 旧文书末尾写「datum Romae…（给于罗马某日）」→ 日期
words.origin: 古法语 date ← 晚期拉丁语 data（文书上标注的签发日）← dare（给）；旧时公文末尾以 datum（给于某地某日）起句，遂以此指日期
words.native_definition: the day of the month or year; an arrangement to meet
words.core_concept: the day written at the foot of a paper to fix when it was handed over – 写在文书末尾、标明何日交出的那一天
words.core_image: 信纸最下面一行写着地点和那一天，字迹比正文小些
examples: What is the date today?
They went on a date last night.
semantic_expansions: 日期：文书上标明何日交出的那一天
约会：定好在哪一天见面这件事
枣：另一支借自希腊 daktulos（指头），与本族无关
words.recall_hint: datum（给于某日）→ 文书末尾标注的那一天

words.root_logic: camera obscura（暗室）截短 → 靠一间暗室成像的那件器械
words.origin: 拉丁语 camera obscura（暗室）的截短形 ← camera（小室）← 希腊语 kamara（拱顶）
words.native_definition: a device for taking photographs or filming
words.core_concept: the light-tight box that lets in just one narrow beam – 密不透光的那个盒子，只放一束光进去
words.core_image: 盒子四面不透光，只前头留一个小孔，光从那儿进来
examples: He bought a new camera.
The camera stopped recording.
semantic_expansions: 照相机/摄像机：靠一间密闭暗室成像的那件器械
words.recall_hint: camera obscura（暗室）截短 → 成像的暗箱器械

words.root_logic: camera（小室）经古法语 chambre → 一间围起来的屋，也指枪膛、议院
words.origin: 古法语 chambre ← 拉丁语 camera（拱顶小室）
words.native_definition: a room, especially a private or official one; an enclosed space
words.core_concept: the space walled off so what is inside stays inside – 围起来、使里头的东西留在里头的那块空间
words.core_image: 推开厚门是一间不大的屋，声音在里头闷着传不出去
examples: The judge spoke in his chamber.
The gun has six chambers.
semantic_expansions: 房间：围起来的一间屋
议院：议事者聚在其中的那间
膛室：枪械里围起来装弹的那格
words.recall_hint: camera（小室）→ 围起来的一间屋

words.root_logic: camara（小室）→ 同住一室的人 → 同伴、战友
words.origin: 法语 camarade ← 西班牙语 camarada（同室者）← 拉丁语 camera（小室）
words.native_definition: a friend or fellow member, especially one sharing hardship
words.core_concept: the one who slept in the same small room as you – 跟你睡同一间小屋的那个人
words.core_image: 两张床挤在同一间屋里，夜里说话不用抬高声音
examples: He lost two comrades in the war.
She greeted her old comrades.
semantic_expansions: 同伴/战友：同住一室、共过患难的那个人
同志：以此互称的政治用法
words.recall_hint: camara（小室）→ 同住一室的人

words.root_logic: damnum（损失）+ -age → 受损这件事，及损到什么程度
words.origin: 古法语 damage（损失）← 拉丁语 damnum（损失）
words.native_definition: physical harm that makes something less useful or valuable
words.core_concept: what is gone from a thing and will not come back – 从一件东西上少掉、再补不回的那部分
words.core_image: 车头凹进去一块，钣金敲平了，那道折痕还留着
examples: The storm caused serious damage.
Water damaged the floor.
semantic_expansions: 损害/损坏：从物上少掉、补不回的那部分
损失：算总账时少掉的那一笔
words.recall_hint: damnum（损失）+ -age → 受损及其程度

words.root_logic: damnare（判罚）→ 判某人该受损失 → 谴责、诅咒
words.origin: 古法语 damner ← 拉丁语 damnare（判罚、使受损）← damnum（损失）
words.native_definition: to condemn strongly; used as a mild swear word
words.core_concept: handing down the verdict that a thing is to be written off – 一句话判定它就此作废
words.core_image: 他把那份稿子往桌上一推，一句话就断了它的生路
examples: Critics damned the film.
He damned his own bad luck.
semantic_expansions: 谴责：判定其该受损、就此作废
诅咒/该死的：把这道判词当骂语用
words.recall_hint: damnare（判罚）→ 判它该受损、就此作废

words.root_logic: con-（加强）+ demn（判罚）→ 正式判定其有罪或不堪用
words.origin: 拉丁语 condemnare（定罪）← con＋damnare（判罚）← damnum（损失）
words.native_definition: to express strong disapproval; to sentence; to declare unfit for use
words.core_concept: the formal word that settles a thing's fate against it – 一纸判词把它的去向定死
words.core_image: 楼门上钉了一张告示，写明此后不许住人
examples: They condemned the attack.
The building was condemned last year.
semantic_expansions: 谴责：正式表明不认可
判罪：判定其有罪
宣告不适用：判定房屋器物不堪再用
words.recall_hint: con-（加强）+ demn（判罚）→ 正式判定其不堪

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ sta（立）→ constare（合起来立住、值多少）→ 代价
words.origin: 古法语 coster ← 拉丁语 constare（值、花费）← com＋stare（站立）
words.native_definition: the amount of money needed to buy or do something
words.core_concept: what has to be put up before a thing will stand – 要它立得住，先得垫上去的那份
words.core_image: 柜台上报出一个数，那数付了东西才归你
examples: The cost of living keeps rising.
It cost more than we expected.
semantic_expansions: 费用/花费：换取一物须付出的那个数
代价：不止钱，泛指须付出的那一份
words.recall_hint: con-（一起）+ sta（立）→ 要它立住须垫上的那份

words.root_logic: cost（代价）+ -ly（…样的）→ 代价大的
words.origin: 英语 costly，来自 cost ← 拉丁语 constare ← com＋stare
words.native_definition: expensive; causing much loss or harm
words.core_concept: the kind that takes a great deal to keep standing – 要撑住它得垫进去很多的那种
words.core_image: 那间铺子每月要垫进去的钱越来越多，最后关了门
examples: It was a costly mistake.
Repairs proved too costly.
semantic_expansions: 昂贵的/代价高的：要撑住它得垫进去很多的那种
words.recall_hint: cost（代价）+ -ly → 代价大的

words.root_logic: contra-（相对）+ sta（立）→ 两者对立而站 → 对比出的差别
words.origin: 法语 contraste ← 意大利语 contrastare（对立）← 拉丁语 contra＋stare（站立）
words.native_definition: a clear difference seen when two things are put side by side
words.core_concept: two things stood against each other so the gap shows – 两样对着立住，差别就显出来
words.core_image: 深浅两块布并排铺开，挨着一看才知道差多少
examples: The contrast between them is striking.
Her mood contrasts with his.
semantic_expansions: 对比/对照：两者对立而站、差别显出来
反差：那道差别本身的大小
words.recall_hint: contra-（相对）+ sta（立）→ 对着立住，差别显出

words.root_logic: capulum（套索）← capere（抓取）→ 抓得住东西的粗绳 → 缆
words.origin: 古北法语 cable ← 晚期拉丁语 capulum（套索）← 拉丁语 capere（抓取）
words.native_definition: a thick strong rope or bundle of wires
words.core_concept: the rope thick enough to hold whatever it is put around – 粗到能箍住东西不放的那种绳
words.core_image: 手腕粗的一股绞在一起，绕上桩子拽不动
examples: The cable snapped under strain.
They laid a cable under the sea.
semantic_expansions: 缆绳：粗到能箍住东西的那种绳
电缆：同样成股的导线
电报：靠海底电缆发的那种讯
words.recall_hint: capulum（套索）← capere（抓取）→ 抓得住的粗绳

words.root_logic: de-（脱开正道）+ ceit（接住）→ 让人接住假的 → 欺骗
words.origin: 古法语 deceite ← 拉丁语 decipere（诱骗）← de＋capere（抓取）
words.native_definition: the act of making someone believe what is not true
words.core_concept: handing over the false one so it is taken as real – 递过去一件假的，让人当真接下
words.core_image: 他把掺过的那壶推到客人手边，自己那壶另放着
examples: She was hurt by his deceit.
The scheme was built on deceit.
semantic_expansions: 欺骗/欺诈：递假的让人当真接下
谎言：用来骗人接下的那句话
words.recall_hint: de-（脱开正道）+ ceit（接住）→ 让人接住假的

words.root_logic: de-（往下）+ cay（落）→ 一路往下落 → 衰败、腐烂
words.origin: 古北法语 decair ← 通俗拉丁语 decadere（落下去）← de＋cadere（落下）
words.native_definition: to become gradually worse or to rot away
words.core_concept: the slow slide downward that nothing stops – 一路往下掉，没什么拦住它
words.core_image: 木桩底下一年年发软，用手一掰就掉渣
examples: The wood began to decay.
The empire slowly decayed.
semantic_expansions: 腐烂：一路往下坏到掉渣
衰败/衰退：局面同样一路往下落
words.recall_hint: de-（往下）+ cay（落）→ 一路往下落

words.root_logic: caboche（大脑袋）← caput（头）→ 长成一个圆头的那种菜
words.origin: 古北法语 caboche（脑袋）← 拉丁语 caput（头）
words.native_definition: a round vegetable with thick green or purple leaves
words.core_concept: the vegetable that grows into one tight round head – 长成紧紧一个圆球的那种菜
words.core_image: 菜地里一颗颗圆球贴地摆着，叶子层层裹得很紧
examples: She shredded a whole cabbage.
Cabbage grows well in cool weather.
semantic_expansions: 卷心菜/甘蓝：叶子裹成紧紧一个圆头的那种菜
words.recall_hint: caboche（大脑袋）← caput（头）→ 长成圆头的菜

words.root_logic: consulere（商议、求教）→ 商议后给出的那番话 → 建议
words.origin: 古法语 conseil ← 拉丁语 consilium（商议、议事）← consulere（商议、求教）
words.native_definition: advice given after careful thought; a lawyer in a case
words.core_concept: what is said back after the matter has been talked through – 事情议过一遍之后回给你的那番话
words.core_image: 他把来龙去脉听完，沉了一会儿才开口说该怎么办
examples: She sought legal counsel.
He counselled patience.
semantic_expansions: 建议/劝告：议过之后回给你的那番话
律师：在案中受聘出这番话的人
words.recall_hint: consulere（商议）→ 议过之后回给你的话

words.root_logic: crescere（增多）→ crue（增补的人手）→ 一船一机上的那班人
words.origin: 古法语 crue（增补、增援）← creistre ← 拉丁语 crescere（生长、增多）
words.native_definition: the people who work on a ship, plane, or team
words.core_concept: the hands added until there are enough to work the vessel – 添到够用为止的那班人手
words.core_image: 船要开了还差几个人，码头上又叫来两个才凑齐
examples: The crew worked through the night.
A film crew arrived at dawn.
semantic_expansions: 船员/机组：添到够用、操作船机的那班人
全体人员：同一班人的总称
words.recall_hint: crescere（增多）→ crue（增补人手）→ 那班人

words.root_logic: de-（脱开）+ bt（habere 持有）→ debere（本该有却不在手上）→ 欠款
words.origin: 古法语 dette ← 拉丁语 debitum（所欠之物）← debere（欠）← de＋habere（持有）
words.native_definition: money that one owes to another
words.core_concept: what should be in your hands but is not, because it is owed – 本该在手上、却因为欠着而不在的那份
words.core_image: 账本上写着数目，钱却还在别人那儿
examples: He paid off his debts.
The company is deep in debt.
semantic_expansions: 债务/欠款：本该在手上、因欠着而不在的那份
人情债：同样欠着、须回报的那一份
words.recall_hint: de-（脱开）+ habere（持有）→ 本该有却不在手上

words.root_logic: col-（一起）+ leg（拣拢）→ colligere（收拢）→ 绕成一圈圈收起来
words.origin: 古法语 coillir（收拢）← 拉丁语 colligere（聚集）← com＋legere（拣选、拢起）
words.native_definition: a length of rope or wire wound into rings
words.core_concept: the rope gathered in on itself, ring lying on ring – 绳往自己身上收拢，一圈压一圈
words.core_image: 绳子一圈压一圈盘在甲板上，中间空出一个洞
examples: He hung a coil of rope on the hook.
The snake coiled around the branch.
semantic_expansions: 线圈/盘卷：绕成一圈圈收拢起来的那束
卷成圈：把它绕起来这个动作
words.recall_hint: col-（一起）+ leg（拣拢）→ 绕成一圈圈收起

words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆
words.origin: 拉丁语 commutare（com-＋mutare：换过来换过去）
words.native_definition: to travel regularly between your home and your place of work
words.core_concept: swap one thing for another of equal worth – 用等价的一样换掉另一样
words.core_image: 每天同一班车同一个位置，六点出门六点回，票根攒了一抽屉
examples: She commutes to London by train every day.
His sentence was commuted to ten years.
semantic_expansions: 通勤：家和工位之间来回替换位置，天天照旧
减刑：把重的那段刑期换成轻的一段
折换：一种东西按算好的比价换成另一种

words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆
words.origin: 拉丁语 conflictus ← con-＋fligere（相互击打）
words.native_definition: a serious disagreement or a period of armed fighting between opposing sides
words.core_concept: two forces striking against each other – 两股力撞在一处，谁也不退
words.core_image: 两只手按住同一张纸的两头，各朝自己那边拽，纸中间已经起皱
examples: The two countries were in armed conflict.
Her account conflicts with the witness statement.
semantic_expansions: 冲突：两边正面撞上，动了手

words.root_logic: dis-（分开）+ pute（算）→ 各算各的、算不到一处 → 争执

words.recall_hint: de-（往下）+ put（派定）→ 被指派顶事的人

words.root_logic: fallere（使跌倒）→ 该托住的没托住 → 没做成

words.core_concept: what is left after the footing gave way – 塌下去之后剩下的那个局面

words.root_logic: falsus（fallere 的过去分词）→ 骗过人的 → 假的、不实的

words.native_definition: not true or real; intended to deceive
words.core_concept: the thing that looks sound until your weight is on it – 看着结实，一压上去才知道不是
words.core_image: 那块板漆得跟别处一样，踩上去才发现底下是空的

That assumption is false.

假的：造出来冒充真的

words.native_definition: a mistake or weakness; responsibility for something wrong
words.core_concept: the one spot where it gave way, and whose hand let it – 塌掉的那一处，以及那是谁的手松了
words.core_image: 查下来是那一颗螺丝没拧紧，别处都好

words.core_concept: of the kind that will give way somewhere – 属于「总有一处会塌」的那种

words.recall_hint: fault（出岔之处）+ -y → 带着毛病的

words.recall_hint: densus（稠的）→ 一处地方里挤了很多

words.root_logic: dense（密集的）+ -ity → 挤得多密这个量

words.native_definition: how tightly packed something is; mass per unit of volume
words.core_concept: the measure of how much is crowded into one space – 一处地方里究竟挤了多少的那个量
words.core_image: 同样大的两只盒子，一只沉手一只轻，装的东西疏密不同
examples: Bone density falls with age.
The city has high population density.

words.recall_hint: dense（密集的）+ -ity → 挤得多密这个量

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ dense（挤实）→ 往一处挤紧 → 压缩、凝结

words.core_concept: squeezing what was spread out into one tighter mass – 把摊开的往一处挤成更紧的一团
words.core_image: 满满一锅汤熬到只剩碗底那点，味道全收在里头

Steam condenses on cold glass.

words.recall_hint: con-（一起）+ dense（挤实）→ 往一处挤紧

words.root_logic: discus（圆盘）→ 扁而圆的那一片

words.native_definition: a thin flat round object
words.core_concept: the thin round piece you can spin between two fingers – 两指一夹就能转起来的那薄薄一圆片
words.core_image: 薄薄一片圆的，对着光能看见一圈圈细纹
examples: He put the disc in the player.

唱片：刻了纹的那种圆片
椎间盘：脊椎间垫着的那片圆软骨
words.recall_hint: discus（圆盘）→ 扁而圆的那一片

words.root_logic: discus（圆盘）经古英语 disc → 盛食物的那只浅圆器
words.origin: 古英语 disc（盘）← 拉丁语 discus（圆盘）← 希腊语 diskos

words.core_concept: the shallow round thing food is set into – 把菜放进去的那只浅圆器

words.recall_hint: discus（圆盘）→ 盛食物的浅圆器

words.root_logic: discus（圆盘、板）经中世纪拉丁语 desca → 写字用的那块板 → 书桌
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 desca（桌）← 拉丁语 discus（圆盘、扁板）
words.native_definition: a piece of furniture with a flat top for writing or working
words.core_concept: the flat board set at hand height to work on – 架到手边高度、供人在上头做事的那块平板

words.recall_hint: discus（扁板）→ desca → 写字用的那块板

words.root_logic: em-（en- 在内）+ phas（显现）+ -is → 把某一处特意显出来 → 强调

words.root_logic: phantasia（心里现出的影）← phainein（使显现）→ 只在心里显出、不在眼前的那些

words.core_concept: the picture that shows only inside the head – 只在脑子里现出来、外头没有的那幅

words.root_logic: fantasy 的截短形 → 心里现出个念头 → 觉得想要、喜欢；形容词指花哨

words.native_definition: to want or like something; elaborately decorated

花哨的：外表现得过多、招眼的那种
words.recall_hint: fantasy 截短 → 心里自己冒出的念头

words.root_logic: fatum（所说定之事）→ 由不得人改的那个去向

words.recall_hint: fatum（所说定之事）→ 由不得人改的去向

命中注定的：早已说定、避不开的
words.recall_hint: fatum（定数）+ -al → 关乎定数、补不回来

words.root_logic: Fata（司命女神）→ 古法语 fae（有法力的女子）+ -ry → 小精灵
words.origin: 古法语 faerie（法术、精灵之境）← fae ← 拉丁语 Fata（司命三女神）← fatum
words.native_definition: a small imaginary being with magic powers
words.core_concept: the small being said to hold sway over how things turn out – 传说能左右事情走向的那个小小者
words.core_image: 书里画着一个巴掌大的身影，背后两片薄翅
examples: She read a fairy tale aloud.
Children believe in fairies.
semantic_expansions: 仙女/小精灵：传说能左右事情走向的那个小小者
words.recall_hint: Fata（司命女神）→ fae（有法力者）→ 小精灵

words.root_logic: im-（in- 向内）+ ploy（折叠）→ implicare（把人卷进事里）→ 雇用、使用
words.origin: 古法语 employer ← 拉丁语 implicare（卷入、缠进）← in＋plicare（折叠）
words.native_definition: to pay someone to work; to make use of something
words.core_concept: folding a person into the work so they are part of it – 把人折进这摊事里，成为其中一折
words.core_image: 名册上添了一个名字，从此这摊活里就有他一份
examples: The firm employs 200 people.
She employed a clever trick.
semantic_expansions: 雇用：把人折进这摊事里、给他一份
使用：把某物折进做法里派上用场
words.recall_hint: im-（向内）+ ploy（折叠）→ 把人折进事里

words.root_logic: employ（雇用）+ -ee（受事者）→ 被折进这摊活里的那个人
words.origin: 英语 employee，由 employ 加受事后缀 -ee 构成 ← 拉丁语 implicare
words.native_definition: a person who is paid to work for someone else
words.core_concept: the one folded in, who works and draws pay – 被折进来做活、按月领钱的那个
words.core_image: 工牌上印着号码，每月到日子就有一笔钱进账
examples: Every employee gets two weeks off.
She is a long-serving employee.
semantic_expansions: 雇员/员工：被折进这摊活里、按期领钱的那个人
words.recall_hint: employ（雇用）+ -ee（受事）→ 被折进来做活的人

words.root_logic: employ（雇用）+ -er（施事者）→ 把人折进来的那一方
words.origin: 英语 employer，由 employ 加施事后缀 -er 构成 ← 拉丁语 implicare
words.native_definition: a person or company that pays others to work
words.core_concept: the side that does the folding-in and pays for it – 把人折进来、并为此付钱的那一方
words.core_image: 签字那一栏是公司的印，钱从那边出
examples: Her employer gave her a raise.
The employer must provide safety gear.
semantic_expansions: 雇主/用人单位：把人折进来做活、并为此付钱的那一方
words.recall_hint: employ（雇用）+ -er（施事）→ 把人折进来的那方

words.root_logic: ex-（出来）+ ploit（折叠）→ explicare（把折的摊开）→ 把用处榨出来 → 利用、开发
words.origin: 古法语 esploitier（施行、获益）← 拉丁语 explicare（展开）← ex＋plicare（折叠）
words.native_definition: to use something fully for gain; to treat someone unfairly for profit
words.core_concept: unfolding a thing to get everything out of it – 把折着的摊开，把里头能取的都取出来
words.core_image: 那张折了几道的纸被完全摊平，背面的字也一并露了出来
examples: They exploit the mine for copper.
Some firms exploit their workers.
semantic_expansions: 利用/开发：把折着的摊开、取尽其中用处
剥削：这种取尽用在人身上
words.recall_hint: ex-（出来）+ ploit（折叠）→ 摊开取尽其用

words.root_logic: ambactus（受派办事的人）→ 受派驻外办事的那个馆
words.origin: 古法语 ambassee ← 意大利语 ambasciata ← 拉丁语 ambactus（受派之人）← 印欧 *ag-（推动、驱使）一支，与 act 同源远亲
words.native_definition: the official office of an ambassador in another country
words.core_concept: the house that stands in for one country inside another – 一国派在别国境内代它办事的那处馆
words.core_image: 门口挂着别国的旗，里头办的是那个国家的事
examples: He works at the British embassy.
The embassy issued a warning.
semantic_expansions: 大使馆/使节团：一国派驻别国、代它办事的那处馆
words.recall_hint: ambactus（受派办事者）→ 派驻外国的那处馆

words.root_logic: ex-（出来）+ ag（驱动、称量）→ exagium（称重）→ 试着写出的一篇 → 短文
words.origin: 古法语 essai（尝试、试验）← 晚期拉丁语 exagium（称量）← exigere（ex＋agere 推出、称量）
words.native_definition: a short piece of writing on one subject; an attempt
words.core_concept: the piece written as a weighing-out of one question – 就一个题目称量着写出的那一篇
words.core_image: 题目摆在纸头，底下一段段把想法称量着摆开
examples: She wrote an essay on climate.
It was his first essay at farming.
semantic_expansions: 文章/论文：就一题称量着写出的那一篇
尝试：同一个「试着称量」用作动作
words.recall_hint: ex-（出来）+ ag（称量）→ exagium → 试写的一篇

words.root_logic: examination 的截短 ← examen（秤舌）← ex＋ag（驱出、称量）→ 称量学识的那一场
words.origin: 英语 exam 是 examination 的截短 ← 拉丁语 examen（天平的指针、称量）← exigere
words.native_definition: a formal test of knowledge or ability
words.core_concept: the occasion on which what one knows is weighed – 把人所知放上秤称一遍的那一场
words.core_image: 卷子发下来，会与不会当场就分出轻重
examples: She passed the exam easily.
The exam lasts two hours.
semantic_expansions: 考试/测验：把人所知放上秤称量的那一场
words.recall_hint: examen（秤舌）← ex＋ag（称量）→ 称量学识的一场

words.root_logic: en-（使）+ able（拿得住）→ 使某人拿得住、办得成
words.origin: 英语 enable，由 en-＋able 构成；able ← 拉丁语 habilis ← habere（拿住）
words.native_definition: to make it possible for someone to do something
words.core_concept: putting the thing within reach of a hand that could not hold it before – 让原先拿不住的那只手够得着、握得住
words.core_image: 垫脚的凳子搬来，本来伸手不及的那格就取到了
examples: The grant enabled her to study.
This tool enables faster work.
semantic_expansions: 使能够/使有可能：让原先拿不住的手够得着、握得住
words.recall_hint: en-（使）+ able（拿得住）→ 使其办得成

words.root_logic: dis-（取消）+ able（拿得住）→ 使拿不住、使用不了
words.origin: 英语 disable，由 dis-＋able 构成；able ← 拉丁语 habilis ← habere（拿住）
words.native_definition: to make someone unable to do something; to switch off a function
words.core_concept: taking away the grip that was there before – 把原先握得住的那份力撤掉
words.core_image: 闸一拉下来，方才还转着的机器立刻停住
examples: The injury disabled his right arm.
Disable the alarm before entering.
semantic_expansions: 使失能/使残疾：把原先握得住的那份力撤掉
停用：把功能撤掉、使它用不了
words.recall_hint: dis-（取消）+ able（拿得住）→ 使拿不住

words.root_logic: en-（使）+ dow（dare 给）→ 把一份给定在某人名下 → 捐赠、赋予
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 endouer ← en-＋古法语 douer ← 拉丁语 dotare（给嫁资）← dos ← dare（给）
words.native_definition: to give money or property to an institution; to give a quality naturally
words.core_concept: handing over a portion for good, not on loan – 交出去的那份是定给的，不是借的
words.core_image: 文书上写明这笔钱此后归学校，不再收回
examples: He endowed a scholarship fund.
She is endowed with great patience.
semantic_expansions: 捐赠/资助：把一份定给出去、不再收回
赋予：天生就把某种性质给定在某人身上
words.recall_hint: en-（使）+ dow（给）→ 把一份定给出去

words.root_logic: dosis（所给的一份）← didonai/dare（给）→ 一次给下的那个量
words.origin: 法语 dose ← 晚期拉丁语 dosis ← 希腊语 dosis（给予、一份），与拉丁 dare 同出印欧 *do-（给）
words.native_definition: a measured amount of medicine taken at one time
words.core_concept: the one portion measured out to be handed over at a time – 量好、一次交出去的那一份
words.core_image: 药瓶盖里倒到那道刻线，一次就喝这么多
examples: Take one dose every four hours.
He got a high dose of radiation.
semantic_expansions: 剂量/一剂：量好、一次给下的那一份
words.recall_hint: dosis（所给的一份）← 与 dare 同出印欧 *do-（给）

words.root_logic: e-（ex- 出来）+ lite（拣选）→ eligere（挑出来）→ 被挑出的那一小群
words.origin: 法语 élite ← élire（挑选）← 拉丁语 eligere（选出）← ex＋legere（拣选）
words.native_definition: a small group with the most power or skill
words.core_concept: the few picked out of the many and set apart – 从众人里挑出来、单独放一处的那几个
words.core_image: 名单一层层筛下来，最后只剩最上面几个名字
examples: The elite controlled the land.
She joined an elite unit.
semantic_expansions: 精英/上层集团：从众人里挑出、单独放一处的那几个
words.recall_hint: e-（出来）+ lite（拣选）→ 挑出来的那一小群

words.root_logic: integer（未经触碰的、完整的）→ 一点没缺的 → 全部的
words.origin: 古法语 entier ← 拉丁语 integer（完整的、未动过的）← in-（不）＋tangere（触）
words.native_definition: whole; with no part missing
words.core_concept: the thing still as it came, nothing taken off – 还是原来那一整个，没被取走过任何一块
words.core_image: 整块蛋糕端上来，刀还没碰过它
examples: He ate the entire cake.
The entire team agreed.
semantic_expansions: 整个的/全部的/完整的：还是原来那一整个、没被取走任何一块
words.recall_hint: integer（未经触碰的完整）→ 一点没缺的

words.root_logic: en-（使）+ sure（无忧）→ 把事办到没有可担心的余地 → 确保
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 enseurer ← en-＋seur（可靠的）← 拉丁语 securus（无忧的）← se-（无）＋cura（挂心）
words.native_definition: to make certain that something happens
words.core_concept: closing every gap until there is nothing left to worry about – 把每一处漏洞都堵上，没什么可担心了
words.core_image: 门窗一扇扇查过，回头再看一遍才走开
examples: Please ensure the door is locked.
This ensures a fair result.
semantic_expansions: 确保/保证：把每处漏洞都堵上、没什么可担心
words.recall_hint: en-（使）+ sure（无忧）→ 办到无可担心

words.root_logic: de-（彻底）+ liver（liberare 使自由）→ 把东西从手里放开交出去 → 递送
words.origin: 古法语 delivrer ← 晚期拉丁语 deliberare（释放、交付）← de＋liberare（使自由）← liber（自由的）
words.native_definition: to take goods to someone; to give a speech; to help at a birth
words.core_concept: letting go of what you held so it passes on – 把攥着的松开，让它转到别处去
words.core_image: 包裹从手里递出去，签完字那人转身就走了
examples: They deliver bread every morning.
She delivered a short speech.
semantic_expansions: 递送：把攥着的松开、让它转到别处
发表：把话从口里放出去
分娩：把胎儿从体内放出来
words.recall_hint: de-（彻底）+ liver（使自由）→ 从手里放开交出

words.root_logic: deliver（递送）+ -y → 递送这件事，或递到的那一批
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 delivree ← delivrer ← 晚期拉丁语 deliberare ← liber（自由的）
words.native_definition: the act of bringing goods; the way something is said; a birth
words.core_concept: the handing-over itself, and the load handed over – 交出这件事，及交出去的那一批
words.core_image: 清早那车停在门口，一箱箱往下卸
examples: The delivery arrived late.
Her delivery of the speech was calm.
semantic_expansions: 投递/交付：把东西交出去这件事及那一批货
分娩：把胎儿放出来这件事
words.recall_hint: deliver（递送）+ -y → 交出这件事及所交之物

words.root_logic: dis-（分开）+ play（折叠）→ displicare（把折的展开）→ 摊开给人看
words.origin: 古法语 despleier ← 拉丁语 displicare（展开）← dis＋plicare（折叠）
words.native_definition: to put something where people can see it; a show of something
words.core_concept: unfolding a thing so the whole of it faces out – 把折着的展开，整面朝外露出来
words.core_image: 折成一叠的图纸抖开铺平，整幅一次看全
examples: The museum displays old maps.
The screen displays the time.
semantic_expansions: 展示/陈列：把折着的展开、整面朝外给人看
显示：屏幕把内容摊出来给人看
words.recall_hint: dis-（分开）+ play（折叠）→ 把折的展开给人看

words.root_logic: de-（往下）+ gree（gradus 一步）→ 一级一级的那个梯级 → 程度、学位
words.origin: 古法语 degré ← 通俗拉丁语 degradus（阶级）← de＋gradus（一步、级）
words.native_definition: a level or amount on a scale; a qualification from a university
words.core_concept: one notch on a ladder of notches – 一格格刻度里的那一格
words.core_image: 温度计上一道道刻线，水银停在其中一道上
examples: The water is at ninety degrees.
She earned a degree in law.
semantic_expansions: 程度/度数：一格格刻度里的那一格
学位：学业等级里评定到的那一级
words.recall_hint: de-（往下）+ gree（一步）→ 一级级刻度里的那一格

words.root_logic: de-（离开）+ sire（sidus 星）→ 抬头望星而盼 → 渴望
words.origin: 古法语 desirer ← 拉丁语 desiderare（渴望，一说 de＋sidus 从星象盼求）← sidus（星）
words.native_definition: to want something very much
words.core_concept: the eyes lifted to something far off, wanting it down – 抬头望着远处那样东西，盼它落到手里
words.core_image: 夜里抬头望着那颗星看了很久，心里空着一处
examples: He desired peace above all.
She got everything she desired.
semantic_expansions: 渴望/想要：抬头望着远处那样、盼它落到手里
欲望：心里那处空着、要拿它来填的劲
words.recall_hint: de-（离开）+ sire（星）→ 望星而盼

words.root_logic: ex-（出去）+ pire（spirare 呼吸）→ 气出去不再回来 → 到期、死
words.origin: 拉丁语 exspirare（呼出、气绝）← ex＋spirare（呼吸）
words.native_definition: to come to an end; to stop being valid; to die
words.core_concept: the last breath going out with none coming back – 最后一口气出去，再没有吸进来的
words.core_image: 胸口起伏一次之后就平了下去，再没抬起来
examples: My passport expires in May.
He expired before dawn.
semantic_expansions: 到期/期满：效力像气一样出去不再回来
去世：最后一口气出去不再吸进
words.recall_hint: ex-（出去）+ pire（呼吸）→ 气出去不再回来

words.root_logic: dis-（分开）+ creet（cernere 筛分）→ 分得清该说不该说 → 谨慎、不外传
words.origin: 古法语 discret ← 拉丁语 discretus（分开的、有分辨的），discernere 的过去分词 ← dis＋cernere（筛分）
words.native_definition: careful not to say or do anything that causes trouble
words.core_concept: the one who sifts what may be said from what may not – 把能说的与不能说的筛开的那种人
words.core_image: 他知道内情，但话到嘴边只挑得出无关的几句
examples: Please be discreet about this.
She made discreet inquiries.
semantic_expansions: 谨慎的/守口的：把能说与不能说筛开的那种
不张扬的：把自己从人眼里筛开、不显出来
words.recall_hint: dis-（分开）+ creet（筛分）→ 分得清该说不该说

words.root_logic: dis-（去掉）+ card（纸牌）→ 把手里那张牌打掉 → 丢弃
words.origin: 英语 discard，由 dis-＋card 构成；card ← 拉丁语 charta（纸）
words.native_definition: to throw away something no longer wanted
words.core_concept: laying a card out of your hand and not taking it back – 把手里那张打出去，不再拿回
words.core_image: 他从手里抽出一张扣到桌边，那张就不算他的了
examples: Discard the packaging first.
She discarded two cards.
semantic_expansions: 丢弃/抛弃：把手里那张打出去、不再拿回
打出（牌）：牌戏里这个动作的本义
words.recall_hint: dis-（去掉）+ card（纸牌）→ 把手里那张打掉

words.root_logic: ex-（出来）+ ert（serere 编连）→ exserere（抽出来）→ 把力使出来
words.origin: 拉丁语 exserere（伸出、抽出）← ex＋serere（编连、串接）
words.native_definition: to use strength or influence to make something happen
words.core_concept: drawing the strand out of the weave and putting it to work – 把编在里头的那股抽出来使上
words.core_image: 攥紧的手往外一抽，绳上那股劲全使了出去
examples: He exerted all his strength.
She exerts great influence here.
semantic_expansions: 运用/施加：把编在里头的那股力抽出来使上
尽力：把自己那股全抽出来使
words.recall_hint: ex-（出来）+ ert（编连）→ 把里头那股抽出来使

words.root_logic: de-（取消）+ fy（fidere 信托）→ 撤回信托、宣告不再服 → 违抗
words.origin: 古法语 defier（挑战、宣告绝交）← 通俗拉丁语 disfidare ← dis＋fidus（可信的）← fidere（信托）
words.native_definition: to refuse to obey; to be impossible to explain
words.core_concept: taking back the trust once pledged and standing against it – 把当初许下的信托撤回，转身站到对面
words.core_image: 他把那份契约推回去，说往后不认这一条
examples: He defied the court order.
The result defies explanation.
semantic_expansions: 违抗/公然反抗：撤回信托、转身站到对面
使无法：某事顶住了解释，讲不通
words.recall_hint: de-（取消）+ fy（信托）→ 撤回信托、不再服

words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆
words.origin: 古英语 forheafod：fore（在前）+ heafod（头）← 原始日耳曼语 *haubudam（头）
words.native_definition: the part of the face above the eyes and below the hair
words.core_concept: the flat field of the face above the eyes – 眼睛上方那块平地
words.core_image: 体温枪往眉毛上边那块平地一贴，眉一挑，横纹叠起好几道
examples: The nurse pressed a thermometer to his forehead.
Sweat ran down her forehead into her eyes.

words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆
words.origin: 古英语 fyrmest（最先的、第一的）← 原始日耳曼语 *frumista-（最先的），后被重新分析为 fore＋most
words.native_definition: most important, or coming before all others in position
words.core_concept: ahead of everything else in the line – 在整列里排在所有人前头
words.core_image: 一排人站齐，只有一个人的鞋尖越出那条白线半个脚掌
examples: Safety is the foremost concern on this site.
She stood foremost among the waiting crowd.
semantic_expansions: 最前的：位置上没有谁比它更靠前
首要的：一堆事里先办、最要紧的那件
首先：说话时把这一条摆在最前面

words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆
words.origin: 中古英语 for ever：for（贯穿）＋ ever（古英语 æfre，始终），17 世纪起连写成一词
words.native_definition: for all time, or very often in an annoying way
words.core_concept: time with no end put to it – 没有给它设终点的时间
words.core_image: 碑上的字换过三代人来看，笔画还是当年那几道，没磨掉一笔
examples: These mountains will stand here forever.
He is forever losing his keys.

辩解：为已做之事补上这份分量
words.recall_hint: just（合于法）+ -ify → 说明它站得住

words.root_logic: ex-（出）+ it（ire 行走）→ 走出去的那个口
words.origin: 拉丁语 exitus（出去、出口）← exire（出去）← ex＋ire（行走）
words.native_definition: a way out of a place; the act of leaving
words.core_concept: the gap you step through on the way out – 往外走时跨过的那个口
words.core_image: 绿灯亮着的那扇门后头是台阶，人一个个跨出去
examples: The exit is at the back.
He made a quiet exit.
semantic_expansions: 出口：往外走时跨过的那个口
退场/离开：跨出去这个动作本身
words.recall_hint: ex-（出）+ it（行走）→ 走出去的那个口

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ it（行走）+ -al → initium（迈进的第一步）→ 最初的
words.origin: 拉丁语 initialis（起头的）← initium（开始）← inire（进入）← in＋ire（行走）
words.native_definition: existing at the beginning; the first letter of a name
words.core_concept: the first foot set down inside the door – 进门后落下的第一只脚
words.core_image: 刚跨进来那一步印在灰上，后面的脚印都在它前头
examples: My initial reaction was surprise.
Sign with your initials here.
semantic_expansions: 最初的/开头的：进门后落下的第一只脚
首字母：名字最前头那一个字
words.recall_hint: in-（进入）+ it（行走）→ 迈进的第一步

words.root_logic: initium（第一步）+ -ate（使…）→ 走出第一步 → 发起
words.origin: 拉丁语 initiare（开始、引入）← initium ← inire（进入）← in＋ire
words.native_definition: to cause something to begin; to admit someone into a group
words.core_concept: taking the one step that starts the rest moving – 迈出那一步，后面的才跟着动
words.core_image: 他先走了一步，原地站着的人这才跟上
examples: They initiated a new program.
He was initiated into the order.
semantic_expansions: 发起/开始：迈出那第一步使其余跟着动
使入会：引某人跨进那个圈子
words.recall_hint: initium（第一步）+ -ate → 走出第一步

words.root_logic: ex-（出）+ issue（ire 行走）→ 走出来的那一批 → 发行；引申为待处理之事
words.origin: 古法语 issue（出去、结果）← 拉丁语 exire（出去）← ex＋ire（行走）
words.native_definition: an important topic; a set of copies published at one time; to send out
words.core_concept: what comes walking out of the door, batch by batch – 一批批从门里走出来的那些
words.core_image: 印好的一摞从后门一批批运出来，封面日期都一样
examples: This is a serious issue.
The magazine issues monthly.
semantic_expansions: 问题/议题：摆到面前待处理的那一桩
期号/发行：一批批出门的那些印本
words.recall_hint: ex-（出）+ issue（行走）→ 走出来的那一批

words.root_logic: co-（一起）+ her（黏住）+ -ent → 各部分黏成一体、说得通的
words.origin: 拉丁语 cohaerens（连在一起的）← cohaerere ← com＋haerere（黏住）
words.native_definition: logically connected and easy to follow
words.core_concept: the parts stuck together so tightly the whole holds – 各部分黏得够牢，整体拎起来不散
words.core_image: 几段话前后咬着，抽掉哪一段后面都接不上
examples: She gave a coherent account.

semantic_expansions: 连贯的/条理清楚的：各部分黏成一体、拎起来不散
words.recall_hint: co-（一起）+ her（黏住）→ 各部分黏成一体

words.root_logic: co-（一起）+ hes（黏住）+ -ive → 能把彼此黏住的
words.origin: 英语 cohesive，来自拉丁语 cohaesus（cohaerere 的过去分词）← haerere
words.native_definition: sticking together well; forming a united whole
words.core_concept: what makes the pieces hold to one another – 使各块相互黏着的那份力
words.core_image: 湿沙攥成一团松手不散，干沙一松就漏下去
examples: They are a cohesive team.
Wet clay is more cohesive.
semantic_expansions: 有黏性的：能把彼此黏住的
团结的：一群人同样相互黏着不散
words.recall_hint: co-（一起）+ hes（黏住）+ -ive → 能相互黏住的

words.root_logic: in-（在内）+ her（黏住）+ -ent → 黏在里头拿不掉的 → 固有的
words.origin: 拉丁语 inhaerens（附着于内的）← inhaerere ← in＋haerere（黏住）
words.native_definition: existing as a natural and permanent part of something
words.core_concept: stuck so deep inside that removing it would break the thing – 黏在里头，要取出来就得把那东西拆了
words.core_image: 花纹是烧进瓷胎里的，擦不掉也磨不去
examples: Risk is inherent in the job.
It has an inherent weakness.
semantic_expansions: 固有的/内在的/天生的：黏在里头取不出来的那部分
words.recall_hint: in-（在内）+ her（黏住）→ 黏在里头拿不掉

words.root_logic: haes（卡住不动）+ -itate（反复）→ 反复卡在那儿 → 迟疑
words.origin: 拉丁语 haesitare（卡住、结巴）← haerere（黏住、卡住）的反复体
words.native_definition: to pause before doing something because of doubt
words.core_concept: the foot that lifts and comes back down in the same spot – 脚抬起来又落回原处，没往前挪
words.core_image: 他手伸到一半停住，收回来又伸出去
examples: She hesitated before answering.
Do not hesitate to ask.
semantic_expansions: 犹豫/迟疑：脚抬起又落回原处，反复卡在那儿
words.recall_hint: haes（卡住）+ -itate（反复）→ 反复卡在那儿

words.root_logic: de-（离开）+ fend（击）→ 把来的击开、使它离远 → 防御
words.origin: 古法语 defendre ← 拉丁语 defendere（挡开、保护）← de＋fendere（击）
words.native_definition: to protect from attack; to argue in support of
words.core_concept: the arm put up so the blow lands somewhere else – 手臂架上去，那一下就落到别处
words.core_image: 他抬臂一格，砸下来的那下偏到了肩外
examples: They defended the city for weeks.
She defended her decision.
semantic_expansions: 保卫/防御：把来的击开使其落到别处
辩护：同样是把冲自己来的话挡开
words.recall_hint: de-（离开）+ fend（击）→ 把来的击开

words.root_logic: defend（挡开）+ -ce → 挡这件事，及用来挡的那一套
words.origin: 古法语 defense ← 拉丁语 defensa ← defendere（挡开）← de＋fendere
words.native_definition: the act of protecting; something that protects
words.core_concept: whatever is put between you and the blow – 架在自己与那一下之间的东西
words.core_image: 土墙、壕沟、拒马一层层排在前头
examples: The country spends much on defence.
He spoke in his own defence.
semantic_expansions: 防御/防务：挡这件事及用来挡的那一套
辩护：法庭上替自己挡的那番话
words.recall_hint: defend（挡开）+ -ce → 挡这件事及所用之物

words.root_logic: defence 的截短 → 拦在四周挡人畜的那道栅
words.origin: 中古英语 fens，defence 的截短形 ← 拉丁语 defendere（挡开）
words.native_definition: a barrier of wood or wire around a piece of land
words.core_concept: the line of stakes that keeps what is outside outside – 一排桩子把外头的挡在外头
words.core_image: 一排木桩钉进土里，中间拉着铁丝，牛走到那儿就停
examples: They built a fence around the yard.

semantic_expansions: 篱笆/栅栏/围栏：拦在四周、把外头挡在外头的那道
words.recall_hint: defence 截短 → 拦在四周挡人畜的那道栅

words.root_logic: frons（额头）→ 朝前的那一面 → 前部、正面
words.origin: 古法语 front（额、正面）← 拉丁语 frons（额头）
words.native_definition: the side that faces forward; the most forward part
words.core_concept: the face that meets you first as you come up – 你走近时先碰到的那一面
words.core_image: 屋子朝街那一面开着窗，背面只有一道墙

semantic_expansions: 前面/正面：朝前、先碰到的那一面
前线：两军相对时朝前的那一面
words.recall_hint: frons（额头）→ 朝前的那一面

words.root_logic: front（正面）+ -ier → 一国朝外那条边 → 边境；引申为未开之域
words.origin: 古法语 frontiere（前沿）← front ← 拉丁语 frons（额头、正面）
words.native_definition: the border between two countries; the edge of what is known
words.core_concept: the outermost line a land turns toward the world – 一片地朝外顶着的那条最外的线
words.core_image: 界桩一路排到山脊，过了那道线就是别处
examples: They crossed the frontier at night.
It is a new frontier in medicine.
semantic_expansions: 边境/边疆：一国朝外顶着的那条最外线
前沿：知识或技术顶到的那条边
words.recall_hint: front（正面）+ -ier → 朝外顶着的那条边

words.root_logic: con-（相对）+ front（额面）→ 额头对额头 → 正面相对
words.origin: 法语 confronter ← 中世纪拉丁语 confrontare ← com＋frons（额头）
words.native_definition: to face someone or something difficult directly
words.core_concept: turning to put your forehead against the other's – 转过身把自己的额头对上对方的
words.core_image: 他没有绕开，转过身直接站到那人跟前
examples: She confronted him about the lie.
We must confront the problem.
semantic_expansions: 面对/对抗：转身把额头对上对方，不绕开
使对质：把两方拉到面对面
words.recall_hint: con-（相对）+ front（额面）→ 额头对额头

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ vade（迈步）→ 迈进别人的地界 → 侵入
words.origin: 拉丁语 invadere（侵入）← in＋vadere（迈步而行）
words.native_definition: to enter a place by force; to crowd into somewhere
words.core_concept: the foot coming down inside a line it had no right to cross – 脚落在本不该越过的那条线里侧
words.core_image: 界桩还立在那儿，一队人已经踩进了桩子里边
examples: The army invaded at dawn.
Tourists invade the town each July.
semantic_expansions: 侵略/侵入：迈进本不该进的地界
涌入：大批人同样跨进来占满
words.recall_hint: in-（进入）+ vade（迈步）→ 迈进别人地界

words.root_logic: invade（侵入）+ -sion → 侵入这件事
words.origin: 拉丁语 invasio ← invadere（侵入）← in＋vadere
words.native_definition: an act of entering by force; an unwelcome intrusion
words.core_concept: the whole of that crossing, once it has happened – 跨进来这件事整个算下来
words.core_image: 第二天清早，界内已经全是别处来的脚印
examples: The invasion began in spring.
It was an invasion of privacy.
semantic_expansions: 入侵/侵犯：迈进本不该进之处这件事
words.recall_hint: invade（侵入）+ -sion → 侵入这件事

words.root_logic: e-（ex- 出）+ vade（迈步）→ 迈出去脱身 → 躲开
words.origin: 拉丁语 evadere（逃出）← ex＋vadere（迈步而行）
words.native_definition: to escape or avoid something, often by cleverness
words.core_concept: stepping out through the gap before the hand closes – 手合上之前先迈出那道缝
words.core_image: 追到墙角却没人，只有一扇半开的小门
examples: He evaded the question.
She evaded capture for months.
semantic_expansions: 逃避/回避：手合上之前先迈出那道缝
躲开：同一动作用在具体的追捕上
words.recall_hint: e-（出）+ vade（迈步）→ 迈出去脱身

words.root_logic: fabula（讲出来的话）← fari（说）→ 讲给人听的那种短故事
words.origin: 古法语 fable ← 拉丁语 fabula（谈话、故事）← fari（说）
words.native_definition: a short story with a moral, often about animals
words.core_concept: the tale that exists only in the telling – 只靠口说才存在的那个故事
words.core_image: 老人一开口讲那只狐狸，孩子们就不出声了
examples: He read the fable aloud.
That story is pure fable.
semantic_expansions: 寓言/传说：靠口说流传的那种短故事
虚构之事：因此指不实之说
words.recall_hint: fabula（讲出来的话）← fari（说）→ 口说的故事

words.root_logic: fabula（故事）+ -ous → 像故事里那样的 → 惊人的、极好的
words.origin: 拉丁语 fabulosus（传说中的）← fabula（故事）← fari（说）
words.native_definition: extremely good; so great as to seem made up
words.core_concept: the kind of thing you would only expect to hear in a tale – 只该在故事里听到的那种
words.core_image: 端上来那一桌，客人先说了句「这哪像真的」
examples: The meal was fabulous.
He has fabulous wealth.
semantic_expansions: 极好的/惊人的：好到像只该在故事里听到
传说中的：本义，出自故事的
words.recall_hint: fabula（故事）+ -ous → 像故事里那样的

words.root_logic: in-（不）+ fant（fari 的现在分词 fans 说）→ 还不会说话的那个 → 婴儿
words.origin: 古法语 enfant ← 拉丁语 infans（不会说话的）← in-（不）＋fari（说）的现在分词
words.native_definition: a very young child, especially one not yet walking
words.core_concept: the one who has everything to say and no words yet – 什么都想表达、却还没有话的那个
words.core_image: 他张着嘴使劲出声，但那些声音还拼不成词
examples: The infant slept through the night.
Infant care takes patience.
semantic_expansions: 婴儿/幼儿：还不会说话的那个
words.recall_hint: in-（不）+ fant（说）→ 还不会说话的那个

words.root_logic: flos（花）→ 植株开出来的那一朵
words.origin: 古法语 flour ← 拉丁语 flos/floris（花）
words.native_definition: the coloured part of a plant that produces seeds
words.core_concept: the part a plant puts out when it has strength to spare – 植株攒足了劲才推出来的那一处
words.core_image: 枝上那处颜色一天天张开，花瓣一层压着一层
examples: She picked a yellow flower.
The tree flowers in April.
semantic_expansions: 花：植株开出来的那一朵
开花：推出那一朵这个动作
words.recall_hint: flos（花）→ 植株开出的那一朵

words.root_logic: flos（花、最好的部分）→ fleur de farine（面之精）→ 面粉
words.origin: 中古英语 flour（面之精），与 flower 同词分化 ← 拉丁语 flos（花、精华）
words.native_definition: powder made from ground wheat, used for baking
words.core_concept: the finest layer sifted out of the ground grain – 磨过的谷里筛出来的最细那一层
words.core_image: 粗的留在筛上，落下来的那层白得发亮
examples: Add two cups of flour.
She dusted the board with flour.
semantic_expansions: 面粉：磨过的谷里筛出的最细那一层，本义即「面之精」
words.recall_hint: flos（精华）→ fleur de farine（面之精）→ 面粉

words.root_logic: flor（花）+ -ish → 开到最盛 → 兴旺、茁壮
words.origin: 古法语 florir ← 通俗拉丁语 florire ← 拉丁语 florere（开花）← flos（花）
words.native_definition: to grow well; to be successful and thriving
words.core_concept: the moment a thing puts out everything it has – 一物把攒下的劲全推出来那一刻
words.core_image: 那株移过来第二年就窜高一截，枝上密密都是花
examples: The business flourished.
Plants flourish in this soil.
semantic_expansions: 茁壮成长/兴旺/繁荣：把攒下的劲全推出来、开到最盛
words.recall_hint: flor（花）+ -ish → 开到最盛

words.root_logic: heres（继承人）→ 依法接过家产的那个人
words.origin: 古法语 eir ← 拉丁语 heres（继承人）；英语拼写的 h 是后来照拉丁语补的，不发音
words.native_definition: a person legally entitled to inherit property or a title
words.core_concept: the one named to receive when the holder lets go – 持有者松手时，被指名接住的那个
words.core_image: 文书上写着那个名字，老人一走东西就归他
examples: He is the sole heir.

semantic_expansions: 继承人/嗣子：持有者松手时被指名接住的那个
words.recall_hint: heres（继承人）→ 依法接过家产的那个人

words.root_logic: herit（继承）+ -age → 一代代传下来的那一份
words.origin: 古法语 heritage ← heriter ← 晚期拉丁语 hereditare（继承）← heres
words.native_definition: traditions and buildings passed down from earlier generations
words.core_concept: what each generation hands on without being asked to – 每一代自然而然交下去的那一份
words.core_image: 老屋、老手艺、老规矩，都是上一辈没说什么就留下的
examples: The town protects its heritage.
Music is part of her heritage.
semantic_expansions: 遗产/文化遗产：一代代传下来的那一份
传统：其中无形的那部分
words.recall_hint: herit（继承）+ -age → 一代代传下来的那份

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ herit（继承）→ 接进自己名下 → 继承
words.origin: 古法语 enheriter ← 晚期拉丁语 inhereditare ← in＋heres（继承人）
words.native_definition: to receive property or a quality from someone before you
words.core_concept: the thing coming into your hands because it left another's – 因为别人松了手，它才落进你手里
words.core_image: 钥匙从那只手落进这只手，屋子从此归后者
examples: She inherited the house.
He inherited his father's temper.
semantic_expansions: 继承：因别人松手而落进自己手里
遗传：性状同样由上一代传下来
words.recall_hint: in-（进入）+ herit（继承）→ 接进自己名下

words.root_logic: jocus（戏言）→ 说出来逗人笑的那句
words.origin: 拉丁语 jocus（玩笑、戏言）
words.native_definition: something said or done to make people laugh
words.core_concept: the line said only for the laugh it gets – 只为博一声笑而说的那句
words.core_image: 他把最后半句一压低，满桌人先是静了一下才笑
examples: He told a bad joke.
She takes a joke well.
semantic_expansions: 玩笑/笑话：只为博一声笑而说的那句
words.recall_hint: jocus（戏言）→ 说出来逗人笑的那句

words.root_logic: jocus（玩物）→ 古法语 jouel（小玩赏物）→ 宝石
words.origin: 古法语 jouel（小玩物、饰件）← 拉丁语 jocus（玩笑、玩物）
words.native_definition: a precious stone; something highly valued
words.core_concept: the small bright thing kept only to be looked at – 留着只为看的那一小件亮东西
words.core_image: 绒布上那一点在灯下转个角度就换一种光
examples: The crown holds many jewels.
This book is a jewel.
semantic_expansions: 宝石/珠宝：留着只为看的那一小件亮东西
珍品：以此喻极可贵之物
words.recall_hint: jocus（玩物）→ jouel（小玩赏物）→ 宝石

words.root_logic: jewel（宝石）+ -ry（成套）→ 成套的饰件
words.origin: 古法语 juelerye ← jouel ← 拉丁语 jocus（玩物）
words.native_definition: rings, necklaces, and similar ornaments worn on the body
words.core_concept: the small bright things put on the body to be seen – 戴在身上、供人看的那些亮小件
words.core_image: 抽屉里一格一格摆着，戴出去时挑那么一两件
examples: She wore silver jewelry.
The jewelry was locked away.
semantic_expansions: 珠宝/首饰：戴在身上供人看的那些亮小件
words.recall_hint: jewel（宝石）+ -ry（成套）→ 成套的饰件

words.root_logic: dran（做）→ drama（做出来的那一场）→ 戏剧
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 drama ← 希腊语 drama（一场演出）← dran（做、行动）
words.native_definition: a play for theatre or television; an exciting series of events
words.core_concept: the doing put on a raised floor so all can watch – 摆到台上、让所有人看着的那一番做
words.core_image: 幕布拉开，台上的事一件件当着众人做出来
examples: She studies modern drama.
The trial was full of drama.
semantic_expansions: 戏剧/剧本：摆到台上做给人看的那一场
戏剧性事件：现实里像那一场一样起伏的事
words.recall_hint: dran（做）→ drama（做出来的那一场）

words.root_logic: drama（一场演出）+ -ic → 像台上那一场的 → 引人注目的、剧烈的
words.origin: 拉丁语 dramaticus ← 希腊语 dramatikos ← drama ← dran（做）
words.native_definition: sudden and noticeable; relating to plays
words.core_concept: of the kind that makes every head turn, as on a stage – 属于「一动就满座回头」那一类
words.core_image: 价钱一夜之间翻了一倍，第二天所有人都在说这事
examples: Prices rose dramatically.
She has dramatic talent.
semantic_expansions: 剧烈的/引人注目的：一动就满座回头那种
戏剧性的：属于台上那一场的
words.recall_hint: drama（一场演出）+ -ic → 像台上那一场

words.root_logic: drastikos（见效猛的）← dran（做）→ 下手重、来得急的
words.origin: 希腊语 drastikos（有力的、见效的）← dran（做、行动）
words.native_definition: extreme and sudden, often severe in effect
words.core_concept: the kind of doing that leaves no room for halfway – 那种做法不留半途，一下到底
words.core_image: 他没有慢慢调，直接把整套换掉了
examples: They took drastic measures.
A drastic change was needed.
semantic_expansions: 激烈的/极端的/彻底的：下手重、不留半途的那种做法
words.recall_hint: drastikos（见效猛）← dran（做）→ 下手重的

words.root_logic: factio（做法、做成的样式）← facere（做）→ 一时通行的做法与样式
words.origin: 古法语 fachon（式样）← 拉丁语 factio（做、样式）← facere（做）
words.native_definition: a popular style of clothing or behaviour; a way of doing something
words.core_concept: the way of making that everyone happens to follow this season – 这一季众人恰好都照着做的那个样式
words.core_image: 街上的裁法今年忽然都改成一个走向，去年那种没人做了
examples: Short coats are back in fashion.
He did it in his own fashion.
semantic_expansions: 时尚/流行式样：一时通行的那种做法与样式
方式：做一件事所取的那个做法
words.recall_hint: factio（做法、样式）← facere（做）→ 通行的样式

words.root_logic: fais（facere 做）+ -ible（可…的）→ 做得成的 → 可行的
words.origin: 古法语 faisable（可做的）← faire ← 拉丁语 facere（做）
words.native_definition: possible to do or achieve
words.core_concept: the plan that survives the question can this actually be done – 经得住「这真做得成吗」一问的那个方案
words.core_image: 把工序一步步排下来，发现每一步都真办得到
examples: The plan seems feasible.
It is not feasible in one week.
semantic_expansions: 可行的/行得通的：经得住「真做得成吗」一问的那种
words.recall_hint: fais（做）+ -ible（可…的）→ 做得成的

words.root_logic: facsimile（fac simile 做得一样）的截短 → 传过去的那份复本
words.origin: 英语 fax 是 facsimile 的截短；facsimile ← 拉丁语 fac simile（做成相像的）← facere（做）
words.native_definition: a copy of a document sent over a phone line
words.core_concept: the copy made to come out the same at the far end – 在远处那头做出来、要求一模一样的复本
words.core_image: 这头把纸吃进去，那头一张一模一样的吐出来
examples: Send it by fax today.
The fax never arrived.
semantic_expansions: 传真/传真件：在远处做出来、要求一模一样的复本
words.recall_hint: facsimile（fac simile 做得一样）截短 → 传过去的复本

words.root_logic: debere（本该有却不在手上）← de＋habere（持有）→ 该给的、到期的
words.origin: 古法语 deu（debvoir 的过去分词）← 拉丁语 debere（欠）← de＋habere（持有）
words.native_definition: owed as a debt or obligation; expected at a certain time
words.core_concept: what is on the books to be handed over, and the day it falls – 账上写着该交出去的那份，及该交的那天
words.core_image: 本子上记着日子，翻到那一页就知道该给了
examples: The rent is due on Friday.
The train is due at six.
semantic_expansions: 应付的/到期的：账上该交出去的那份及其期限
预期的：按约该到的那个时候
words.recall_hint: debere（本该有却不在手）← de＋habere → 该给的

words.root_logic: due（该给的）+ -ty → 该做的那一份 → 职责；也指该缴的那笔税
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 duete ← deu（该给的）← 拉丁语 debere ← de＋habere（持有）
words.native_definition: something one is obliged to do; a tax on goods
words.core_concept: the share of work that is owed, not chosen – 分给你、非做不可的那一份，不是你挑的
words.core_image: 值班表上那格写着他的名字，轮到就得在那儿
examples: It is your duty to report it.
They paid duty on the import.
semantic_expansions: 职责/义务：分给你、非做不可的那一份
关税：进出货物该缴的那笔
words.recall_hint: due（该给的）+ -ty → 该做的那一份

words.root_logic: en-（使）+ devoir（该做之事）→ 把该做的当成自己的事去尽力 → 努力
words.origin: 中古英语 endeveren，由 en-＋古法语 deveir（本分）← 拉丁语 debere ← de＋habere
words.native_definition: to try hard to do something
words.core_concept: taking what is owed as one's own and pushing at it – 把该做的那份认作自己的，往上使劲
words.core_image: 他把那份本不属他的活也接了过来，一样往前推
examples: She endeavored to finish on time.
It was a worthy endeavor.
semantic_expansions: 努力/尽力/尝试：把该做的认作自己的、往上使劲
words.recall_hint: en-（使）+ devoir（该做之事）→ 当作己事去尽力

words.root_logic: en-/in-（使）+ sure（无忧）→ 先出一笔把后顾之忧买掉 → 投保
words.origin: 英语 insure 是 ensure 的分化形 ← 古法语 enseurer ← 拉丁语 securus（无忧）← se-＋cura（挂心）
words.native_definition: to arrange for money to be paid if loss or damage happens
words.core_concept: paying a little now so the big loss is not yours to carry – 先付一点，把那笔大损失从自己肩上挪走
words.core_image: 每月扣掉一小笔，出事那天赔的是另一方
examples: They insured the house against fire.
Is the car insured?
semantic_expansions: 投保/为…保险：先付一点，把大损失从自己肩上挪走
words.recall_hint: in-（使）+ sure（无忧）→ 出钱买掉后顾之忧

words.root_logic: grev（gravis 重）→ 压在心上那份沉 → 悲痛
words.origin: 古法语 grief（苦难）← grever（压重）← 拉丁语 gravare ← gravis（重的）
words.native_definition: very great sadness, especially after a death
words.core_concept: the weight that settles on the chest and does not lift – 压在胸口、久久不散的那份沉
words.core_image: 他坐着没说话，肩往下垮着，像有东西压在上头
examples: She was overcome with grief.
Time eases grief.
semantic_expansions: 悲痛/悲伤：压在胸口久久不散的那份沉
words.recall_hint: grev（重）→ 压在心上那份沉

words.root_logic: in-（不）+ ert（ars 技艺、本事）→ 没本事动起来 → 惰性
words.origin: 拉丁语 inertia（无能、懒惰）← iners（无技艺的）← in-（不）＋ars（技艺）
words.native_definition: a tendency to stay unchanged; resistance to being moved
words.core_concept: the state of a thing that will not start moving on its own – 一物自己不会动起来的那个状态
words.core_image: 推第一下最费劲，一旦动起来反倒不用那么使力
examples: The body has great inertia.
Bureaucratic inertia slowed reform.
semantic_expansions: 惯性/惰性：一物自己不会动起来的那个状态
不作为：把这份不动用在人或机构上
words.recall_hint: in-（不）+ ert（技艺、本事）→ 没本事动起来

words.root_logic: credere（信托）→ creantare（许诺、应承）→ 应允给出 → 授予
words.origin: 古法语 granter（应允）← creanter ← 通俗拉丁语 credentare ← 拉丁语 credere（信托）
words.native_definition: to agree to give or allow something formally
words.core_concept: handing over what was asked because you take the asker at their word – 信得过对方所求，就把那份给了
words.core_image: 他把申请翻了一遍，抬头说了句可以，笔一签就批了
examples: The city granted permission.
She won a research grant.
semantic_expansions: 授予/准予：信得过所求便把那份给出
补助金：这样给出的那笔钱
words.recall_hint: credere（信托）→ creantare（应承）→ 应允给出

words.root_logic: fundere（倒出）→ futilis（一倒就漏的容器）→ 白费的
words.origin: 拉丁语 futilis（易漏的、无用的）← fundere（倒出、流泻）
words.native_definition: having no useful result; pointless
words.core_concept: the leaky jar you keep filling that never holds anything – 一只漏的罐，一直往里倒却始终装不住
words.core_image: 水一勺勺倒进去，底下同时往外淌，怎么倒都不满
examples: It was a futile attempt.
Further talks proved futile.
semantic_expansions: 无用的/徒劳的：像一只漏的罐，倒进去也留不住
words.recall_hint: futilis（一倒就漏的容器）← fundere（倒出）

words.root_logic: grammar（学问、法术书）的苏格兰语变体 → 施在人身上的那层魅 → 魅力
words.origin: 苏格兰语 glamer，为 grammar（旧时兼指法术之学）的变体 ← 希腊语 grammatikē ← graphein（刻写）
words.native_definition: an attractive and exciting quality
words.core_concept: the sheen laid over a thing so the eye will not look past it – 覆在一物上、叫人目光挪不开的那层光
words.core_image: 灯一打上去，本来平常的那身衣裳忽然亮得扎眼
examples: The city has a certain glamor.
She was drawn by the glamor of fame.
semantic_expansions: 魅力/诱惑力/光彩：覆在一物上、叫人目光挪不开的那层
words.recall_hint: grammar（旧兼指法术之学）的变体 ← graphein（刻写）

words.root_logic: in-（向内）+ cline（klinein 倾斜）→ 朝一边斜过去 → 倾向
words.origin: 拉丁语 inclinare（使倾斜）← in＋clinare ← 希腊语 klinein（倾斜）
words.native_definition: to lean or slope; to tend toward an opinion
words.core_concept: the surface tipped so things roll one way, not the other – 面一斜，东西就只往那一边滚
words.core_image: 板子一头垫高，珠子全滚到低的那边去了
examples: The path inclines steeply here.
I incline to agree with you.
semantic_expansions: 倾斜/斜坡：面朝一边斜过去
倾向：心里同样偏向某一边
words.recall_hint: in-（向内）+ cline（倾斜）→ 朝一边斜过去

words.root_logic: di-（分开）+ vorce（vertere 转）→ 各自转开 → 离婚
words.origin: 古法语 divorce ← 拉丁语 divortium（分离）← divertere（转开）← dis＋vertere（转）
words.native_definition: the legal ending of a marriage; a complete separation
words.core_concept: two who had faced each other turning away – 本来对着的两人各自转开身
words.core_image: 两人在桌两边签完字，起身朝相反方向走出门
examples: They filed for divorce.
There is a divorce between theory and practice.
semantic_expansions: 离婚：本来对着的两人各自转开
分离：两者之间同样转开、不再相接
words.recall_hint: di-（分开）+ vorce（转）→ 各自转开

words.origin: 中古英语 kide ← 古诺斯语 kið（小山羊）← 原始日耳曼语 *kidjom；十六世纪起用来称人的幼崽
words.native_definition: a child, a young goat, or to tease someone playfully

examples: The kids ran out into the yard.

words.origin: 中古英语 kidenei，第二成分 ei 是「蛋」，指其形状；第一成分说法不一，更早词源不明

examples: He donated a kidney to his brother.
The kidneys filter waste from the blood.

消磨：把一段时间用掉，像把它做掉一样

words.origin: 法语 kilo- ← 希腊语 khilioi（一千），十九世纪随公制一起进入英语
words.native_definition: a unit of mass equal to one thousand grams

examples: The bag weighs about two kilos.

公斤：同一份重量在日常口语里的说法

words.origin: 古英语 cynn（族、种）← 原始日耳曼语 *kunja（出身、血统）

examples: She has no kin living nearby.

家族：这些人合起来算作的一支

words.native_definition: a group of things sharing a nature, or gentle and helpful by nature

examples: What kind of music do you like?

words.origin: 古英语 cyning ← 原始日耳曼语 *kuningaz：*kunja（族）+ -inga（属于），字面「族里出来的那位」

大王：某一行里最能耐的那个人被这样叫

words.origin: 古英语 cyssan ← 原始日耳曼语 *kussjan，词形本身带着拟声的味道

亲：日常口语里做这个动作的说法
